src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela lokuzuziwe lokugcanyiswe nguMengameli Jacob Zuma ngesikhatsi avakashele Sikhumulo Semikhumbi saseBhayi eMphumalanga Kapa, ayohlola inchubekelembili leyentiwe ekufezekiseni i-Operation Phakisa: Umtamo Wemnotfo Waselwandle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile osekuzuziwe okuqhakanjiswe nguMongameli u-Jacob Zuma ngenkathi ehambele mathupha Echwebeni laseBhayi eMpumalanga Kapa, ukuhlola inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe maqondana nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kohlelo lomnotho wasolwandle olwaziwa ngokuthi yi-Operation Phakisa: Umnotho Waselwandle.

src: Hulumende sewudale tintjalomali letingu-R17 wetigidzi Emnotfweni Waselwandle.
tgt: Uhulumeni usethukulule utshalomali olufinyelela cishe kwizigidigidi eziyi-17 zamarandi Emnothweni Wasolwandle.

src: Kusukela yacala, sekudaleke imisebenti lengetulu kwale-4 500 emikhakheni leyehlukene.
tgt: Kusukela ekusengulweni kwalo lolu hlelo, sekusungulwe imisebenzi engaphezu kwezi-4 500 emikhakheni enhlobonhlobo.

src: Tikebhe letimbili taleyimfica tekudvosa imikhumbi letakhiwe yi-Southern African Shipyards teSiphatsimandla Setikhumulo Temikhumbi Savelonkhe SeTransnet (i-TNPA) eSikhumulweni Semikhumbi yaseDurban iyiswa eBhayi.
tgt: Izingalawana ezimbili kweziyisishiyagalolunye ezakhiwa Izakhamkhumbi zaseNingizimu ne-Afrika zakwa-Transnet National Ports Authority (i-TNPA) Echwebeni lase-Durban zizohanjiswa Echwebeni laseBhayi.

src: Mengameli Zuma wetfule sikebhe sekudvosa imikhumbi sekucala eBhayi, lesibitwa ngekutsi nguMvezo, lesetsiwe ngeligama lendzawo lapho kwatalelwa khona Mengameli waphambilini Nelson Mandela.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma wethule ingalawana yokuqala eBhayi, ebizwa ngokuthi uMvezo, eqanjwe ngegama lendawo yokuzalwa kaMongameli waphambilini uNelson Mandela.

src: I-TNPA seyabe ngetulu kwetigidzigidzi le-R7 tekuphucula tikhumulo tetfu temikhumbi.
tgt: I-TNPA seyabe izigidigidi ezingaphezu kweziyi-7 zamarandi ukwenza ngcono amachweba ethu.

src: Mengameli wehlwaye lugidzi lwekuhambisa nekwemukela tikebhe letincane loluphuculiwe nalolwakhiwe kabusha kanye netakhiwonchanti tesikhumulo semikhumbi tekuvikela imikhumbi eSikhumulweni Semikhumbi saseBhayi lesitawetfwala imikhumbi lengetulu kwale-12 kunalena lemibili lekhona kwamanje.
tgt: UMongameli uzibhekile izindlela ezishibilikayo ezivuselelwe kabusha nezakhiwe kabusha kanye nemigudu eholela ezakhiweni zokukhuleka imikhumbi Echwebeni laseBhayi ezizokwazi ukuhlala imikhumbi eyi-12 ngaphezulu uma kuqhathaniswa nalena emibili ekhona njengamanje.

src: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu labakhokha umtselo lababambisene nahulumende ngemnyakamabhuku wanga-2015/16 kwenta lugcogcomali lolwente tigidzigidzi tetigidzigidzi le-R1 kwekucala ngca.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke abakhokhi bentela ababambisane nohulumeni onyakeni wezimali wezi-2015/16 ekuthatheni izimali zethu eziqoqwayo bazibeke kutriliyoni yamarandi okokuqala ngqa emlandweni.

src: Lena yinkhomba lecaca kahle kamhlophe yemandla emnotfo wetfu lophumelelako ngisho nasetimeni letimatima.
tgt: Lesi yisibonakaliso esicacile samandla omnotho wethu ohlumayo ngisho ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.

src: Kungenca yemtselo lokhokhwa bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labahambisana nemtsetfo kanye nekugcogca ngemphumelelo kweLuphiko Lwamalingena LwaseNingizimu Afrika lokwenta kutsi hulumende akhone kwetfula kancono tinsita letidzingeka kakhulu letifaka sandla ekuphuculeni timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Kungenxa yezinkokhelo zentela ezivela kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abathobela umthetho kanye nokuqoqwa kwezimali ngempumelelo yiSikhungo Sezinsizakalo Zokuqoqwa Kwezimali saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS) nakuba uhulumeni ukwazi kangcono ukuhlinzeka izinsizakalo ezibhekwe ngamehlo abovu ezinegalelo ekwenzeni ngcono izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iyasemukela simemetelo saMengameli Zuma sekutsi lusuku lwamhla ti-3 Ingci 2016 lube lusuku Lwelukhetfo Lwahulumende Wasekhaya Lwanga-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamukelile isimemezelo sikaMongameli uZuma somhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016 njengosuku Lokhetho Lohulumeni Bezindawo Lwezi-2016.

src: Hulumende uyatfokota kutsi letimphelansontfo letimbili tekubhalisa tamhla ti-5 – 6 Mabasa kanye nemhla ti-9 – 10 Mabasa kube khona emanani lamakhulu ebantfu labatawuba bavoti labavakashele titeshi tekuvota, ikakhulu bavoti labacala kuvota kanye nelusha.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyakujabulela ukuthi izimpelasonto ezimbili zokubhalisela ukuvota ngomhla zi-5–6 kuNdasa kanye nomhla ziyi-9–10 kuMbasa zibonise inqwaba yabantu abangavota behambela ezikhungweni zokuvota, ikakhulukazi labo abazobe bevota okokuqala kanye nentsha.

src: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu labaphendvulile kulesimemo sekubhalisa baphindze futsi bahlola nemininingwane yabo eluhlwini lwekubhalisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke labo abasabelile ekhweleni lokubhalisela ukuvota kanye nokuyobheka imininingwane yabo ohlwini labavoti.

src: Kungenca yekubambisana kwetfu lokwenta kutsi intsandvo yelinyenti yetfu itfutfuke ngemandla isuke kulinye lizinga iye kulelinye.
tgt: Kungenxa yokusebenza kwethu ndawonye lapho intando yeningi yethu izokwazi ukukhula izikhathi ngezikhathi.

src: Ikhabhinethi icela tonkhe takhamuti letisengakabhalisi nobe letisengakahloli imininingwane yato kutsi tivakashele emahhovisi eKhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele kubomasipala bato bendzawo tilungise imininingwane yato eluhlwini lwebavoti ibe sesikhatsini samanje (tinikete emakheli ato) tibuye futsi tibhalisele kuvota nakuvotwa mhla ti-3 Ingci.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa zonke izakhamuzi ezingakabhaliseli ukuvota noma ezingakayibheki imininingwane yazo ukuba zihambele amahhovisi eKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele komasipala bezindawo bazo bese zivuselela imininingwane yazo ohlwini labavoti (zihlinzeke ngamakheli) bese zibhalisela ukuvota okhethweni lomhla zi-3 kuNcwaba.

src: Bavoti bangabuye futsi batfumele tinombolo tabo tematisi nge-SMS ku: 3281.0 nobe bashayele sikhungo sekutsintsana ku: 0800 11 8000 kute bacinisekise simo.
tgt: Abavoti bangaphinda futhi bathumele nge-SMS inombolo yabo kamazisi ku-3281.0 noma baxhumane nesikhungo sezingcingo ku-0800 11 8000 ukuqinisekisa isimo sabo.

src: Kubhalisa kwenta kutsi ligama lakho libe khona eluhlwini lwebavoti kute kutsi ukwati kuvota.
tgt: Ukubhalisa kuqinisekisa ukuthi igama lakho likhona ohlwini labavoti ukuze uzokwazi ukuvota.

src: Ikhabhinethi imema takhamuti kutsi tisebentise lilungelo lato lentsandvo yelinyenti leyatfolwa kamatima kutsi tivote eLukhetfweni Lwahulumende Wasekhaya lwanga-2016 mhla ti-3 Ingci 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema izakhamizi ukuba zisebenzise ilungelo lethu lomthethosiseko esalithola kanzima lokuvota Okhethweni Lohulumeni Bezindawo Lwezi-2016 ngomhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa ngalokusemtsetfweni kweMkamo Wekufezekisa i-eChannel weLitiko Letasekhaya (i-DHA) nguMengameli Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukwethulwa ngokusemthethweni komklamo obizwa ngokuthi yi-eChannel Pilot Project woMnyango Wezasekhaya (i-DHA) nguMongameli uZuma.

src: Lomtamo lomusha utawenta takamuti kutsi tikwati kufaka ticelo tabomakhadimatisi babo ku-inthanethi futsi tigweme kuma imigca lemidze.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luusha lesimanje manje luvumela izakhamuzi ukuba zikwazi ukufaka izicelo zazo zomazisi abangamakhadi, i-Smart ID, ku-inthanethi futhi zigweme imigqa emide.

src: Kubambisana nemabhange lamakhulu lamane i–ABSA, FNB, Nedbank kanye neStandard Bank– kwetfula indlela yekufaka ticelo taBomakhadimatisi kanye nemapasipoti ku-inthanethi kutawenta emakhasimende kutsi avakashele ema-kiosks e-DHA kutsi angenise tinyatseliso teminwe ato kanye netitfombe ngemuva kwekuhlela tikhatsi tekwenta loko kantsi futsi sebakhokhele ku-inthanethi.
tgt: Lokhu kusebenzisana namabhange amane amakhulu – okuyi-ABSA, i-FNB, i-Nedbank kanye ne-Standard Bank – ukwethula inkundla yokufaka izicelo kwi-inthanethi zomazisi abangamakhadi kanye namaphasiphothi kuzokwenza izakhamuzi zikwazi ukuhambela amakhosombe e-DHA ukuhambisa izinsalela zawo zeminwe kanye nezithombe emva kokuba esenze isivumelwano sokubonana futhi enza nezinkokhelo kwi-inthanethi.

src: I-eChannel iyincenye yendlelalisu yesimanje yekuphucula ngalokuphelele yekwenta kutsi tinsita tingasentiwa ephepheni kepha tentiwe ngekwedijithali, inchubo letawufaka ekhatsi kuhlantwa kwerejista yebantfu.
tgt: I-eChannel iyingxenye yeqhinga selilonke lomnyango lesimanjemanje lokususa izinsizakalo ephepheni ziye kubuxhakaxhaka bubochwepheshe, uhlelo oluzobandakanya ukulungiswa kwamaphutha kwirejista enemininingwane yabantu.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuphumelela kweliViki Lekugcila KutiMbizo lesandza kubanjwa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi ‘Sisonkhe sichubekisela iNingizimu Afrika embili’, lokwenta kutsi tikhulu tahulumende tikhulumisane nemimango kulo lonkhe lelive.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukelile impumelelo yeViki Lokubamba Izimbizo esanda kubanjwa nje ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi ‘Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika phambili’, ebonise izikhulu zikahulumeni zixoxisana nemiphakathi ezweni lonkana.

src: IKhabhinethi incoma bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labahlanganyele etinhlelweni letingetulu kwaletinge-36 kulo lonkhe lelive, labacinisekise kutsi hulumende uyaphendvula ekuboneni tidzingo temimango.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma labo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezingaphezu kwama-36 ezweni lonkana, abaqinisekisile ukuthi uhulumeni uyaphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi ezihlonziwe.

src: LiViki Lekugcila kutiMbizo seyihlomise imimango ngelwatiso lolumayelana netinhlelo tahulumende.
tgt: IViki Lokubamba Izimbizo isimamise imiphakathi ngolwazi maqondana nezinhlelo zikahulumeni.

src: Litiko Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu libambe inkhomfa yaMhlabuhlangene (ye-UN) lebe yimphumelelo lenkhulu lebeyibukene nekuhlala kwebantfu etindzaweni letingakahleleki (emikhukhwini), igcizelela lizinga lesivinini lekwenta letindzawo kutsi tibe tasemadolobheni kanye nekukhula kwemikhukhu.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu usingathe ingqungquthela eyimpumelelo Yenhlangano Yezizwee (i-UN) ebibhekene nezindawo zokuhlala eziyimikhukhu, igcizelela izinga elimangalisayo lokufudukela kwabantu emadolobheni kanye nokukhula kwemikhukhu.

src: Manje bantfu labasigidzi sinye emhlabeni bahlala emikhukhwini.
tgt: Njengamanje abantu abayisigidigidi esisodwa emhlabeni bahlala emikhukhwini.

src: INingizimu Afrika seyakhe tindlu letitigidzi kusukela nga-1994 njengencenye yekucinisekisa imphilo lencono yabo bonkhe bantfu.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika kusukela ngowe-1994 seyakhe izigidi ngezigidi zezindlu njengengxenye yokuqinisekisa impilo engcono kubo bonke abantu.

src: ImitsetfosivivinyoIKhabhinethi ivume tinhlaka taleMitsetfosivivinyo lelandzelako:.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywaIKhabhinethi igunyaze lezinhlaka zeMithethosivivinywa elandelayo:.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuvikelwa Kwetakhiwonchanti Letibalulekile wa-2016 kutsi ushicilelwe kuGazethi yaHulumende kute kutsi ummango uphawule.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuvikelwa Kwengqalasizinda Esemqoka wezi-2016 uzoshicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze kutholakale imibono yomphakathi ngawo.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ucitsa Umtsetfo Wetindzawo Tavelonkhe Letibalulekile, 1980 (Umtsetfo-102 wa-1980), futsi ufuna kwenta lenchubo yekukhomba nekumemetela takhiwonchanti letibalulekile kuhambisane futsi kwentiwe ngendlela lebeka tintfo ebaleni lebuye futsi ibe nekutiphendvulela.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchitha uMthetho Wezintuba Ezisemqoka Zikazwelonke, we-1980 (uMthetho we-102 we-1980), futhi ufuna ukuhambelanisa inqubo yokuhlonza kanye nokudalulwa kwengqalasizinda esemqoka ngendlela esobala nephendulayo.

src: Utawubuye futsi wente siciniseko sekutsi tonkhe takhiwonchanti tekuvikela tavelonkhe talelive tiyakhonjwa tibuye futsi tivikelwe ngalokwenele.
tgt: Uzophinda futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izingqalasizinda zokuvikelela kuzwelonke kwezwe ziyakwazi ukuhlonzwa futhi ziyavikelwa ngokwanele.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wenta kutsi kwentiwe luhlakamsebenti lwesikhungo lwekulandzelela kanye nekulawula kuvikelwa kwetakhiwonchanti letibalulekile.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlinzekela ukumiswa kohlaka lokusebenza lwesikhungo ukuqapha nokusebenzisa ukuvikelwa kwezingqalasizinda ezisemqoka.

src: Luphindze futsi luchubeke luchaze imisebenti yemtimba lotaweluleka Indvuna Yetemaphoyisa ekumemeteleni takhiwonchanti letibalulekile.
tgt: Uphinde uchaze imisebenzi yomgwamanqa ozokweluleka uNgqongqoshe Wezamaphoyisa ekudalulweni kwezingqalasizinda ezisemqoka.

src: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela Tinhlangano Temphahla Yemmango wa- 2016 utawushicilelwa kute kutsi ummango uphawule.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchitshiyelwa Kwezinhlangano Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo wezi-2016 uzoshicilelwa ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibiyela Umtsetfo weTinhlangano Temphahla Yemmango, wa-1996 (Umtsetfo we-28 wa-1996).LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawucinisa inchubo yekuhola ngekubambisana kwentsandvo yelinyenti weTinhlangano Temphahla Yemmango letikhona nobe tintfo te-Trust letengamele umhlaba wemmango.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho wamanje Wezinhlangano Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo, we-1996 (uMthetho wama-28 we-1996).UMthethosivivinywa uzoqinisa uhlelo lokubusa ngentandoyeningi lweziNhlangano ezikhona njengamanje Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo noma izikhungo ezikhona njengamanje Zesikhwama Sezimali Ezisisiwe ezengamela umhlaba osetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo lochitjelwe wenta kutsi kwentiwe kube neRejista kuLitiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni kanye Netingucuko Kutemhlaba.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa ochitshiyelwe uhlinzekela ukumiswa kwehhovisi likaNobhala eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya kanye Nezinguquko Kwezomhlaba, futhi uchaze imisebenzi yaleli hhovisi.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ungaphasiswa ube ngumtsetfo, utawucinisa kulawulwa kwetikhungo letenganyelwe ubuye futsi wente kancono kwesekelwa kwato nguMbuso.
tgt: Uma lo Mthethosivivinywa usuphasisiwe waba umthetho, uzoqinisa ukulawulwa kwezikhungo zokubusa futhi uthuthukise ukwesekwa kwawo nguMbuso.

src: Utawenta imimango kutsi itfole, ibe nemphahla ibuye futsi iyilawule ngekusebentisa imitimba yetekulawula yetemtsetfo lesunguliwe lesekelwa nguhulumende.
tgt: Uzovumela imiphakathi ukuba ithole, ibambe futhi iphathe izimpahla ngokusebenzisa izikhungo zokwenziwa komsebenzi ezisungulwe ngokusemthethweni ngempumelelo zisekelwa nguhulumeni.

src: Kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekulawula Wemave Emhlaba wa-2016.
tgt: Ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokulamula Emhlabeni Wonke wezi-2016 ePhalamende.

src: Inchubo yekulamula yemave emhlaba ilithulusi lelibalulekile lwekwenta ibhizinisi nalamanye emave.
tgt: Inqubo yokulamula emhlabeni wonke iyithuluzi elisemqoka lokwenza ibhizinisi ngaphesheya kwemingcele yezwe.

src: Utawenta kancono tinsita tetebulungiswa tetinkampani letichuba ibhizinisi ngaphandle kweminyele yalelive kanye netinkampani talamanye emave letilapha eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Uzokwenza ngcono ukufinyeleleka kwezinsizakalo zobulungiswa ezinkampanini ezenza ibhizinisi ngaphandle kwaleli lizwe kanye nezinkampani zasemazweni angaphandle eNingizimu Afrika.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ucitsa Kwemukelwa kanye Nekucinisekiswa KweMtsetfo Wetincumo Temlamuli Temave Angephandle, wa-1977 (Umtsetfo we-40 wa-1977) uphindze futsi uchibele Umtsetfo Wekuvikelwa Kwemabhizinisi lokhona kwamanje, wa-1978 (Umtsetfo we-99 wa-1978).
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchitha uMthetho Wokwamukelwa kanye Nokuqiniswa Kwemiklomelo Yokulamula Emazweni Angaphandle, we-1977 (uMthetho wama-40 we-1977) uphinde futhi uchibiyele uMthetho wamanje Wokuvikelwa Kwebhizinisi, we-1978 (uMthetho wama-99 we-1978).

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhambisana neMtsetfo Loyimodeli Wekulamula Emabhizinisi Emave Emhlaba, lowemukelwe yiKhomishini ye-UN yeMtsetfo Wekuhweba Wemave Emhlaba.
tgt: Umthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo uhambelana Nomthetho Owuhlaka maqondana Nokulamula Kwezokuhwebelana Ezweni Lonke, owamukelwa yiKhomishana Yenhlangano Yezizwe maqondana Nomthetho Wezokuhwebelana Emhlabeni Wonke.

src: Kushicilelwa kweluhlaka LweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Wesikhwama Selucwaningo Savelonkhe wa-2016 kuGazethi yaHulumende kute kutsi ummango uphawule.
tgt: Ukushicilelwa kohlaka loMthethosivivinywa Wokuchitshiyelwa Kwesisekelo Socwaningo Lukazwelonke wezi-2016 kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze umphakathi uphawule.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo Wesikhwama Selucwaningo Savelonkhe, 1998 (Umtsetfo we-23 wa-1998).LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawenta kancono kucudzelana kweNingizimu Afrika ekutfutfukiseni lucwaningo kanye nekwenta tintfo letinsha nelulawulo lolusebentako, lolwenele naloluhlangene lwekuhlanganyela kwemmango kutesayensi, kanye nekuniketwa kwesakhiwonchanti selucwaningo lesivunyiwe kanye nekufinyelelwa.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wesisekelo Socwaningo Lukazwelonke, we-1998 (uMthetho wama-23 we-1998).

src: Utawuphindze futsi wente kancono kuphendvula kanye nekusebenta ngemphumelelo kwekutfutfukiswa kwetelucwaningo kanye nekutsi kwentiwe lokusha, kute kwentiwe kancono lizinga lemphilo yebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekuhambisana kancono netintfo tahulumende letibekwa embili.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uzokwenza ngcono ubuqhudelwano beNingizimu Afrika ekuthuthukisweni kocwaningo kanye nokuqamba kabusha ngokusebenzisa ukuphathwa ngempumelelo, ngendlela egculisayo futhi edidiyelwe kokuxoxisana komphakathi nabezesayensi, kanye nokuhlinzekwa okwenziwe ngcono kwengqalasizinda yocwaningo kanye nokufinyeleleka.

src: Tincumo teKhabhineti letibalulekile.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele Umtsetfo Lodzingidvwako weTebuphoyisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele Umthetho Odingidwayo Omaqondana Nobuphoyisa.

src: Loluhlaka lweMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako lwashicilelwa kwekucala kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo ngaMabasa 2015.
tgt: Uhlaka Lomthetho Odingidwayo lwashicilelwa okokuqala ukuze kutholakale imibono yomphakathi ngoNdasa 2015.

src: Lomtsetfo lodzingidvwako wenta kutsi kubekhona temisebenti yemaphoyisa lekhetsa takhamuti letishukumako kanye nekuphendvula kusimondzawo lesigadvwako lesikhona kwamanje.
tgt: Lo mthetho odingidwayo uhlinzekela imisebenzi yobuphoyisa echeme nezakhamuzi eziphilayo futhi ephendulayo esimweni samanje semisebenzi yobuphoyisa.

src: Uphindze futsi wente kutsi kube khona Luphiko Lwetemisebenti Yemaphoyisa LwaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemaphoyisa amasipala latiphendvulelako kanye nalatingcweti.
tgt: Uphinde uhlinzekele Umbutho Wamaphoyisa waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) kanye namaphoyisa kamasipala akwaziyo ukuphendula futhi asebenza ngobungoti.

src: LoMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako uphindze futsi wente simemo sekutsi kusungulwe Ibhodi Yemaphoyisa Yavelonkhe, emkhatsini waleminye imisebenti, utawuba nemsebenti wekusungula tinchubo letingavuni luhlangotsi tekutfolwa kwemaphoyisa, kukhetfwa nekubekwa etikhundleni kwemaphoyisa latfoliwe kutemisebenti yemaphoyisa.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo unxusa ukuba kusungulwe iBhodi Likazwelonke Lamaphoyisa, elizokuba, phakathi kweminye imisebenzi, nesibophezelo sokumisa imigomo yezinjongo zokuqashwa, ukuhlungwa kanye nokuqokwa kwabantu abasha emisebenzini yobuphoyisa.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele LoMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako weTekuvikela Nekuphepha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele Umthetho Odingidwayo Omaqondana Nezokuphepha Nokuvikeleka.

src: LoMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako, lesewuvele uphumile kute kutsi kukhulunyiswane ngawo nemmango ngeNdlovana 2015, ugcile endleleni lehlanganisiwe neyekutfutfukisa tekuvikela kwendlula tebuphoyisa.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo, obuvele usukhishiwe ukuze kuxoxiswane nomphakathi ngawo ngoNhlolanja 2015, ugxile endleleni yokusebenza edidiyelwe nethuthukisayo maqondana nokuphepha okungale komsebenzi wobuphoyisa.

src: Ufuna kukhombindlela kutekuvikela tekuphepha temimango.
tgt: Ufuna ukuba ngumkhombandlela mayelana nezinyathelo zokuvikela ezokuphepha zemiphakathi.

src: LoMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako uchaza onkhe ematiko lafanele kanye netinhlangano temmango letifaka sandla ekuphepheni kwemimango.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo uhlonza yonke iminyango efanelekile kanye nezinhlangano ezigxile emiphakathini ezinegalelo ekuphepheni kwemiphakathi.

src: IKhabhinethi iluvumile luhlaka Lwenchubomgomo Yelisiko Lekusoka LaseNingizimu Afrika yaphindze futsi yavuma kutsi Litiko Lebaholi Bendzabuko licale lente luhlaka lemtsetfo wekusoka lwavelonkhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze uhlaka lweNqubomgomo emaqondana Nosiko Lokusoka eNingizimu Afrika futhi yagunyaza nokuthi uMnyango Wezendabuko uqale ukwenza uhlaka lomthetho kazwelonke omaqondana nokusoka.

src: Lomtsetfomgomo sewuvele ungenele inchubo lenkhulu yekukhulumisana kwalabatsintseka labafanele.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo isivele isidlule ohlelweni olunzulu lokuxoxisana nomphakathi maqondana nayo kanye nababambiqhaza abafanelekile.

src: Lenchubomgomo iniketa tinkhombandlela leticinisekisa kuvikelwa kwelisiko lemnyaka lendzabuko lekusoka kwebafana labancane ngaphandle kwekutsi tekuphepha tabo tibe senkingeni.
tgt: Inqubomgomo ihlinzeka ngemihlahlandlela eqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kosiko lomdabu lokusokwa minyakayonke kwabafana abasebancane ngaphandle kokubeka ukuphepha kwabo engcupheni.

src: Loku kwenta incenye yetinyatselo hulumende latitsatsela kucinisekisa emasiko lafanele kanye nalemukelekile.
tgt: Lokhu kwenza ingxenye yezinyathelo uhulumeni azithathayo ukuqinisa amasiko afanelekile kanye navumelekile.

src: Ubuyisela esimeni lesifanele lizinga lelemukelekako lekutiphendvulela kulabo labachuba tikolwa tekusoka kanye nebatali labatfumela bantfwana babo kuletikolwa.
tgt: Igcina izinga elivumelekile lokukwazi ukuziphendulela kulabo bantu abaphethe izikole zokusoka kanye nabazali abathumela izingane zabo kulezo zikole.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume tincumo letentiwe Likomidi Lekuphenta mayelana nekukhona kuhweba ngetimphondvo tabhejane njengalenye indlela yekulondvolota bobhejane balelive.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze izincomo ezenziwe yiKomidi Lophenyo olumaqondana nokufaneleka kokuhweba ngezimpondo zobhejane njengenye yezindlela zokulondoloza obhejane kuleli lizwe.

src: Letincumo tavunywa Likomidi Letekweluleka Letebucwepheshe Lematiko Lahlangene kanye neLikomidi Letindvuna lelibekelwe kuphenya kutsi kungakhoneka yini kwenta kuhweba ngetimphondvo tabhejane etimakethe temhlaba kutsi kube semtsetfweni.
tgt: Lezi zincomo zamukelwa yiKomidi Lokweluka Kwezobuchwepheshe Leminyango Ehlukene kanye neKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukene aqokelwa ukuba aphenye ngamathuba okwenza kube semthethweni ukuhweba ngokuthengiselana ngezimpondo zobhejane emhlabeni wonke.

src: Letincumo temukela indlelalisu yekulawula lehlanganisiwe yaseNingizimu Afrika yekusombulula kutingelwa kubulawe bobhejane kanye nekuhweba ngabobhejane ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.
tgt: Izincomo zigunyaza indlela yokusebenza yaseNingizimu Afrika yokuphathwa ngobuqhinga obudidiyelwe kwesixazululo sokuzingelwa kobhejane kanye nokuhweba ngobhejane okungekho emthethweni.

src: Lelikomidi lincoma kutsi lendlela lekhona kwamanje yekugcina emazinga emfuyo alelive agcinekile ayigcinwe kunekutsi kuhwetjwe ngetimphondvo tabhejane.
tgt: Ikomidi lincoma ukuthi indlela esetshenziswa manje ukugcina isibalo sobhejane baleli lizwe kumele igcinwe uma iqhathaniswa nokuhwebelana ngezimpondo zobhejane.

src: Indlelalisu yalelive yekubukana nalesimo ifaka ekhatsi kuvikeleka kuhlonyiswa kwemmango kulawulwa kwetilokatana lokuhlanganisiwe, imigomo yemtsetfo lephendvulako lefezekiswa ngalokuyimphumelelo ibuye futsi icinisekise kanye nekulawulwa kwekufuna.
tgt: Indlela yokusebenza ngobuqhinga yaleli lizwe iqukethe ukuvikeleka ukunikezwa komphakathi amandla ukuphathwa kwebhayoloji izimiso zemithetho ephendulayo eziqaliswa ukusebenza ngempumelelo futhi eziqiniswayo kanye nokuphathwa kokufunwa ngamandla kobhejane.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kudizayinwa kwetinhlavu tekukhumbula kwanga-2016:a) Luchungechunge Lwetinhlavumali Tekuma Kwemhlaba Lwavelonkhe – Imitamo Yemakati Lamakhulu: ‘Lihlosi’.b) Umchele weSterling-silver kanye neluchungechunge lweluhlavumali lwe-tickey coin ‘Kucamba kwaseNingizimu Afrika –‘i-Dolosse’.Lamadizayini aletinhlavumali, kanye nekumenyetelwa kwato, kutawushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende, titawubese-ke tiyakhiwa tibuye futsi titsengiswe ngetindlela letetayelekile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze lawa madizayini alandelayo ezinhlamvu zemali azokuba yisikhumbuzo sowezi-2016:a) Uhlelo Lochungechunge Lwezinhlamvu Zemali ze-National Geographic –Amakati Amakhulu: ‘Ingulule’.b) Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zemali zepondo notiki ezinomqhele wesiliva ‘Okukhandwe eNingizimu Afrika–‘i-Dolosse’.Amadizayini ezinhlamvu zemali, kanye nokwaziswa kwawo, azophrintwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni, bese emva kwalokho azobe esekhiqizwa bese edayiswa kusetshenziswa imigudu ejwayelekile.

src: Imikhosi letako.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Mengameli Zuma utawutsi emkhatsini wamhla ti-18 namhla tinge-22 Mabasa 2016 angenele kuvakasha ngekwemsebenti avakashele emave langemalunga eNyonyane Yekutselisa Imphahla Yemave Laseningizimu ne-Afrika (i-SACU) lokufaka ekhatsi iNamibia, Botswana, Lesotho kanye neSwaziland.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzokube phakathi komhla ziyi-18 nama-22 Mbasa 2016 enohambo olusemthethweni lokuvakashela amazwe angamalungu eNhlangano yaMazwe Angakhokisani Intela yoHwebo aseNingizimu neAfrika (i-SACU) ahlanganisa i-Namibia, iBotswana, iLesotho kanye ne-Swaziland.

src: Lokuvakasha kutawenta kancono indzima lebalulekile ledlalwa yi-SACU ekutfutfukiseni kuhlangana kwetigodzi kanye nekutfutfukisa umnotfo wawo onkhe emalunga ayo.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambela kuzothuthukisa indima ebalulekile i-SACU eyidlalayo ekukhuthazeni ukuhlanganiswa kwezifunda kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho wawo wonke amalungu ayo.

src: Mengameli utawungenela luhambo lweKuvakasha kweMbuso aye e-Islamic Republic of Iran mhla tinge-23 kanye namhla tinge-24 Mabasa 2016 ayocinisa tinchubo temnotfo netepolitiki letisemkhatsini walamave lamabili.
tgt: UMongameli uzothatha uhambo Lokuhambela Kombuso ezweni lase-Islamic Republic of Iran ngomhla zingama-23 nama-24 kuMbasa 2016 ukuyoqinisa izingxoxo zezombusazwe kanye nezomnotho phakathi kwalamazwe amabili.

src: Mengameli utawuhola Kugujwa Kwemigubho yeLusuku Lwenkhululeko mhla tinge-27 Mabasa 2016 eLimpopo, eNkhundleni Yetemidlalo yaseGiyani ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Sisonkhe sakha imimango lencono – Hulumende Wendzawo ngumsebenti wawonkhewonkhe”.IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemikhakha kutsi bakhombise kutsandza live labo ngekutsi bahlanganyele kulemikhosi leyehlukene yekukhumbula Inyanga Yenkhululeko.
tgt: UMongameli uzohola imigubho yoSuku Lwenkululeko Lukazwelonke ngomhla zingama-27 Mbasa 2016 eLimpopo, eGiyani Stadium ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Sisonke sakha imiphakathi engcono – Uhulumeni Wezindawo uwumsebenzi wawo wonke umuntu”.IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nayo yonke imikhakha ukuba bakhombise ugqozi lwabo ngezwe labo ngokubamba iqhaza emicimbini enhlobonhlobo yokugubha iNyanga Yenkululeko.

src: Kulamaviki latako, iPhalamende itawube ibambe Tinkhulumiswano Temcombelelo wematiko.
tgt: Kulawa masonto ezayo, iPhalamende lizobe libambe Amavoti Eezabelomali zeminyango.

src: Labaphetse ematiko lahlukene batawendlala tinhlelo tabo tekusebenta temnyakatimali wanga-2016/17.
tgt: Iziphathimandla zeminyango ehlukahlukene zizothulula izinhlelo zazo zokusebenza zonyaka wezimali wezi-2016/17.

src: Emalunga emmango atawatiswa ngetinhlelo tahulumende tekwetfulwa kwetinsita.
tgt: Amalungu omphakathi azokwaziswa ngezinhlelo zokuhanjiswa kwezidingongqangi zikahulumeni.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letibalulekile tesimondzawo.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: IKhabhinethi iyemukele imphendvulo nekucolisa lokwalandzela kwaMengameli Zuma kusehlulelo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo lesimayelana nekuhambisana netinyatselo tekulungisa simo letabekwa kumbiko weMvikeli Wemmango.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukele impendulo kanye nokuxolisa okulandele lapho okwenziwe nguMongameli uZuma maqondana nesinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo mayelana nokuthobela izinyathelo zokulungisa isimo ezavezwa embikweni woMvikeli Womphakathi.

src: IKhabhinethi isasibukisisa lesehlulelo kute itfole kutsi ingabe tikhona yini letinye tinyatselo letingatsatfwa kute kuciniswe Imisebenti yaHulumende.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isafunda isinqumo ukuze ithole ukuthi ngabe zikhona yini ezinye izinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuqinisa indima kaHulumeni.

src: Lesehlulelo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo siyacinisa sibuye futsi sivikele intsandvo yelinyenti yemtsetfosisekelo yaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo siqinisa siphinde sivumele intando yeningi labantu eyatholakala ngokomthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi itivumile tinyatselo letitsetfwe ngemabhange lamane lakhipha satiso sekuvala ema-akhawunti asebhange enkampani letsite.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiqaphelile isenzo esenziwe ngamabhange amane afake isaziso sokuvala i-akhawunti yasebhange yenkampani ethile.

src: Nanobe Ikhabhinethi iyitfokotela imibandzela netimo talamabhange, letento tingacedza emandla ebatjalimali labebangatsandza kwenta ibhizinisi neNingizimu Afrika esikhatsini lesitako.
tgt: Yize iKhabhinethi iyiqonda kahle imigomo nemibandela yamabhange, lesi senzo singaphazamisa abatshalizimali bakusasa abangafisa ukwenza ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ikhabhinethi ivume kutsi Indvuna yeTetimali, Tetemisebenti kanye neTimbiwa tifanele kutsi tikhulumisane nalamabhange kute kutfolwe sisombululo lesingusonasona saloludzaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelene ngokuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, Wezabasebenzi kanye Nowezimbiwa Phansi kumele bavulele ingxoxo eyakhayo kanye namabhange ukuze kutholakale isisombululo sesikhathi eside kulolu daba.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele Indvuna yeTemphilo, Dkt.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, othole indondo yomhlaba wonke evela kwi-USAID-TB yokumhlonipha ngobuholi bakhe empini yomhlaba wonke yokulwisana nesifo sofuba (i-TB) kanjalo nokuhola phambili izinhlelo zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezezifunda ekuhlolelweni, ukwelapha kanye nokuvimbela i-TB amagciwane okutheleleka nge-TB kanye Negciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) ngesikhathi esisodwa kanye ne-TB engazweli amakhambi.

src: Aaron Motsoaledi, lotfole umklomelo wemave emhlaba we-USAID-TB wekubona nekuhlonipha buholi bakhe ekulweni kwemave emhlaba nesifo sesifuba (i-TB) kanye nekuhola imitamo yesigodzi yaseNingizimu Afrika ekuhlolisiseni, kwelashwa kanye nekuvikela kungenwa yi-TB TB/HIV kanye ne-TB lelwa nekwelashwa ngemitsi leminyenti lehlanganisiwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukuqokwa kweNingizimu Afrika njengezwe elizokwamukela Indondo yowezi-2016 Yemisebenzi Enhlobonhlobo Yosomaqhinga nguMkhandlu Wezindaba Zomhlaba e-Washington, DNjengezwe lokuqala lase-Afrika ukuthola le ndondo, ihlonipha ukuzinikela okuvelele kwezwe ekufundiseni umhlaba wonke, izindaba zamazwe omhlaba kanye nokuxhumana emhlabeni wonke ukuze liqhubele phambili izimfuno zezwe.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuphakanyiswa kweNingizimu Afrika njengalotawemukela Umklomelo Lokhetsekile Wekuchuba Nebudlelwane Lobuhle Nemave Emhlaba nga-2016 lotawuniketwa nguMkandlu Wetindzaba Temave Emhlaba eWashington, DNjengelive lekucala kutfola lomklomelo, uhlonipha kutinikela lokuvelele kwalelive kutemfundvo yemave emhlaba, tindzaba temave emhlaba kanye nekuchumana nemave emhlaba kute kutfutfukiswe tintfo letifunwa ngulelive.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income uNgqongqoshe Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Nokubambisana, uNkz Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngegalelo lakhe ezingxoxweni zeNingizimu Afrika namazwe omhlaba, ezigqugquzelwa ngumbono “wezwekazi lase-Afrika elibumbene elinoxolo, elibuswa ngentando yeningi labantu, elingacwasi ngokobuhlanga, elingacwasi ngokobulili futhi eliqhakazile, futhi elinegalelo emhlabeni onobulungiswa nonokulingana.”.

src: IKhabhinethi incoma Indvuna yeLitiko Letebudlelwane Nekubambisana Nemave Emhlaba, Mk Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngekufaka ligalelo ekukhulumisaneni kweNingizimu Afrika nemave angaphandle, lokuchutjwa ngumbononchanti lotsi “livekati lase-Afrika lelibumbene lelinekuthula, lentsandvo yelinyenti, lelingabandlululi ngekwebuhlanga, ngekwebulili naleliphumelelako, kanye futsi nalelifaka ligalelo emhlabeni lolungile futsi lolinganako.”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukuqokwa nguMongameli uZuma ko-Advocate u-Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengeNhloko yoPhiko Olukhethekile Lezophenyo, futhi imfisela okuhle nokumhlophe emisebenzini yakhe emisha yokuqeda inkohlakalo kanye nokuphatha budlabha.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kutsi Mengameli Zuma abeke esikhundleni Advocate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengeNhloko yeLuphiko Lwekuphenya Lolukhetsekile, futsi umfisela konkhe lokuhle emisebentini yakhe lemisha yekulwa nenkhohlakalo nekulawula ngalokungafanele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu emndenini wakwaMakwetu nakwi-Pan Africanist Congress ngokwedlula emhlabeni kukaMnu Clarence Makwetu.

src: Ikhabhinethi yendlulisa emavi ekudvudvuta umndeni wakaMakwetu kanye nePan Africanist Congress ngekushiywa emhlabeni nguMnu Clarence Makwetu.
tgt: UMnu Makwetu uzokhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe elikhulukazi kanye nasekuzinikeleni kwakhe uqobo embuthweni wokulwela inkululeko kanye nasekusungulweni kweNingizimu Afrika entsha ebuswa ngokwentando yeningi labantu.

src: Mengameli umemetele Kungcwatjwa Ngekwelisiko Lelikhetsekile Letifundza Lekungcwatjwa Kwetikhulu taHulumende kwalelishanhlitiyo lenkhululeko lelasebenta ngekutimisela lokukhulu.
tgt: UMongameli umemezele ukuthi kube Nongcwabo Okhethekile Wesifundazwe Osemthethweni wale ngqalabutho yomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: IKhabhinethi yendlulisa emavi ekudvudvuta umndeni wakaNaidoo ngekushiywa emhlabeni nguMnu Kumaran Naidoo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu emndenini wakwa-Naidoo ngokwedlula emhlabeni kukaMnu Kumaran Naidoo.

src: Naidoo bekaLibamba Lemcondzisi Jikelele weLitiko Lekutfutfukiswa Kwemnotfo.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ubeyiBamba likaMqondisi-Jikelele woMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezomnotho.

src: Phambilini bekasebenta njengeSikhulu Lesikhulu Setetimali seLitiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni.
tgt: Ukhe wasebenza ngaphambilini njengoMphathi Omkhulu Wezezimali woMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni.

src: Umnu Naidoo ufake ligalelo lelikhulu ekulawulweni kwetemnotfo kuTemisebenti yaHulumende.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ube negalelo elikhulukazi ekuphathweni kwezezimali emkhakheni weMisebenzi Kahulumeni.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kubonga kwayo ligalelo lelifakwe nguMnu William Smith, lobekasebenta njengaMabhalane weKhabhinethi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakaliswe ukubonga kwayo maqondana negalelo elifakwe nguMnu William Smith, obesebenza njengeHhovisi likaNobhala weKhabhinethi.

src: Smith watsatsa umhlalaphasi ekupheleni kwaMabasa ngemuva kwekuSebentela Hulumende iminyaka lenge-27.
tgt: UMnu Smith uthathe umhlalaphansi ekupheleni kukaNdasa emva kokusebenzela umkhakha weMisebenzi Kahulumeni iminyaka engama-27.

src: Ikhabhinethi imfisela lokuhle ekutsatseni kwakhe umhlalaphasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imfisela okuhle kodwa kumhlalaphansi wakhe.

src: IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngeMbiko weKhomishini Yekuphenya Ngetinsolo Tekukhwabanisa, Tenkhohlakalo, Kwehluleka Kugcina Emazinga Ekusebenta Ngekwetsembeka nobe Kungasebenti ngalokufanele Ekutsengweni Kwetikhali Tekuvikela (Ikhomishini Yekutsengwa Kwetikhali) lekhishwe nguMengameli lamuhla ekuseni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilunywe indlebe mayelana noMbiko weKhomishana Yophenyo Maqondana Nezinsolo Zokukhwabanisa, Inkohlakalo, Ukungahloniphi noma Ukungahambisi Ngomthetho Ekuthengweni Kobuqhinga Kwempahla Yokuzivikela (iKhomishana Yokuthengwa Kwezikhali) okhishwe nguMongameli ekuseni namuhla.

src: LoMbiko utfole kutsi kute bufakazi bekusebenta ngalokungakafaneli, kudiza, kukhwabanisa nobe inkhohlakalo enchubeni yekutsengwa kwetikhali, SinguHulumende siyayemukela imiphumela yeluphenyo lweKhomishini.
tgt: Umbiko uthole ukuthi abukho ubufakazi bokwenza okungalungile, ukugwazela, ukukhwabanisa noma inkohlakalo enqubweni yokuthwengwa kwezikhali.

src: Sitfolakele simsulwa njengobe besihlale sisho kuyo yonkhe leminyaka kutsi simsulwa kanye nekutsi letikhali tatsengwa ngalokusemtsetfweni.
tgt: Sikhishwe phambili satholakala singenacala njengoba besilokhu sisho eminyakeni eminingi edlule ukuthi kwakungekho ukuphambana nomthetho okwenziwa nanokuthi ukuthengwa kwezikhali kwenziwa ngendlela efanelekile nesemthethweni.

src: Setsemba kutsi lemiphumela italuvala loludzaba leseluchubeke sikhatsi lesidze.
tgt: Siyethemba ukuthi imiphumela izoletha isiphetho kulolu daba oselube yinsakavukela umchilo wesidwaba isikhathi eside.

src: Sijoyina Mengameli Zuma ekubongeni Lijaji Willie Seriti neLijaji Thekiso Musi, bonkhe bofakazi, kufaka ekhatsi Mengameli waphambilini Thabo Mbeki, baholi bebufakazi, emacembu etemtsetfo, tisebenti kanye nalabo labafake ligalelo ekwenteni umsebenti waleKhomishini kutsi ube yimphumelelo.
tgt: Sihlanganyela noMongameli uZuma ekubongeni iJaji u-Willie Seriti kanye neJaji uThekiso Musi, bonke ofakazi, kubandakanya noMongameli waphambilini uThabo Mbeki, abaholi bobufakazi, amathimba ezomthetho, abasebenzi kanye nalabo ababe negalelo ekwenzeni umsebenzi weKhomishana ube yimpumelelo.

src: Kubekwa EtikhundleniKutawuhlolwa ticu tabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni kubuye futsi kwentiwe nekucinisekiswa lokufanele.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikeziwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Kufezekiswa Kwetinhlelo Tahulumende Letibalulekile.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zikahulumeni Ezisemqoka.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuvakasha kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma Kwembuso kwekuya e-Islamic Republic of Iran, lokukhulisa ngemandla budlelwane betemnotfo nekuhwebelana emkhatsini walamave omabili, ngekusayina tivumelwane letinyenti kanye nekutinikela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamukela uhambo lukaMongameli u-Jacob Zuma lokuHambela Kombuso ezweni lase-Islamic Republic of Iran, oludlondlobalisa ubudlelwano bezomnotho kanye nezokuhwebelana phakathi kwawo womabili lawa mazwe, ngokucikicwa kwezivumelwano ezihlukahlukene kanye nezibophezelo.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma naMengameli Hasan Rouhani bacinise kubambisana emikhakheni yetekuhwebelana, temfundvo nekutfutfukiswa kwemakhono isayensi netebucwepheshe, emandla agezi, kufaka ekhatsi kuhlolisiswa kwegesi yemakhemikhala aphethroli nemakhono ekuwuhluta tekulima kumbiwa kwetimbiwa kanye nekuzuza kwakhiwa kwesakhiwonchanti netitfutsi timali, kubhanga nemshwalensi kanye netekuvakasha.
tgt: UMongameli u-Jacob Zuma kanye noMongameli u-Hasan Rouhani bakuqinisile ukusebenza ngokubambisana emikhakheni yezokuhwebelana, ezemfundo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ezesayensi kanye nobuchwepheshe ezamandla, kubandakanya nokuhlolwa kwegesi yamakhemikhali kaphethiloli ongakahluzwa kanye namandla okukwazi ukuhluza ezolimo ezezimayini kanye nokuhlomula kwezezimbiwa phansi ezokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda kanye nezokuthutha ezezimali, ezokubhanga kanye nezemishwalense kanye nezokuvakasha.

src: Konkhe loku kufaka sandla ekufezekisweni kweLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP).Mayelana netemave emhlaba, labaholi lababili bavumelene kutsi kuciniswe simemo sekulungisa Mhlabuhlangene (i-UN) ikakhulu Umkhandlu Wekuvikela we-UN, ngekuya kwetimfuno temave lasatfutfuka.
tgt: Konke lokhu kunegalelo ekuqalisweni kokusebenza koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).Ngasohlangothini lwamazwe omhlaba, abaholi ababili bavumile ukuqinisa ikhwela elihlatshwayo lokuguqulwa kweNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene (i-UN) ikakhulukazi Umkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka weNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene, ngokubhekelela izimfuno zamazwe asathuthuka.

src: Lemiphumela icinise Kuvakasha Ngekwemsebenti kwaMengameli e-United Arab Emirates (e-UAE) lapho khona omabili lamave avusetele kutinikela kwawo ekuhlanganiseni nasekuphakamiseni budlelwanobubili emkhatsini walamave omabili, ikakhulu kutekuhwebelana, imikhakha yelutjalomali neyemnotfo kutsi ibe yelubanjiswano lolubalulekile lolukhulu.
tgt: Le miphumela iqinise kabusha Uhambo Lokusebenza lukaMongameli oluya ezweni lase-United Arab Emirates (i-UAE) lapho yomibili le mibuso ivuselele isibophezelo sayo maqondana nokuhlanganiswa kanye nokukhushulwa kobudlelwano obumbaxambili, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni yezokuhwebelana, ezokutshalwa kwezimali kanye neyezomnotho ukuba bube ukubambisana okubanzi okunobuqhinga.

src: Loku kwakhele etukweKuvakasha Kwembuso kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma ngeLweti nga-2011 lokwaholela ekusungulweni kweKhomishini Lehlangene Ye-SA-UAE lokwasheshisa ngalokuphelele umdlandla nemandla ekuhwebelana emkhatsini walamave omabili kusuka kutigidzigidzi leti-R13 nga-2011 kuya kutigidzigidzi letinge-R27 nga-2015.INingizimu Afrika kanye ne-UAE baphindze bavuma kukhulisa kubambisana kwabo kute basebentise ematfuba lakuMnotfo waseLwandle, kute kukhutsatwe kutsengiswa kulamanye emave imikhicito letilimo yaseNingizimu Afrika, imikhicito leyakhiwe ikakhulu tintfo tetekuvikela nelubanjiswano.
tgt: Lokhu kwakhelwe ohambweni lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma Lokuhambela Kombuso ngoLwezi wezi-2011 olwabonakalisa ukusungulwa kweKhomishana Ehlanganyelwe ye-SA-UAE eyadlondlobalisa umgqigqo ophelele wezokuhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe omabili kusukela ezigidini eziyi-13 zamarandi ngowezi-2011 kuya ezigidini ezingama-27 zamarandi ngowezi-2015.INingizimu Afrika kanye ne-UAE baphinde bavumelana ukuthi bazokwandisa ukusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze basebenzise amathub ngendlela efunwa yibona Kwezomnotho Wasolwandle, ukukhulisa ukuhanjiswa emazweni angaphandle kwemikhiqizo yezolimo yaseNingizimu Afrika, imikhiqizo ekhiqiziwe ikakhulukazi ukuthengwa kwezinto zezokuzivikela kanye namaxhama okubambisana.

src: Lokuvakasha kuphindze kwakhutsata emandla ekwakha sakhiwonchanti saseNingizimu Afrika sacondza ematfuba etinkampani taseNingizimu Afrika ekukhangiseni kwaseDubai lokubitwe ngekutsi pheceleti, EXPO 2020 in Dubai, kanye nekubambisana emkhakheni wetekuthula, tekuvikela kanye nekusimama.
tgt: Lolu hambo luphinde lwakhulisa amandla iNingizimu Afrika enawo ukwakha ingqalasizinda esophe amathuba azotholwa yizinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika embukisweni i-EXPO 2020 ozobe ubanjelwe eDubai, kanjalo nokusebenza ngokubambisana emkhakheni wezoxolo, ukuvikeleka kanye nozinzo.

src: IKhabhinethi itemukele tinyatselo leticatsa letihlelwe yiNdvuna yeTemidlalo Nekukhibika Fikile Mbalula tekwakha kabusha temidlalo nekukhibika letibhidlikile naletibandlula ngemandla ngekusebentisa Ishatha Yetingucuko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamukelile izinyathelo eziqinile ezibekwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezemidlalo Nokungcebeleka uFikile Mbalula ukubumba kabusha ukubukeka kwesimo sezemidlalo nokungcebeleka esiqhekekile nesibandlululayo ngendlela ejulile esebenzisa uMqulu waso Woguquko.

src: Loku kutawusheshisa tingucuko tekutsi kube khona inchubo yetemidlalo lebumbene lesime etukwemitsetfomgomo yentsandvo yelinyenti, kulingana, kubekwa kwetintfo ebaleni, kumelelwa kwabo bonkhe bantfu, kufinyelela nekukhula kwemazinga ekuhlanganyela ngekuhambisana netimfuno teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.
tgt: Lokhu kuzodlondlobalisa uguquko maqondana nohlelo lwezemidlalo olubumbene olusekelwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yentando yeningi labantu, ukulingana, ukusebenzela obala, ukumeleleka kwabantu ngokwehlukahlukana kwabo, ukufinyeleleka kanye nokubamba iqhaza okukhuphukile ngokuhambelana nezinjongo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela mcombelelo lowetfulwe ngematiko lehlukene lonemibiko lemikhulu lechaza inchubekela embili leyentiwe ekwenteni timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi tibe ncono.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela izinkulumo zamavoti esabiwomali ezethulwa yiminyango eyehlukene ezihambisana nemibiko ebanzi eqhakambisa inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe maqondana nokwenziwa ngcono kwezimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Loku kukhombisa kufezekiswa kweLuhlakamsebenti Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini lolusisondzeta dvutane nekuzuza Umbononchanti 2030 weLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.
tgt: Lokhu kubonisa ukuqaliswa ukusebenza koHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi olusisondeza eduzane nokufezekiswa koMbono wezi-2030 woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi balandzele inkulumomphikiswano yomcombelelo etinkhundleni tekuchumana tebetindzaba letinyenti letehlukene kute bavisise kancono Luhlelo lwaHulumende lweKusebenta IKhabhinethi icela kutsi kube nekutinikela lokuchubekako kute kutsi kube netingucuko letingito tetindzawo tekusebenta letihambisana naloko lokutfolwe Ngumbiko Wemnyaka We-16 Wekhomishini Yetekucashwa Ngekulingana yabo bonkhe bacashi lababekiwe lowetfulwa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi “Tingucuko tibalulekile”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba balandelele izinkulumo zokwabiwa kwezimali ezinkundleni zabenzindaba ezinhlobonhlobo ukuze baqonde kangcono ngoHlelo Lokusebenza lukaHulumeni.

src: Lombiko usita hulumende kutsi avisise simo setekucashwa ngekulingana kulelive kanye nenchubekela embili yakho ekuguculeni simo sasemsebentini ngemnyaka-2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa ukuba kube khona ukuzibophezela okuqhubekayo ukuze kuvikelwe uguquko olunengqondo lwendawo yokusebenzela ngokubhekelela imiphumela evela Embikweni Wonyaka weKhomishana ye-16 Yokuqashwa Kwabantu Ngokulingana wabo bonke abaqashi abaqokiwe owethulwa ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Uguquko lubalulekile”.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele Litiko Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu ekwakhiweni kwetindlu letitigidzi leti-4, 3 kanye nematfuba ekuba netindlu kusukela kwaba khona intsandvo yelinyenti.
tgt: Umbiko usiza uhulumeni ukuba aqonde isimo sokuqashwa kwabantu ngokulingana ezweni kanye nenqubekelaphambili yaso ekuguqulweni kwendawo yokusebenzela onyakeni wezi-2015.

src: Lamatfuba afaka ekhatsi-2, 806 235 wetindlu letelekelelwa ngalokuphelele (tindlu te-BNG), 121 784 wetindlu tetenhlalo/tekurentwa, 6329 weteLuhlelo Lwekwelekelelwa Kwangamunye Loluchumene Netimali kanye nemasayithi latfola tinsita la-986 608.Leligcatsi lelingumlandvo selwente kutsi kube neluphahla lwebantfu labangetelulu kwalabatigidzi letinge-20 futsi-ke kugubha umkhosi walokuzuza lelitiko seletfule umkhankhaso wavelonkhe wekukhombisa timphumelelo talelive.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu ngokwakhiwa kwezindlu eziyizigidi eziwu-4, 3 kanye namathuba okwakhiwa kwenzindlu kusukela kwafika umbuso wentando yeningi labantu.

src: Lokwetfulwa kwavelonkhe kwentiwe eCOSMO City, lomunye wemiklamo lehlanganisiwe lebekwa embili lekhona kulo lonkhe lelive nawo logubha umkhosi weminyaka lelishumi solo waba khona.
tgt: Lawa mathuba abandakanya izindlu ezixhaswe ngokuphelele eziyizi-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zomphakathi/eziqashisayo eziyizi-121 784, izi-6329 zoHlelo Lokuxhaswa Komuntu Ngamunye Oluxhunywe Kwezezimali kanye neziza zokwakha ezinezinsizakalo eziyizi-986 608.Leli banga eliyingqophamlando eselihanjiwe selihlinzeke umpheme kubantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kanti-ke ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo umnyango sewethule umkhankaso kazwelonke wokudweba isithombe sempumelelo yezwe lakithi.

src: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekufaka sandla kwabo, kutinikela kanye nekusebenta ngekutikhandla ekucinisekiseni kutsi siyabuyiswa sitfunti sebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labadzingako, ngekuhlaliswa kwebantfu.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kukazwelonke kubanjelwe e-COSMO City, okungomunye wemiklamo yezindlu edidiyelwe eseqhulwini ezweni lonkana nawo ogubha iminyaka eyishumi ukhona.

src: IKhabhinethi iyamncoma Mabhalane Jikelele waMhlabuhlangane ngekubamba Umkhosi Losezingeni Lelisetulu Kakhulu Wekusayinwa kweSivumelwane saseParis, lesemukelwa ngemave la-176 ngeNgongoni 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngegalelo labo, ukuzimisela kanye nokusebenza kanzima ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi isithunzi sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaswele siyabuyiselwa ngezinhlelo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu.

src: Kusayinwa kwaleSivumelwano saseParis kwenta sinyatselo sekucala sekuphumelelisa lesitawukhomba indlela imitamo yemave emahlaba yekunciphisa kubhunyiswa kwemimoya lengcolile lengcolisa umoya lesiwuphefumulako kanye nekuhlangabetana nato tonkhe tinsayeya letivetwa kugucuka kwesimo selitulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income uNobhala-Jikelele weNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangane ngokuhlanganisa Umcimbi Osezingeni Eliphezulu Wokucikicwa Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris, esamukelwa ngamazwe ayi-176 ngoZibandlela wezi-2015.

src: IKhabhinethi ilindzele kuphetfwa kwetinchubo tekucinisekiswa kwetekuhlala letifanele, ngubo bonkhe, kute ivumele sikhatsi lesifanele sekutsi leSivumelwane saseParis sifezekiswe ngalokuphelele nga-2020.
tgt: Ukucikicwa Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris kuwuphawu lwesinyathelo sokuqala ekuqalisweni kokusebenza kwaso okuzohola imizamo yamazwe omhlaba ukunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwezintuthu ezingcolisa umoya kanye nokuhlangabezana nazo zonke izinselele eziphonswe ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela futsi nekutsi Litiko Letemvelo libambisene neLitilo Letekuvakasha ekuhlanganiseni emalabhorekhthri ekwetfula labitwa ngekutsi ngemaLebhu Etitjalo netilwane Letehlukahlukene: Kukhuliswa kwemnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika ngemcebo wetitjalo netilwane” kusukela mhla ti-10 Mabasa kuya kumhla ti-13 Inkhwekhweti 2016.Inhloso kuzuza emandla emnotfo wetitjalo netilwane taseNingizimu Afrika letehlukahlukene lokubekwe ngalokucacile kuluhlaka Lwendlelalisu Yemnotfo Wetitjalo Netilwane Letehlukahlune Lwavelonkhe leyavunywa yiKhabhinethi ngaKholwane 2015 kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isilangazelele isiphetho sezinqubo zezigunyazo zalapha ezweni ngaphakathi ezihlukahlukene, yibo bonke abantu, ukuvumela ukuqaliswa ngesikhathi kokusebenza ngokuphelele Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris ngowezi-2020.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume Luhlelo Lwekusebenta Lwenchubomgomo Yetimboni (i-IPAP) lwanga-2016/17 – 2018/19, loluyinsika yeLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica lwaMengameli futsi lufaka sandla ekufezekisweni kweLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqaphela ukuthi uMnyango Wezemvelo usubambisene noMnyango Wezokuvakasha ekuhlanganiseni amalebhu okuhanjiswa kwezinsizakalo abizwa ngokuthi yi-“Biodiversity Lab: Ukukhulisa igalelo lezomnotho lemithombo yezemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika” kusukela mhla ziyi-10 kuMbasa kuya mhla ziyi-13 kuNhlaba 2016.Inhloso ukufezekisa amandla ezomnotho emvelo enothile yaseNingizimu Afrika eyingxubevange aveziwe ohlakeni lokuqala lweQhinga Likazwelonke Lezomnotho Yezemvelo Eyingxubevange olwagunyazwa yiKhabhinethi ngoNtulikazi wezi-2015 ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukubamba iqhaza kulona.

src: Loku ngumnyaka wesiphohlongo kuphindzeka kuphumelela kwetinhlelo tahulumende tekutfutfukisa timbono lokwakhela ekuzuzeni, tinkhundla tenchubomgomo kanye netinhlelo tekuphindzeka lokwendlulile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlelo Lokusebenza Lwenqubomgomo Yezimboni (i-IPAP) lowezi-2016/17 – 2018/19, oluyinsika eqavile yoHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye lukaMongameli futhi olunegalelo maqondana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: I-IPAP 2016/17 ifuna kuzuza inchubomgomo yetimboni lenemphumela losezingeni leliphakeme etimeni temnotfo letimatima.
tgt: Lesi yisibuyekezo sonyaka wesishiyagalombili sezinhlelo eziyimpumelelo zezimboni zikahulumeni esakhela ezinzuzweni, izithangami zezinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo zezibuyekezo ezidlulile.

src: Loku kufaka ekhatsi imiphumela yekwehla kwemandla emali emhlabeni wonkhe lokuchubekako kanye nesomiso lesibi kabi naletinye tintfo tetenhlalo letisikhinyabeto.
tgt: I-IPAP yowezi-2016/17 ifuna ukuzuza inqubomgomo yezezimboni enomthelela ophezulu ezimweni ezinzima zezomnotho.

src: Lokuzuziwe emnyakeni lophelile kufaka ekhatsi imisebenti levikelwe lelinganiselwa kule-67 000 kanye nekuvetwa kwemisebenti lemisha lenesitfunti lengalinganiselwa kule-7 000 emikhakheni yeTimphahla, yeMayadi Etikhumba kanye neyeTicatfulo.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya imithelela eqhubekayo yokuwohloka kwamandla omnotho emhlabeni wonke kubandakanya nesimo esimazonzo embonini yezensimbi nezimbiwaphansi kanjalo nesomiso esibi kakhulu kanye nezinye izingqinamba ezinkulu ezikhona ezweni lakithi ngaphakathi.

src: Umkhakha lomncane wekwendlulisa imikhicito letilimo nguwona mkhakha locashe bantfu labanengi kwendlula yonkhe imikhakha yasekhaya lekhicitako, uniketa imisebenti lelinganiselwa kule-216 090 nga-2015 nakucatsaniswa kule-208 822 nga-2014.
tgt: Izimpumelelo zangonyaka odlule zibandakanya ukuphephiswa kwemisebenzi ebalelwa ezi-67 000 kanye nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi eqotho emisha sha eyizi-7 000 emkhakheni Wezendwangu, Izimpahla Zesikhumba kanye Nezicathulo.

src: Lungetulu kwegidzi letinge-R600 telutjalomali lolwaba khona nge-2015/16, lokwakha sisekelo sekucinisa kutfutfuka kwemabhizinisi lapho khona bekugcilwe emimangweni yasemaphandleni.
tgt: Umkhakhana ongaphansi kwezokukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo ungomunye wemikhakha emikhulukazi lapha ezweni yezokukhiqiza ngokuqasha abantu, ngokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi elinganiselwa ezi-216 090 ngowezi-2015 uma kuqhathaniswa nezi-208 822 ngowezi-2014.

src: IKhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlakamsebenti Lwekugcina Loluhlanganisiwe Lwekutfutfukisa Tindzawo Tasemadolobheni kanye neLuhlelo Lwekufezekisa lwanga-2016/19.
tgt: Izigidi ezingaphezu kwama-600 zamarandi zotshalomali ezihehekile ngowezi-2015/16, ezindlale isisekelo sokuqinisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi ngokugxila kakhulu emiphakathini yasezindaweni ezisemakhaya.

src: Umphumela sewuwonkhe waloLuhlakamsebenti Lwekugcina Loluhlanganisiwe Lwekutfutfikisa Tindzawo Tasemadolobheni kutfutfukiswa kwendzawo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlaka Lokusebenza Lokugcina Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Ezisemadolobheni Ezididiyelwe kanye Nohlelo Lokuqaliswa Ukusebenza lowezi-2016/19.

src: Loku kwenta sivumelwane setebhizinisi lesisha semadolobhakati aseNingizimu Afrika, lokutawucondzisa kukhula kwetindzawo tasemadolobheni tibe yimodeli yekukhula lokungenamkhawulo nemadolobha lahleleke kahle futsi lasondzelene nalachunyaniswako, laphephile, lanemitfombolusito kanye naletindzawo lekahle tekusebenta nekuhlala kuwo.
tgt: Umphumela ophelele woHlaka Lokusebenza Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Ezisemadolobheni Ezididiyelwe ukuguqulwa kokuklaywa kwemingcele yedolobha.

src: Loku kuphendvula ticondziso teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe lwekwakha inchumomgomo yekutfutfukisa tindzawo tasemadolobheni letawucinisekisa kuhlelwa ngendlela lefanele, kwakhiwa kwetakhowonchanti nekulawulwa kwato kute tesekele kukhula tibuye futsi tikhulule emandla emnotfo wemadolobhakati nemadolobha etfu.
tgt: Lokhu kuwuphawu lesivumelwano esisha samadolobha kanye namadolobhana amancane aseNingizimu Afrika, esizoqhubezela phambili ukukhula kwezindawo ezisemadolobheni siziqhubekisele ohlakeni lokukhula okuqinile kwamadolobha namadolobhana amancane ahlangene, axhumene futhi adidiyelwe, aphephile, anezinsiza ezanele futhi ayizindawo ezinhle zokusebenza kanye nokuhlala kuzo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende Inchubomgomo Yavelonkhe Yetekutfutfukisa Imisebenti – Kwakha Inchubo Yetinsita Yekutfutfukisa Imisebenti Lehlanganisiwe nalephumelelako yaseNingizimu Afrika, kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngayo.
tgt: Lokhu kuphendula emyalelweni woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe wokuthi kusungulwe inqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo ezisemadolobheni ezoqinisekisa ukuhlela okufanelekile, utshalomali lwezingqalasizinda kanye nokuphathwa kwalo ukuze kwesekwe ukukhula kanye nokuthukulula amandla ezomnotho amadolobha kanye namadolobhana amancane ethu.

src: Loluhlaka lweNchubomgomo naselufezekisiwe lutawuniketa indlela luchunyanisiwe yekubukana netinsita tekutfutfukiswa kwemisebenti lenguyonayona yetakhamuti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa koHlaka lweNqubomgomo Yezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi Kazwelonke – Ukwakha Uhlelo Lwezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi Oluyimpumelelo Noludidiyelwe lwaseNingizimu Afrika, eMqulwini Kahulumeni ukuze kutholwe imibono yomphakathi.

src: Loku kutawubenta kutsi bakwati kukhetsa kahle tinhlobo temisebenti kute kutsi batfole imisebenti, bafake sandla emmangweni babuye futsi bakhe umnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Uhlaka lweNqubomgomo uma seluqalisiwe ukusebenza luzohlinzeka ngendlela yokusebenza ehlanganisiwe yezinsizakalo zokuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha yemisebenzi eziseqophelweni eliphezulu zazo zonke izakhamuzi.

src: Luphiko Lwetekutfutfukisa Imisebenti ludlala indzima lebalulekile ekusiteni timakethe tetisebenti kutsi tisebente kanye nekutsi tinchubo temfundvo tizuze imigomo yato.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza izakhamuzi zikwazi ukukhetha imikhakha yemisebenzi ngomqondo ophusile ukuze zikwazi ukuqashwa, zibe negalelo emphakathini futhi zakhe umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Loku kufaka sandla ekutsini kuzuzwe tincomo teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe tekukhutsata kukhula kwemnotfo nekucashwa, kucondzaniswe tisebenti nemisebenti kanye nekukhulisa lizinga lekutfutfukiswa kwemakhono kanye nelinani letitjudeni tasemanyuvesi letiphotfulile.
tgt: Izinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi zidlala indima esemqoka ekusizeni umsebenzi wezimakethe zabasebenzi kanye nezinhlelo zezemfundo zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinjongo zazo.

src: IKhabhinethi yatiswa ngekufezekiswa kweNchubo Yekuhlola Yavelonkhe yabuye futsi yavuma Umbiko wemnyaka wa-2014/15 kanye neLuhlelo Lwekuhlola Lwavelonkhe lwa-2016/17 to 2018/19, njengencenye yemtamo wekwenta kancono kwetfulwa kwetinsita,Inchubo Yekuhlola Yavelonkhe ivela kuLuhlakamsebenti Lwenchubomgomo Yekuhlola Lwavelonkhe lolucinisekisa kutsi bufakazi lobungubobabona nalobungavunicala bekuhlola buyayakwa enchubeni yekuhlela, yelwabiwomali, ekwentiweni kancono kwenhlangano bubuye futsi bulinganisele kulawula kute kwentiwe kancono kusebenta.
tgt: Lokhu kunegalelo maqondana nokufezekiswa kwezincomo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe zokugqugquzela ukukhula komnotho kanye nokuqashwa kwabantu, ukuqondaniswa kwabasebenzi abaqashiwe nemisebenzi yabo kanye nokwandisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nesibalo sabantu abaneziqu zemfundo yasenyuvesi.

src: Sekuphetfwe kuhlola lokunge-47 nobe kusatawentiwa, lokufaka ekhatsi lusetjentisomali lwahulumende lolutigidzigidzi letinge-Kuvunywe imibiko yekuhlola le-15 kanye nale-12 leyetfulwe kuKhabhinethi kute kube ngulamuhla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza Kohlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke futhi lagunyaza umbiko Wonyaka wezi-2014/15 kanye Nohlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke lesihlanu lowezi-2016/17 kuya kowezi-2018/19, njengengxenye yombhidlango wokwenza ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo-ngqangi.

src: Tinhlelo le-14 tekutfutfukisa tiyafezekiswa kwamanje futsi inchubekela embili yato ikhombisa tingucuko letinkhulu letibonakalako, letitawenabisa umphumela.
tgt: Uhlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke lususelwa oHlakeni Lokusebenza leNqubomgomo Yokulinganisa Kazwelonke oluqinisekisa ukuthi ubufakazi obuqotho nobunenjongo obuvela ekulinganisweni buyafakwa ezinhlelweni zokuhlela, ukwabiwa kwezimali, ukwenziwa ngcono kwezinhlangano, ukubuyekezwa kwezinqubomgomo, kanjalo nasezinhlelweni eziqhubekayo kanye nokuphathwa kwemiklamo ukuze kwenziwe ngcono ukusebenza.

src: IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngemiphumela yabuye futsi yavuma netincomo ngenhloso yekukhulisa imiphumela ngekufezekiswa kweMkakha Wetenhlalo Weluhlelo Lwemisebenti Yahulumende Leyengetiwe (i-EPWP-SS).Loluhlelo ludlala indzima lenkhulu kutekuvikela kutenhlalo kwebantfu labadzala labangaguli ndzawo labangasebenti, ngekutsi bafakwe emisebentini lekhicitako nekutsi batfole umholombhasha welizinga lelisemkhatsini we-R1 517.
tgt: Izilinganiso ezingama-47 seziphothuliwe noma zisaqhutshwa, ezikhava izigidigidi ezingama-75 zamarandi ezindleko zikahulumeni.

src: IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngalokutfoliwe yabuye futsi yemukela netincomo tekuhlolwa kwedizayini nekufezekiswa kweSelekelelo Sekutfutfukisa Kuhlaliswa Etindzaweni Tasemadolobheni kanye neLuhlelo Lwekwenta Kancono.
tgt: Izinhlelo zokwenza ngcono eziyi-14 ziyaqaliswa ukusebenza kanti futhi inqubekelaphambili maqondana nazo ikhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu kakhulu, ukukhulisa umthelela wazo.

src: Loku lokutfoliwe kwesekela kugcinwa kweSelekelelo Sekutfutfukisa Kuhlaliswa Etindzaweni Tasemadolobheni njengesibonelelo sekugcwalisela lesisita ngetimali umbono lomkhulu wekuhlaliswa lokuchubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo kute kutsi kuzuze bantfu labaphuyile kanye nemakhaya latfola imali lengenako lesezingeni lelisemkhatsini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yokulinganisa kanye nezincomo ezigunyaziwe ngenhloso yokwandisa umthelela osukela ekuqalisweni ukusebenza Kohlelo Lemisebenzi Yomphakathi Eyandisiwe Yomkhakha Wezenhlalo (i-EPWP-SS).Lolu Hlelo ludlala indima esemqoka yokuvikelwa kwesimo senhlalo yabantu abantu abangakhubazeke ndawo abangasebenzi, kokubadonsela emsebenzini onomkhiqizo bese bethola umthobanhlizinyo njalo ngenyanga olinganiselwa esambeni se-R1 517.

src: Loku kubalulekile ekuzuzeni imigomo lehlosiwe levela kuLuhlakamsebenti Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini kuvetwa kwematfuba etindlu leti-1 495 etindzaweni tekuhlala letingutonatona nga-2019.
tgt: Iningi lezinhlelo zomkhakha wezenhlalo lihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhethekile emiphakathini entekenteke nehluphekayo.

src: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile umbiko weKufezekiswa neKuhlolwa Kwemphumela weTebucwepheshe neTisebenti teLuhlelo lweTimboni, kuphendvula kwebaphatsi kulombiko kanye neluhlelo lwekwenta kancono lolungeniswe Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netimboni.
tgt: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngesivinini esikhulu phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibili, kusukela ezinhlelweni ezi-5 kuya ezinhlelweni ezingama-22 okuholele kulo mkhakha ukuba ufezekise amathuba emisebenzi ayizi-175 769 esigabeni sokuqala kanye namathuba emisebenzi ayizi-866 246 esigabeni sesibili, nokungaphezulu kakhulu kobekusophiwe okungamathuba emisebenzi ayizi-750 000.Izincomo zigxile ekwenzeni ngcono ukuqaliswa kokusebenza ukuze kuncishiswe ukungasebenzi ngendlela egculisayo ekuthathweni kwezinqumo, ukuqaliswa ukusebenza (izinkokhelo zemithobanhliziyo) kanye nokuhlinzekwa ngokuqeqesha, kanjalo nokuxhumanisa.

src: Loluhlelo lwetfulwa Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netimboni nga-1992 kucinisa kutfutfukiswa kwemakhono kutesayensi, tebunjinela netebucwepheshe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela kanye nezincomo ezigunyaziwe zedizayini kanye nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kokulinganiswa Kwesabelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ezisemadolobheni kanye Nohlelo Lokwenziwa Ngcono kwaso.

src: Lufaka sandla ekwakhekeni kwematfuba emisebenti ngekutsi lukhicita kufika kwenabacwaningi labanelikhono lelisezingeni lelisetulu kanye nebaphatsi betebucwepheshe betimboni kanye nekutfutfukisa kucudzelana kwetinhlangano temabhazinisi letihlanganyelako.
tgt: Imiphumela yeseka ukugcinwa kweSabelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ezisemadolobheni njengesabelo sokunezezela esikhokhela umqondo ovulekile wokuhlaliswa kwabantu okuqhubekayo nokulinganayo ukuze kuhlomule abantu abahluphekayo kanye namakhaya anemali engenayo engenkulu kakhulu.

src: LoLuhlelo lungilo, lubalulekile futsi luyincenye leyenele yekwesekela lokusha lokuniketa lokulingana nemali ngekwekutfutfukiswa kwetebucwepheshe nekutfutfukisa tisebenti kanye nemakhono laphatselene netimboni.
tgt: Lokhu kuwusizo kakhulu ekufezekiseni izinjongo zoHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwamathuba okwakhiwa kwezindlu eziyisigidi esi-1 495 ezindaweni zokuhlala eziseqophelweni eliphezulu ngowezi-2019.

src: IKhabhinethi yatiswa ngalokutfolwe nguMbiko Welicembu Lekusebenta Letindvuna lebeluhlola tinsolo ‘tikhundla tabothishela letitsengiswako’ lokufaka ekhatsi bantfu labatimele, tinhlangano tabothishela kanye netikhulu teMatiko Etemfundvo Etifundza letitsite.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze umbiko maqondana Nokuqaliswa Ukusebenza kanye Nokulinganiswa Komthelela Wezobuchwepheshe kanye Nezindaba Zabasebenzi zoHlelo Lwezezimboni, impendulo yabaphathi embikweni kanye nohlelo lokwenza ngcono oluthunyelwe nguMnyango Wezokuhwebelana kanye Nezezimboni.

src: IKhabhinethi itivumile tincomo tekubukana naloko lokutfoliwe ngalokuhlelekile nangekwesekela.
tgt: Lolu Hlelo lwethulwa nguMnyango Wezohwebo kanye Nezezimboni ngowe-1992 ukuze kuqiniswe ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kwezesayensi, ezobunjiniyela kanye nezobuchwepheshe.

src: Embikweni wayo wekugcina leLicembu Lekusebenta Letindvuna liniketa luhlatiyo lwendzima ledlalwe ngubo bonkhe labatsintsekako kulenchubo yekukhetsa nekufuna bothishela.
tgt: Lunegalelo ekusungulweni kwamathuba emisebenzi ngokukhiqiza inqwaba yabacwaningi abanamakhono aphezulu kanye nabaphathi bezobuchwepheshe embonini kanye nokwenza ngcono ubuqhudelwano bezinhlangano zamabhizinisi ezibambe iqhaza.

src: Iphindze futsi yemukela tinkinga letinkhulu kulenchubo lekhona kwamanje yekubeka bothishela etikhundleni emkhakheni wetemfundvo lesisekelo libuye futsi libeke tincomo tekusita Litiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo kanye nemkhakha wetemfundvo lesisekelo jikelele kute kulungiswe letinsayeya letitfoliwe.
tgt: Uhlelo luyingxenye esemthethweni, esemqoka futhi egculisayo yokweseka okuqanjwe kabusha okunikezela ngalokho okuyifanele ngempela imali yakho kukhona kokubili ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezindaba zabasebenzi kanye namakhono ahlobene nezezimboni.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kwetfulwa ePhalamende Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Temahlatsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yoMbiko Wethimba loNgqongqoshe Lokwenziwa Komsebenzi wokuphenya ngezinsolo ‘zokuthengiswa kwezikhala zemisebenzi yothisha’ ezibandakanya abantu abathile, izinyunyana zothisha kanye nezikhulu zeMinyango ethile Yezemfundo Yezifundazwe.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo Wetemahlatsi Wavelonkhe, 1998 (Umtsetfo 84 wa-1998).Kufesekiswa kwaletichibelo kutawenta kancono kulawulwa kwemahlatsi lokuchubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo kubuye futsi kukhutsate kuhlanganyela kwemacembu lasengotini, laphila ngetemahlatsi, kuMkandlu Wekweluleka Ngetemahlatsi Wavelonkhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze izincomo zokubhekana ngendlela enohlelo neqondiswe ngqo emiphumeleni.

src: Baholi betenkholo kanye nebaholi betinhlangano temmango batawujoyina hulumende ekuthantazeleni kuhlanganiswa lokuchubekako kwentsandvo yelinyenti, kubumbana kwavelonkhe, kuchumana kwemimango yetenhlalo kanye neLukhetfo Lwahulumende Wendzawo lolunekuthula naloluyimphumelelo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezamahlathi Kazwelonke, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwezichibiyelo kuzokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa kwezamahlathi okuqinile futhi kuphinde kugqugquzele ukubamba iqhaza kwamaqempu abantu abantekenteke, abathembele emahlathini ukuze bakwazi ukuphila, eMkhandlwini Wezokululeka Ngezamahlathi Kazwelonke.

src: IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngeluhlelo lweLitiko Letebuciko Nemasiko kutsi litawungenisa Inyanga Ye-Afrika ngeNkhwekhweti-2016 ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kwakha i-Afrika Lencono neMhlaba Loncono” njengencenye yekugubha umkhosi kwalelive kugujelwa kusungulwa kweNhlangano Yekuhlanga kwe-Afrika (i-OAU), manje leseyibitwa ngekutsi Bunye Be-Afrika (i-AU) kanye nemsebenti leyiwentile.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzohambela umcimbi wokugcotshwa kanye nokufungiswa kukaMongameli wase-Uganda u-Yoweri Museveni eKampala ngomhla ziyi-12 Nhlaba 2016.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawetfula Inyanga Ye-Afrika ngeLilanga Lekuthantaza Lavelonkhe mhla tinge-29 Mabasa 2016.Nga-2016 Inyanga ye-Afrika itawugcila kubomake kanye nemitamo yekutfutfukisa lusha, sibe sikhumbula umnyaka we-60 weKushuca kwaBomake kanye nemnyaka we-40 weTibhelu Telusha taseSoweto.
tgt: Lolu hambo oluphumayo luzophinde luqinise ubudlelwano obumbaxambili phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bacelwa kutsi bahlanganyele eluhlelweni lwemikhakhaminyenti lolufaka ekhatsi imisebenti leminengi lefaka ekhatsi tebuciko lobubukwako, itiyetha, umculo, tifundvo kanye netingcungcutsela tetemfundvo kanye nemgubho we-10 wase-Afrika wekugubha Sikhwama Semagugu Emhlaba.
tgt: UMongameli u-Jacob Zuma uzokwengamela Usuku Lukazwelonke Lomkhuleko ozobanjelwa Ezinkundleni Zemidlalo i-ABSA e-Durban mhla zingama-29 Mbasa 2016.

src: Inyanga Ye-Afrika iyinkhundla yekuchumana nekutinikela kabusha kwetfu kuMcondvo weKubumbana kwe-Afrika kanye neKuncoba Kwe-Afrika ekuhlanganiseni bantfu balalelivekati.
tgt: Abaholi bezenkolo kanye nabaholi bezinhlangano zomphakathi bazohlanganyela nohulumeni ekukhulekeleni okunye ukuqiniswa kombuso wentando yeningi labantu, ubumbano lukazwelonke, ukubumbana komphakathi kanjalo Nokhetho Lohulumeni Bezindawo lowezi-2016 oluyimpumelelo nolunokuthula.

src: Mhla tinge-20 Inkhekhweti 2016 hulumende utawuhola kugujwa kwemkhosi wavelonkhe weminyakalikhulu weNyuvesi yaseFort Hare kuluphiko loluse-Alice eMphumalanga Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nezinhlelo zoMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko zokusingatha Inyanga ye-Afrika ngoNhlaba 2016 ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika Engcono kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono” njengengxenye yemigubho yezwekazi yokusungulwa kweNhlangano Yobumbano lwase-Afrika (i-OAU), manje esiyaziwa ngokuthi Ubumbano lwaseAfrika (i-African Union) kanye nomsebenzi esiwenzile.

src: Mayelana nekulungiselela lomgubho lomkhulu, Mengameli Jacob Zuma sewusungule Likomidi LeTindvuna (i-IMC) kutsi lihlele libuye futsi lichumanise lomgubho wemnyakalikhulu loyincophamlandvo.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzokwethula Inyanga yeAfrika ngoSuku Lukazwelonke Lomkhuleko ngomhla zingama-29 kuMbasa 2016.Ngowezi-2016 Inyanga ye-Afrika izogxila ezinhlelweni eziqanjwe kabusha zokuthuthukiswa kwabantu besifazane kanye nentsha, ngenkathi sigubha iminyaka engama-60 yeMashi Yabantu Besifazane kanye neminyaka engama-40 Yemibhikiso Yentsha eSoweto.

src: Lesikhungo sekufundza lesiyincophamlandvo sibe sikhonkhwane ngesikhatsi semzabalazo wekutfola inkhululeko sibuye futsi satiwe ngekutsi “libhodo lekuphekelwe kulo baholi base-Afrika” ngoba kwafundza khona bantfu labebalwa nelubandlululo, bantfu labakhulu labafanana nabo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo kanye naGovan Mbeki.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayanxuswa ukuba babambe iqhaza ohlelweni oluzobe luhlanganise iminxa ehlukahlukene olubandakanya imisebenzi enhlobonhlobo efaka phakathi imisebenzi yobuciko obubukwayo, imidlalo yeshashalazi, umculo, izifundo kanye nezingqungquthela kanjalo nokubungazwa kweminyaka eyi-10 yeSikhwama Samasiko Omhlaba Wase-Afrika.

src: Ngiyo kuphela inyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika lekhicite baholi bemibuso labasihlanu: Nelson Mandela waseNingizimu Afrika, Yusuf Lule wase-Uganda, Robert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle waseLesotho kanye na-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.
tgt: Inyanga yase-Afrika isebenza njengenkundla yokuzixhumana kabusha kanye nokuzibophezela kabusha Obumbanweni lwama-Afrika kanye Nasekuvuselelweni kwe-Afrika ekuhlanganiseni abantu bezwekazi lase-Afrika ndawonye.

src: Njengencenye yekugujwa kwemkhosi wemnyakalikhulu weNyuvesi yaseFort Hare iKhabhinethi imema titjudeni lebetifundza kulenyuvesi kanye nemalunga emmango kutsi babelane ngaloko labakukhumbulako ngeFort Hare bentele umkhankhaso weCoca Yakho Indzaba basebentisa #MyFortHare.
tgt: Ngomhla zingama-20 Nhlaba 2016 uhulumeni uzohola umgubho kazwelonke weminyaka eyikhulu yeNyuvesi i-Fort Hare ophikweni oluse-Alice eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Lisekela laMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa litawuhola litsimba letitfunywa laseNingizimu Afrika liye kuForamu Yetemnotfo Yemhlaba (i-WEF) ye-Afrika ye-26 eRwanda emkhatsini wamhla ti-11 namhla ti-13 Inkhwekhweti 2016.
tgt: Ukulungiselela umgubho omkhulu, uMongameli u-Jacob Zuma usesungule iKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukahlukene (i-IMC) ukuba lihlele liphinde lididiyele le ngqophamlando yomgubho weminyaka eyikhulu.

src: Leforamu itawubanjelwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kuchumanisa imitfombolusito yase-Afrika ngeTingucuko tekweDijithali”.Hulumende ngaloLuhlelo lwakhe Lwemaphuzu Layimfica utfutfukisa tigucuko tekwedijithali telive lakhe.
tgt: Lesi sikhungo sokufunda esiyingqophamlando sasebenza njengesikhonkwane ngesikhathi sethu sokuzabalazela inkululeko futhi siphinde saziwe njenge “mbiza yobuholi base-Afrika” ngenxa yokuthi iyona nyuvesi eyafunda izingqalabutho zomzabalazo wokulwisana nobandlululo ezinjengo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo no-Govan Mbeki.

src: Wetfula sigaba sekucala semtamo wakhe we-inthanethi lesebenta ngekushesha letawuchumanisa tisetjentiswa tahulumende letingetulu kwaleti-5 000 kubomasipala besigodzi labasiphohlongo eminyakeni lemitsatfu.
tgt: Iyona kuphela inyuvesi eseNingizimu ne-Afrika eyake yakhiqiza izinhloko zombuso ezinhlanu: u-Nelson Mandela waseNingizimu Afrika, u-Yusuf Lule wase-Uganda, u-Robert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, uNtsu Mokhehle waseLesotho kanye no-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.

src: INDABA 2016 eSikhungweni Senkhomfa sase-Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban kusukela mhla ti-7 kuya kumhla ti-9 Inkhwekhweti 2016, yinkhundla ye-Afrika Yonkhe letawukhutsata kutsengwa kwemikhicito yetfu yetekuvakasha bantfu bemave angaphandle.
tgt: Njengengxenye yemigubho yeminyaka eyikhulu yeNyuvesi i-Fort Hare iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abafundi bangaphambilini bale nyuvesi kanye namalungu omphakathi ukuba abelane ngezinkumbulo anazo nge-Fort Hare emkhankasweni Wokuxoxa Indaba Yakho esebenzisa isibambo esithi #MyFortHare.

src: Tekuvakasha, njengalenye yetinsika letisitfupha tekukhula kwemnotfo teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe, tifake tigidzi letinge-R357 kuSambakhulu Semkhicito Wasekhaya (i-GDP) nga-2014 tabuye futsi tesekela i-9% yako konkhe kukhokhelwa kwaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: IPhini likaMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uzohola ithimba lezinthunywa zaseNingizimu Afrika eliya Esithangamini Sezomnotho Womhlaba Wonke (i-WEF) sama-26 e-Afrika esizobe sibanjelwe eRwanda phakathi komhla ziyi-11 kanye ne-13 Nhlaba 2016.

src: Umkhandlu Wemhlaba Wetekuhamba kanye neTekuvakasha ulinganisela kutsi tekuvakasha titawufaka tigidzigidzi letinge-R560 ku-GDP yetfu nga-2025 kantsi futsi titawesekela imisebenti lengetulu kwaletigidzi letimbili.
tgt: Isithangami sisingathwe ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Ukuxhumanisa Izinsiza zase-Africa ngokusebenzisa Ukuguquka Kwezobuxhakaxhaka Bukagesi”.Uhulumeni esebenzisa Uhlelo lwakhe Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye uqhubezela phambili ukuguquka kwezwe kwezobuxhakaxhaka bukagesi.

src: Kukhulisa umphumela weTekuvakasha eMnotfweni Waselwandle kuyinsika lebalulekile yeLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica, lokwesekelwa ngemakhono lasengakatsintfwa etilwandle tetfu, lokungafaka sandla ekukhuleni kwemnotfo.
tgt: Useqalile ukukhipha isigaba sokuqala sohlelo lwakhe oluqanjwe kabusha lwezinxakanxaka zokuxhumana oluzoxhuma izikhungo zikahulumeni ezingaphezu kwezi-5 000 komasipala bezifunda abayisishiyagalombili esikhathini esiyiminyaka emithathu.

src: Mayelana nekukhunjulwa kweLilanga leTisebenti mhla lu-1 Inkhwekhweti 2016, iKhabhinethi ihamba etinyatselweni tekutinikela kwelive letfu ekuvikeleni emalungelo etisebenti ngekwemtsetfo wetisebenti lotfutfukako.
tgt: INDABA 2016 eNkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre e-Durban kusukela mhla ziyi-7 kuya mhla ziyi-9 Nhlaba 2016, iyisithangami Sobumbano lwama-Afrika esizokhuthaza imikhiqizo yethu yezokuvakasha kubathengi basemazweni aphesheya.

src: Kusukela nga-1994 hulumende ngekusebentisa umtsetfo lefanana neMtsetfo Webudlelwane Betisebenti Nebacashi, Umtsetfo Wetimo Tekucashwa Letisisekelo, Umtsetfo Wekucashswa Ngekulingana kanye neTemphilo yasemsebentini neKuphepha yatfutfukisa emalungelo etisebenti.
tgt: Ezokuvakasha, njengenye yezinsika eziyisithupha zokukhula komnotho woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe, zibe negalelo lezigidigidi ezingama-357 zamarandi kwiSamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP) ngowezi-2014 futhi zixhase nge-9% esambeni esiphelele sabantu abaqashiwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: IkKabhinethi icela bafundzi beLibanga le-12 kutsi bacale manje bakhiphe ku-inthanethi emafomu ekufa ticelo tetindzawo tekufundza etikhungweni tetemfundvo lephakeme nobe bafake ticelo ku-inthanethi njengencenye yeMkankhaso i-Apply Now/Khetha Career GuidanceLomklamo uchutjwa njalo ngemnyaka Litiko Letemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha, utawuchutjwa kulo lonkhe lelive kute kube yiNyoni 2016 futsi usita bafundzi kutsi bakhetse kahle nabafaka ticelo tendzawo yekufundza etikhungweni temfundvo lephakeme.
tgt: Umkhandlu Wezokuhamba Nokuvakasha Womhlaba Wonke ulinganisa ngokuthi ezokuvakasha zizoba negalelo lezigidigidi ezingama-560 zamarandi kwi-GDP yethu ngowezi-2025 kanti futhi ziyoxhasa ngemisebenzi engaphezu kwezigidi ezimbili.

src: Bafundzi bakhutsatwa kutsi batsintse Sikhungo Setinsita Tekutfutfukisa Imisebenti nge-SMS nome batfumele “please call me” ku: 072 204 5056 nobe :086 999 0123, incwadzigezi: EMAILTOKEN, ku-Facebook ku: WEBTOKEN nobe ku-Twitter ku: WEBTOKEN Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letibalulekile tesimondzawo.
tgt: Ukukhulisa umthelela Wezokuvakasha Emnothweni Wasolwandle kuyinsika esemqoka yoHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, okususelwe emandleni angakathintwa muntu ezilwandle zethu, angaba negalelo ekukhuleni komnotho.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata labatsintsekako kutsi baphawule ngeluhlaka lolubuyeketiwe lwaseNingizimu Afrika lweShatha Yekuhlonyiswa Ngemandla Emnotfo Umkhakha Lobanti Webantfu Labamnyama kanye neMboni Yetimbiwa, lwanga-2016 lolwashicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende.
tgt: Umnotho wasolwandle kanye nezokuvakasha zihlinzeka ngamathuba amangalisayo okukhula komnotho kanye nokusungulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi.

src: Loluhlaka lolwabuyeketwa lweShatha Yetetimbiwa iyachubeka ihlanganise tinchubomgomo tahulumende tekutfutfukisa kanye nemtsetfo kute kutsi kuchutjwe emabhizinisi kalula, kwakheke kucaca kwekulawula, kucombeleleka kanye nekuciniseka.
tgt: Kusukela ngowe-1994 uhulumeni esebenzisa imithetho enjengoMthetho Wezobudlelwano Nabasebenzi, uMthetho Wezimo Zokusebenza Eziyisisekelo, uMthetho Wokuqashwa Kwabantu Ngokulingana kanye noMthetho Wezempilo Emsebenzini kanye Nokuphepha useqhubezele phambili amalungelo abasebenzi.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kutsi kuvunywa kutfolwa kwe-SAB Miller yi-AB InBev lokuhlongotwako kubukwa tiphatsimandla temicudzelwano.
tgt: Abafundi bayagqugquzelwa ukuba baxhumane neSikhungo Sezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi ngokuthumela i-SMS noma u-“please call me” ku-072 204 5056 noma ku-086 999 0123, nge-imeyili kuleli kheli: EMAILTOKEN, ku-Facebook kuleli kheli: WEBTOKEN noma ku-Twitter kuleli kheli: WEBTOKEN Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela indlela levunywe yiNdvuna Yekutfutfukiswa Kwetemnotfo kanye ne-AB InBev kutiphatsimandla temcudzelwano ngekwetintfo letinyenti letitsandvwa ngummango.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igqugquzela ababambiqhaza abafanelekile ukuba baphawule ohlakeni olubuyekeziwe loMqulu Wokuthuthukiswa Kwabamnyama Kwezomnotho Wezezimboni zaseNingizimu Afrika Zezezimayini kanye Nezimbiwa Phansi, lowezi-2016 olwashicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni.

src: Lokutinikela kwalenkampani kusebenta njengenkhombandlela, yetindzaba letitsandvwa ngummango, kuletinye tinkampani letihlanganiswako kanye nekutfola etimeni letinjalo.
tgt: Uhlaka olubuyekeziwe loMqulu Wezezimayini luphinde luhlanganise izinqubomgomo zenguquko zikahulumeni kanye nomthetho wokuthuthukisa ukwenziwa lula kwebhizinisi, ukusungula incanciselo yezokulawula, ukuqagulwa kanye nokuqiniseka.

src: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kutinikela lokuvunyelwene ngako ngulenkampani kwekusebentisa sigidzigidzi si-R1 kuleminyaka lesihlanu letako kute kukhutsate kulima kwebalimi labancane kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwemtfulitinsita wendzawo, emabhizinisi lamasha, bucwepheshe bagezi nemanti lenele kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwelusha.
tgt: Luphinde lwahanjelaniswa nezimiso zoMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwabamanyama Kwezomnotho, wezi-2003 (uMthetho onguNombolo 53 wezi-2003) kanye Namakhodi Enkambiso Enhle (Amakhodi e-DTI).
