src: IKhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-10 Imphala 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-10 kuMfumfu 2018 e-Tuynhuys eKapa.

src: Tindzaba Letimcoka.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: IKhabhinethi iyatemukela tingenelelo letiphatsekako njengekutinikela ekutsengeni imikhicito yalelive, kwandzisa kakhulu indlela yekutsengisela emave angephandle imphahla, tingenelelo tenchubo yekukhicita kutekulima kanye nekwesekela emabhizinisi lamancane nalasemkhatsini.
tgt: Umnotho kanye nomkhankaso wotshalomali.1 IKhabhinethi liyazamukela izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokungenelela eziphathekayo futhi ezinohlonze ezinjengokuzibophezela ekuthengeni imikhiqizo yakuleli, ukuqiniswa kakhudlwana kwemizamo yokukhulisa umthamo wempahla yakuleli ethunyelwa emazweni angaphandle, izinhlelo zokungenelela ochungechungeni lomsebenzi wokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo kanye nokweseka amabhizinisi asafufusa.

src: Letimemetelo tivele ngesikhatsi kuneNgcungcutsela yeteMisebenti, lebeyibanjwe ngaphasi kweMkandlu Wavelonkhe Wekutfutfukisa Umnotfo Netisebenti (i-Nedlac).
tgt: Lezi zimemezelo ziwumphumela weNgqungquthela Yemisebenzi ethathe izinsuku ezimbili ebibanjwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule, ebibizwe ngaphansi koMkhandlu Kazwelonke Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho kanye Nezabasebenzi (i-Nedlac).2 Umphumela weNgqungquthela Yemisebenzi ulandela isimemezelo soHlelo Lokuvuselela Nokugqugquzela Ukusimama Komnotho, oluhlose ukubuyisa nokuvuselela ukukhula komnotho futhi ludale namathuba omsebenzi adingeka kakhulu.

src: Umphumela waleNgcungcutsela yeteMisebenti ulandzela simemetelo seLuhlelo Lwevusamnotfo neLuhlelo lwekuBuyisa, lokuhloswe ngalo kubuyisa kukhula kutemnotfo nekudala imisebenti ledzingeka kakhulu.
tgt: Usomqulu Wezimayini omusha – ophothulwe ngokubonisana nemboni yezimayini, abasebenzi, imiphakathi ethintekile kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza – icacisa izinto ezisemqoka kakhulu okumele zenziwe ukuze kulethwe ukukhula komnotho, ukusimama kanye noguquko.3 IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuthi bawucubungule futhi bazame ukuwuqonda uSomqulu Wezimayini ukuze uphothulwe futhi kulethwe uzinzo emkhakheni wezimayini.

src: Umculu lomusha weteTimayini – lowaphotfulwa ngekubonisana nemboni yetetimayini, temisebenti, imimango letsintsekile kanye nalabanye labatsintsekako – uchaza kudzingeka kwekukhula, kusimama kanye netingucuko.
tgt: Ihhovisi loMnyango Wezasekhaya lase-Kokstad kanye nokunikezwa kwamatayitela.1 NjengoMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa, iKhabhinethi nalo liyawuncoma impela uMnyango Wezasekhaya ngokuvula ngempumelelo ihhovisi lawo lase-Kokstad KwaZulu-Natali.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe labatsintsekako kutsi babonisane ngaloMculu weteTimayini ngenhloso yekuwuphotfula nekudala kutsi kube nekusimamama emkhakheni wetetimayini.
tgt: UMongameli wavula ngokusemthethweni leli hhovisi loMnyango Wezasekhaya njengengxenye yohlelo lukahulumeni lokwelula ukufinyelela kwezizinda zoMnyango Wezasekhaya ezihlinzeka ngezidingongqangi kubantu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nesasasa elikhulu eliboniswa yizakhamuzi zakuleli komazisi bekhadi kanye nezinye izincwadi.2 Ngaphezu kwalokho, uMongameli Ramaphosa wadlulisela amatayitela angaphezu kwama-443 ezandleni zabahlomuli boMklamo Wezindlu wase-Franklin.

src: Mengameli uvule lelihhovisi letaseKhaya njengencenye yeluhlelo lwahulumende lwekwengeta tindzawo letaseKhaya tekuletsa tinsita tekuhlangabetana netidzingo tetakhamuti tekufuna bomatisi bemakhadi (e-Smart ID) kanye nalamanye emadokhumenti.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo lokuvuselela ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi abahlomuli bathokozela imihlomulo ephelele yokuba ngabanikazi bezindlu futhi ukuze bakwazi nokufinyelela emakethe yomhlaba ehlelekile.3 IKhabhinethi lithanda futhi ukusebenzisa leli thuba ukukhuthaza izakhamuzi zakuleli ukuthi zihambe ziyolanda omazisi bazo ngokushesha emva kokuthola isaziso esibanxusa ukuthi beze bazobalanda.

src: Kwengeta, Mengameli Ramaphosa unike bazuzi bemklamo wetindlu, i-Franklin Housing Project, ematayitela lange-443.
tgt: Ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni mayelana nokwabiwa kwamagagasi okusakaza ngomoya IKhabhinethi liyasamukela isivumelwano okufinyelelwe kusona mayelana nodaba olubandakanya isiMemo Sokufakwa Kwezicelo eziqondene nokwabiwa kwamagagasi okusakaza ngomoya afunwa kakhulu.

src: Loku kuyincenye yeluhlelo lwekubuyisa kucinisekisa kutsi bazuzi batfola tinzuzo letiphelele tekuba nendlu kanye nekutsi batfole tindlu letisemtsetfweni labangakhona kutitsengisa.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka ukuqiniseka mayelana nezinqubomgomo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bolwazi nokuxhumana (i-ICT).

src: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi itsatsa lelitfuba igcugcutela kakhulu takhamuti kutsi tiyowulandza bomatisi bato ngekushesha emva kwekutfola satiso sekubalandza.
tgt: Lesi sivumelwano sihambelana nekhwelo likaMongameli Ramaphosa lokuqaliswa kwenqubo yokwabiwa kwamalayisensi amagagasi okusakaza ngomoya afunwa kakhulu.3 Ngenhloso yokufaka isandla esithe xaxa ekuqalisweni kokusebenza koHlaka Lombiko Odingidwayo Wenqubomgomo Ye-ICT Edidiyelwe Kazwelonke, bonke abanentshisekelo bazonikezwa ithuba lokuhlinzeka uphiko ngemibono yabo ebhalwe phansi kuze kube ngumhla ziyisi-8 kuLwezi 2018 mayelana nenqubomgomo ehlongozwayo kanye nesiqondiso senqubomgomo.

src: Sivumelwane lesincunyiwe lesimayelana ne-spectrum IKhabhinethi iyasemukela lesivumelwane lesincunyiwe lokufinyelelwe kuso eludzabeni lolufaka ekhatsi Simemo sekwenta Sicelo sekunikwa spectrum lesidzingeka kakhulu.
tgt: Imifelandawonye yabadobi abancane yokuqala ngqa yaseNingizimu Afrika IKhabhinethi liyayamukela imifelandawonye yabadobi abancane yokuqala ngqa yaseNingizimu Afrika emkhakheni wezokudoba, okungumfelandawonye wase-Port Nolloth kanye nowase-Hondeklipbaai eNyakatho Kapa, eyathulwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezolimo, Ezamahlathi Nezokudoba, uMnu Senzeni Zokwana.

src: Loku kwenta kutsi kube nekucinisekiswa kwenchubomgomo yemkhakha wethekhinoloji yelwati lwetekuchumana (i-ICT).
tgt: Ukwethulwa kwale mifelandawonye kuwuphawu lokuqaliswa kokusebenza kwenqubomgomo yabadobi abancane.

src: Lesivumelwane lesincunyiwe sihambelana nesimemetelo lesentiwe nguMengameli Ramaphosa sekucala inchubo yekunika imvume yekusakata ye-spectrum ledzingeka kakhulu.
tgt: Amalungelo okudoba anikeza abadobi bendawo isithunzi, njengoba bebedoba ngokungemthetho, kepha-ke manje sebevikelekile, futhi kungokokuqala ngqa ukuthi kwenzeke into enjalo kuleli.

src: Ngekufaka ligalelo ekucaleni kwekusetjentiswa kweMtsetfo Lohlongotwako weNchubomgomo yaVelonkhe yekuHlanganisa i-ICT, emacembu lanenshisekelo anesikhatsi kute kube mhla ti-08 Lweti 2018 kutsi angenise kulabasemagunyeni kuphawula lokubhaliwe lokumayelana nalenchubomgomo lephakanyisiwe kanye nesicondziso senchubomgomo.
tgt: Le miphakathi yabadobi abancane emibili ezohlomula kule nqubomgomo seyithole ukuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo mayelana nemifelandawonye futhi ilekeleliwe ukubhalisa imifelandawonye yayo ukuze ikwazi ukufaka izicelo zamalungelo okudoba isikhathi esiyiminyaka eyi-.

src: Emakoporasi aseNingizimu Afrika ekucala lamancane etinhlanti.
tgt: Isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela.1 IKhabhinethi liyabancoma abakhokhi bentela ababalelwa ezigidini ezintathu asebewathumelile amafomu abo entela, futhi abayisigamu kulaba bawathumele nge-inthanethi amafomu abo besebenzisa uhlelo lwe-eFiling.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela emakoporasi aseNingizimu Afrika ekucala lamancane etinhlanti emkhakheni wetekudvoba, latiwa ngekutsi yiPort Nolloth neHondeklipbaai laseNyakatfo Kapa, latfulwa yiNdvuna yeTekulima, Temahlatsi Netinhlanti, Umnu Senzeni Zokwana.
tgt: Mhla zingama-31 kuMfumfu, siyavalwa isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela sowezi-2018 maqondana nabakhokhi bentela abathola ingenisomali evela emholweni kuphela kanye nabakhokhi bentela yesithutshana (okusho labo abathola ingenisomali ngale komholo, noma ingenisomali evela ebhizinisini) abaqoka ukuzihambisela amafomu abo mathupha egatsheni lesiKhungo Esiqoqa Intela saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS).

src: Lamalungelo ekudvoba anika badvobi bendzawo sitfunti, ngobe bebasolo badvoba ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kenje nyalo sebavikeleke kwekucala.
tgt: Abakhokhi bentela yesithutshana abaqoka ukuthumela amafomu nge-eFiling bazonikezwa ithuba lokuthumela amafomu abo kuze kube ngumhla zingama-31 kuMasingana 20.2 Ukuqoqwa ngendlela efanele kwemali engenayo emgodlagodleni kahulumeni kuqinisekisa amandla aleli lizwe olulawula imali engenayo ngokuzimela futhi ukuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela aqukethe imininingwane efanelekile, ngesikhathi esibekiwe, kuyaqinisekisa ukuthi abakhokhi bentela bathathwa njengabantu abawuthobelayo umthetho wezentela.

src: Lemimamngo lemincane lemibili ledvobako letawuzuza kulenchubomgomo seyitfole kuceceshwa lokusisekelo lokumayelana nemakoporasi futsi seyisitwe ngekutsi ibhalise emakoporasi ngenhloso yekufaka sicelo semalungelo ekudvoba iminyaka le-.
tgt: Imali etholakala ngokukhokhwa kwentela ilekelela uhulumeni ukuze akwazi ukuxhasa ngezimali imiklamo yokuthunyelwa kwezidingongqangi kuleli kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalomnotho.

src: IKhabhinethi iyababonga labakhokhi bemtselo labacishe balinganiselwe etigidzini letintsatfu labangenise emafomu abo emtselo, kwatsi sigamu sabo sangenise emafomu abo ngekusebentisa i-eFiling.
tgt: Ukukhokhwa kwezibonelelomali zikahulumeni.1 IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko yiKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene: Elijutshwe Ukubhekana Nodaba Lwezibonelelomali Zikahulumeni, usihlalo walo okunguNgqongqoshe Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.

src: Ngamhla tinge-31 Imphala, sikhatsi sekutsela sa-2018 sekuvala kwalabo labangakhokhi umtselo ngendlela letikhawu kanye nalabo labakhokha umtselo ngetikhawu labakhetse kutsi batawuletsa emafomu abo emtselo egatjeni lemahhovisi eLuphiko LwaseNingizimu Afrika Lwekugcogcwa Kwemtselo (i-SARS).
tgt: Kusukela mhla lu-1 kuMfumfu 2018, bangaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-10 abahlomuli abakhokhelwe izibonelelomali zabo kusetshenziswa ezinye zalezi zikhungo ezilandelayo – iPosi laseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPO)/i-Postbank i-Grindrod Bank kanye nezitolo ezinjengo-Boxer, Shoprite, kanye no-Pick n Pay.2 Uhulumeni usekwazile ukufudukisa ngempumelelo umsebenzi wokukhokhwa kwezibonelelomali zikahulumeni usuka enkampanini yakwa-Cash Paymaster Services (i-CPS) ngokomyalelo wesiNqumo Senkantolo.

src: Labakhokha umtselo ngetikhawu labakhetse kuletsa emafomu abo emtselo ngendlela ye-eFiling bangakwenta loko kudzimate kube mhla tinge-31 Bhimbidvwane 2019.
tgt: Bonke abahlomuli abebekhokhelwa imali engukheshi ngu-CPS sebefudukisiwe futhi i-CPS seyazisiwe ngokuqedwa kwenkontileka yayo kusukela mhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 20.3 IKhabhinethi lidlulisa ukubonga kwalo ngomsebenzi wokuqapha omuhle kakhulu obuholwa yiThimba LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene lisekelwa yiThimba Elikhethekile LabaQondisi Jikelele Abanolwazi Olunzulu Emsebenzini Walo Mkhakha.

src: Kugcogcwa kahle kwemalingena yemtselo nangemphumelelo kucinisekisa kutibusa ngekwetimali tahulumende, kantsi nekuletsa emafomu lagcwaliswe kahle futsi nangesikhatsi kucinisekisa kutfobela indlela yekwenta tintfo yebakhokhi bemtselo.
tgt: Liyawubonga futhi umsebenzi omuhle wezikhulu ezivela ku-SAPO, Inhlangano Yezimpesheni Nezibonelelo Zikahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika (i-Sassa) kanye noMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi OwezeNgqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi OwezokuHlela, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola Owezezimali Kuzwelonke uMbutho Wamaphoyisa waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) kanye Nophiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokuhlinzeka Ngolwazi (i-GCIS).4 IKhabhinethi liyababonga bonke abahlomuli bezibonelelomali zikahulumeni ngobambiswano lwabo abalubonisile kulesi sikhathi soguquko.

src: Imalingena yemtselo isita hulumende kutsi akhokhele imiklamo yalelive yekuletsa tinsita kanye naletinye tinhlelo tekutfutfukisa tenhlalomnotfo.
tgt: Imigubho yekhulu-nyaka lika-Albertina Sisulu IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko mayelana namalungiselelo omgubho wekhulu-nyaka likaMama u-Albertina Sisulu ozobanjwa ngenyanga azalwa ngayo, uMfumfu.

src: IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafishane Likomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna: Tibonelelo Temali Yahulumende, sihlalo walo lokuyiNdvuna Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.
tgt: UMama uSisulu wazalwa mhla zingama-21 kuMfumfu 1918, futhi usiHlalo WeKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene Ejutshwe Umsebenzi Wokuhlela Lo mgubho, uNgqongqoshe u-Jeff Radebe, ukhona lapha ukuzochaza kabanzi mayelana nemicimbi nemisebenzi ezokwenziwa ephathelene nomgubho wekhulu-nyaka likaMama u-Albertina Sisulu.

src: Kusukela mhla ti-01 Imphala 2018, bantfu labangetulu kwetigidzi letilishumi bakhokhelwa kusetjentiswa letinye taletindlela – Lihhovisi Leliposi laseNingizimu Afrika (i-Sapo)/i-Postbank i-Grindrod Bank kanye netitolo letifanana neBoxer, Shoprite, nePick n Pay.
tgt: Ukugwetshwa kukababa wase-Springs.1 IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukugwetshwa kwendoda enesihluku, edume ngeleNunu Esabekayo yase-Springs (i-Springs Monster).

src: Hulumende ukutsutse ngemphumelelo kukhokhelwa kwetibonelelo yemali yahulumende kusuka ku-Cash Paymaster Services (i-CPS) njengekuyalwa Sijubo seNkantolo yeteMtsetfosisekelo.
tgt: Wagwetshwa iminyaka engama-35 ejele ngecala lokuzama ukubulala indodana yakhe, ukuhlukumeza, ukuhluleka ukunakekela izingane zakhe kanye nokusebenzisa futhi athengise izidakamizwa.

src: Bonkhe bantfu labebaholelwa imali lengukheshi i-CPS sebatfutsiwe kantsi na-CPS sewatisiwe futsi nangekuncanyulwa kwalesivumelwane kusukela mhla tinge-30 Inyoni 2018.
tgt: Udlame oluqondiswe kwabesifazane lusalokhu luyinselele enkulu ezweni lethu, njengoba lokhu kubonakale ngokucacile esigamekweni sokudlwengulwa kwengane esencane esenzeke esikhathini esifushane esedlule esitolo sokudla sakwa-Dros e-Silverton.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudvumisa kwayo ngalomsebenti wekwengamela lobewuholwa Likomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna lebelisekelwa Licembu Lemasu Ekusebenta leBacondzisi Jikelele.
tgt: Khabhinethi liyagcizelela ekhweleni eliqondiswe kwiziphathimandla eziqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ukuthi zenze konke okusemandleni azo ukushushisa abenzi balawa macala amabi kangaka.

src: Iphindze futsi ivakalise kudvumisa kwayo umsebenti lowentiwe tikhulu taka-SAPO, i-Ejensi yetekuCinisekiswa kweteNhlalakahle eNingizimu Afrika (i-Sassa)kanye, neLitiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalalakahle Letakhiwonchanti Tekuchumanisa Netinsita Teliposi letekuHlela, kuCaphela nekuLungisa, Temafa Avelonkhe Luphiko Lwembutfo Wemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) neLuphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Netekwatisa (i-GCIS).
tgt: Imibhikisho yase-Westbury.1 IKhabhinethi liyazamukela izinyathelo zokungenelela e-Westbury ezithathwe nguNgqongqoshe uBheki Cele, eziyingxenye yeqhingasu elibanzi lokulwisana nesihlava sezidakamizwa kanye nodlame oluphathelene nemigulukudu kuleya ndawo.2 Izinyathelo zokungenelela zibandakanya ukutshalwa kwethimba lamaphoyisa akhethekile aqeqeshwe ngokujulile, adume “ngelamaBherethi”, kanye nokukhuliswa kwesibalo samaphoyisa aqaphile, ehla enyuka emphakathini, eqinisekisa ukuphepha komphakathi.

src: Iminyaka Lelikhulu ya-Albertina Sisulu IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafishane mayelana nemalungiselelo emcimbi wekugubha iminyaka lelikhulu yekutalwa kwaMake Albertina Sisulu lotawubanjwa ngenyanga yekutalwa kwakhe, Imphala.
tgt: Ubugebengu IKhabhinethi liyazincoma impela izimpiko eziqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ngophenyo olunzulu olumkhakha-mningi ezilwenzile oluphathelene nezigameko zeziqhumane ezitholakale ezikhungweni ezinenxanxathela yezitolo, ezitolo ezinkulu ezidumile kanye nasezindlini zesonto lamaSulumane (ama-mosque), okuwuphenyo oseluholele ekuboshweni kwabasolwa abayi-19.

src: Ugwetjwe iminyaka lenge-35 abhadla ejele ngekulinga kubulala indvodzana yakhe, kuhlukubeta bantfwana nekungabanakekeli, kanye nekusebentisa aphindze futsi atsengise tidzakamiva.
tgt: Lolu phenyo belubandakanya neQoqwana Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvinjelwa Kobugebengu kanye Nokuvikeleka.

src: Budlova lobucondziswe kulabasikati buyinsayeya lenkhulu emmangweni wetfu, njengaloku kubonakele ngesikhatsi kugagadlelwa umntfwana lomncane lapha resitjurenti eDros eSilverton.
tgt: Abasolwa abathathu kulaba baboshelwe amacala aphathelene neziqhumane ezatholakala ezikhungweni ezihlukahlukene eThekwini, kubandakanya nendlu yesonto lamaSulumane e-Verulam.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi icela labo labasemagunyeni ekucinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo kutsi bente konkhe lokusemandleni kutsi bayashushiswa bonkhe labo labenta lamacala ebugebengu lamabi ngalendlela.
tgt: Bonke abasolwa kulindeleke ukuthi babekwe amacala, kubandakanya elokubulala, ukuzama ukubulala kanye nokwephula uMthetho Weziqhumane.2 IKhabhinethi liyabaqinisekisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ukulwisana nobugebengu kuyinto ebekwe eqhulwini futhi uhulumeni uzoqhubeka nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika baphila ngaphansi kwesimo esiphephile futhi esivikelekile.

src: Iphindza futsi icela wonkhe umuntfu kutsi kubanjisanwe ekuvimbeni kutsi kungaphulwa emalungelo ebantfwana kanye newalawo malunga emmango lahlaseleka lula.
tgt: Ukuguqulwa kwegama lendawo: Makhanda IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukuguqulwa kwegama ledolobha i-Grahamstown, eMpumalanga Kapa, libizwe ngeMakhanda, ngenhloso yokuhlonipha umphrofethi, isazi senzululwazi kanye nomkhuzi wempi owalwisana nenqubo yokuqonelwa ngabezizwe.2 Lolu guquko luyingxenye esemqoka ohambweni lwentando yeningi labantu futhi luzolekelela ukuqinisa ubumbano lomphakathi futhi luzokwenza ukuthi abantu bakuleli bawuqonde futhi bawazise kakhudlwana umlando waleli lizwe, okungumlando wethu sonke.

src: Umshuco waseWestbury IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kungenelela kweNdvuna Yetemaphoyisa Bheki Cele eWestbury, lokuyincenye yendlelalisu lelibanti lekulwa nalesishayo setidzakamiva nebudlova lobuhambisana nemacembu emigulugudvu kulendzawo.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethiIKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uhlelo olubuyekeziwe lokuqaliswa koMklamo Wokufudukela Ekusakazeni Ngedijithali.

src: Lesingenelelo sifaka ekhatsi kutfunyelwa kweLicembu Lemaphoyisa Leliceceshwe Ngalokuvelele (maBharethe) kanye nekubonakala ngalokugcamile kwemaphoyisa kulendzawo.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lusebenzisa indlela yokusebenza eqhutshwa yizimakethe noma izitolo ngokuthi kubanjiswane nomkhakha ozimele kanye nezimboni.

src: IKhabhinethi icela ummango waseWestbury kutsi kanye nayo yonkhe nje imimango kutsi isebentisane nemaphoyisa ekucinisekiseni kutsi sitisephula netimphandze tato tonkhe tento tebugebengu, tetidzakamiva netemigulukudvu kuletindzawo lapho tenteka khona.
tgt: Ngale ndlela yokusebenza, uhulumeni ngeke esazibandakanya ekuthengweni kwamabhokisana okudonsa isiginali kamabonakude (ama-set-top-boxes), ukugcinwa kwawo, kanye nokuthuthwa nokuxhunywa kwawo emakhaya.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawabonga ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo ngekwenta luphenyo lolujulile nalolufaka tindlela letinengi lolumacondzana netehlakalo letenteka emamoli, etitolo kanye nasemasontfweni eMamozilemu lokuholele ekutseni kubanjwe basolwa laba-19.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka iNingizimu Afrika ngethuba lokuqhubekela phambili ekuphothulweni kwalo mklamo wokufudukela ekusakazeni ngedijithali ngendlela ebandakanyayo, engambi eqolo futhi esebenza kahle, futhi kunciphisa nobungozi kuhulumeni.

src: Loku kufake ekhatsi LiKlasta Letebulungiswa, Letekuvikela Bugebengu neTekuphepha.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokhuphula inani lababukeli asebebukela umabonakude othola isiginali yedijithali lifinyelele emkhawulweni obekuhloswe ukufinyelela kuwona wama-85% futhi kuze kudlulele nangaphezulu kwalokho, njengoba kuphokophelwe ekucimeni wonke amasiginali okusakaza nge-analogi.

src: Labatsatfu kulabasolwa baboshelwe mayelana netisetjentiswa letivutsako endzaweni yaseDurban, lokufaka ekhatsi lisontfo leMamozilemu leliseVerulam.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liwugunyazile uMbhalo Wemigomo Engumongo (i-Common Core Document) yeNingizimu Afrika, ozothunyelwa kwiNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN).

src: Bonkhe labasolwa balindzeleke kutsi babukane nemacala lafaka ekhatsi kubulala kanye nekuzama kubulala kanye nekwephula Umtsetfo weTichumachumachumane.
tgt: Lo mbhalo uhlinzeka ngenqubekelaphambili equkethe ulwazi olujwayelekile olungamaqiniso futhi olunezibalomanani mayelana nokuthobela kweNingizimu Afrika izibopho ezihambisana nezivumelwano ze-UN eziyisishiyagalolunye ezasayinwa.

src: IKhabhinethi itsandza kucinisekisa bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi kulwa nebugebengu yintfo lesembili eluhlwini lwetintfo lekumele kutsi kucalwe ngato tentiwe kanye nekutsi hulumende utawuchubeka atsatse tinyatselo letidzingekako kucinisekisa kutsi kuba nesimondzawo lesiphephile nalesivikelekile sabo bonkhe labahlala lapha eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Imicimbi EzayoIsitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS)UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali u-Tito Mboweni uzokwethula Isitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS) ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-24 kuMfumfu 2018, esizoveza izinguquko ezithile ezenziwe kwisabelomali sikazwelonke ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukusimama kwezimali.

src: Kuntjintja kweligama: Makhanda IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuntjintjwa kweligama iGrahamstown, lidolobha leliseMphumalanga Kapa, kutsi ibe yiMakhanda kute kuhlonishwe umpholofidi, linjulamcondvo lesive semaXhosa, naloyindvodza yemphi leyalwa nebukholoni.
tgt: Inyanga Yezokuthutha Uhlelo lwalo nyaka lweNyanga Yezokuthutha lugcizelela ukubaluleka kwengqalasizinda yezokuthutha, enjengezithuthi zasolwandle, izindiza, izitimela kanye nezithuthi ezihamba emgwaqeni njengoba lokhu kuyizinto ezisemqoka ezizolekelela ekukhuliseni umnotho.

src: Loluntjintjo luyincenye lebalulekile yeluhambo lwetfu lwentsandvo yelinyenti futsi lutawusita ekwakheni kubumbana kutenhlalo kanye nekwakha kwatisa lokujulile kwemlandvo wetfu lesabelana ngawo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawunxusa umphakathi ukuthi usebenzise izithuthi zomphakathi futhi uqalise ngenkuthalo ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphepha emgwaqeni, okuyinto okumele yenziwe unyaka wonke.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethiIKhabhinethi iyivumile indlela lebuyeketiwe yekwetfula kucala kusebenta kweMkamo weLuhlelo Lwekutfutsa Tekusakata Tiye Ekusakateni Ngekwedijithali.
tgt: Masisebenziseni iNyanga Yezokuthutha ukugubha nokubuyisa isikompilo lokuthi abantu bagibelisane emotweni eyodwa uma beya emsebenzini esikhundleni sokuthi umuntu ngamunye azihambele ngemoto yakhe ukuze kuncishiswe isiminyaminya sezimoto emigwaqeni yakuleli.

src: Lendlela ilandzela sichamkelo lesichutjwa yimakethe/batsengi ngekusebentisana kanye nebudlelwane nemkhakha lotimele netimboni.
tgt: Ukuphepha kusalokhu kuyinselele emgwaqeni yakuleli, futhi abashayeli kanye nabantu abahamba ngezinyawo kumele bayisebenzise ngokucophelela imigwaqo yomphakathi.

src: Ngekusebentisa lendlela, hulumende ngeke aphindze atimbandzakanya ekutsengeni lama-set-top-box, kuwagcina, kuwahambisa kanye nekuwafaka.
tgt: ImiyalezoAmazwi okuhalaliselaIsibonakude seNingizimu Afrika esisebenza ngamagagasi omoya, i-MeerKAT, sizoba yingxenye ye-Breakthrough Listen, okuwuhlelo lwamazwe ngamazwe lokucinga nokuthungatha izimpawu zezidalwa eziphilayo emkhathini.

src: Ledokhumenti ichaza ngenchubekelembili lecuketse lwatiso jikelele, emaphuzu kanye netibalobalo letimayelana nekugcina kweNingizimu Afrika tibophelelo letisayinwe etivumelwaneni letiyimfica taMhlabuhlangene.
tgt: I-MeerKAT, okuyisibonakude seNingizimu Afrika esisebenza ngamagagasi omoya esinezindishi ezingama-64, esethulwa ngoNtulikazi kulo nyaka, yisibonakude esibukhali kunazo zonke izibonakude zohlobo olufanayo emhlabeni wonke jikelele.

src: Imikhosi LetakoSitatimende Senchubomgomo yeSabelotimali Sethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTBPS)Indvuna Yetetimali Tito Mboweni utakwetfula Sitatimende Senchubomgomo yeSabelotimali Sethemu Lesemkhatsini, mhla tinge-24 Imphala 2018, lesitawuveta kulungiswa kwesabelotimali savelonkhe kute kucinisekiswe kusimama etimalini tahulumende.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela ithimba labacwaningi abavela eNyuvesi yase-Wits abenze ukufakelwa kwesibindi okuyingqophamlando futhi okube yimpumelelo, ngenkathi bethatha ingxenye yesibindi kumama Onegciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) beyifaka kumntwana wakhe ongenayo i-HIIthimba lodokotela belibandakanya uSlz Jean Botha, Dkt Francesca Conradie, Dkt Harriet Etheredge, Dkt June Fabian kanye noSlz Caroline Tiemessen.

src: Inyanga Yetekutfutsa Luhlelo lwalonyaka lweNyanga yeTekutfutsa lutawugcizelela kubaluleka kwesakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa, njengetaselwandle, tasemoyeni, tajantji kanye nemkhakha wetemgwaco njengetikhutsati tekukhula kwemnotfo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela abantu base-Equatorial Guinea emgubhweni wama-50 wenkululeko yabo.

src: Asisebentiseni lenyanga kugubha kanye nekubuyisa lisiko lekusebentisa emacembu ekugibelisana etimotini nasiya emisebentini kute sinciphise siminyaminya lesibakhona emigwacweni.
tgt: Amazwi enduduzo IKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini, abangani kanye nozakwabo bakaNgqongqoshe Wezemvelo u-Boma Edna Molewa osesishiyile emhlabeni.

src: Kuphepha emigwacweni yetfu kusaseyinsayeya, bashayeli kanye nalabahamba ngetinyawo kufanele kutsi basebentise imigwaco yawonkhewonkhe ngekucophelela.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Molewa wazibonakalisa ngomsebenzi wakhe omuhle ezikhundleni eziningi abethweswe zona kanye nasemikhankasweni yobushoshovu abeyishabashekela, kusukela kwigalelo lakhe emzabalwazweni wenkululeko yethu kuya kubushoshovu bakhe bokulwela amalungelo abesifazane alinganayo ezweni lethu.

src: ImilayetoKulalaliselaIthelesikobhu yemagagasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, i-MeerKAT, itawuhlangana ne-Breakthrough Listen, lokungumtamo wemave emhlaba wekufuna timphawu temphilo emhlabeni wonkhe nasezulwini.
tgt: Futhi ubeyisishabasheki sikazwelonke nesomhlaba wonke jikelele ebesilwela ukuphathwa kahle kwemvelo ukuze sibe nomhlaba osimeme oyothokozelwa yibo bonke abantu futhi bahlalisane kahle kuwona.

src: Loku kukhomba kwatiswa ngemave emhlaba kwelikhono kanye nesakhiwonchanti setfu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo kuhulumeni nabantu base-Indonesia.

src: Ithelesikobhu yemagagasi yaseNingizimu Afrika i-MeerKAT lenetindishi letinge-64, yetfulwe ngalokusemtsetfweni ngaKholwane kulomnyaka, iluhlobo lwethelesikobhu lenemandla kakhulu emhlabeni yekuva tintfo letikhashane.
tgt: Uhulumeni usethembisile ukuthi uzoleseka futhi alilekelele leliya lizwe, lapho kudingeke khona, futhi iKhabhinethi liyabancoma impela abahlinzeki bosizo abavela eNingizimu Afrika abayingxenye yemizamo yokulekelela nokuhlinzeka ngosizo esiqhingini sase-Indonesia, i-Sulawesi, esikhahlanyezwe wukuzamazama komhlaba kanye ne-tsunami.

src: IKhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla tinge-24 Imphala 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangana walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-24 kuMfumfu 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Tindzaba Talelive.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Sitatimende Senchubomgomo Yesabelotimali Sethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTBPS).
tgt: Isitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS).

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela i-MTBPS yekucala yeNdvuna yeteTimali Tito Mboweni, legcile embonweni locinile lotsi iNingizimu Afrika ingavuselelwa kabusha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela i-MTBPS yokuqala kaNgqongqoshe Wezezimali uTito Mboweni, ebesisuselwa enkolelweni enkulu yokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ingavuselelwa.

src: Le-MTBPS yanga-2018 ikhomba bumatima kutemnotfo kanye netincumo letiphatselene netimali tahulumende, hulumende latawubukana nato kuleminyaka lemitsatfu letako.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowezi-2018 icaphuna ubunzima uhulumeni abhekene nabo ezinqumweni okumele azithathe kwezomnotho kanye nakwimali kahulumeni eminyakeni emithathu ezayo.

src: Kukhula kwemnotfo nga-2018 kwehlile kwasuka ku-1.5% kwaya ku-0.7%, kantsi simo semnotfo wemave emhlaba wonkhe solomane asikagucuki futsi loko kuyinsayeya emaveni lasafufusa.
tgt: Ukukhula kwezomnotho konyaka wezi-2018 kubuyekeziwe kwasuka ku-1.5% kwaya ku-0.7%, futhi isimo somhlaba jikelele siqhubeka nokuba nezingqinamba kwezomnotho emazweni asafufusa.

src: Le-MTBPS yanga-2018 inemtselela lomuhle kuloluhlelo lwaMengameli lwemvusamnotfo neluhlelo lwekubuyisa, lolutawusekelwa kutinta etimalini letiphatselene nahulumende kanye nekusimama etimalini.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowezi-2018 iqalisa ukusimamisa kanye nohlelo lukahulumeni lokuvusesela nokugqugquzela ukusimama komnotho, oluzosekelwa uzinzo lwesikhwamamali sikahulumeni kanye nolwezimali.

src: Hulumende utimisele macondzana nekusimama kwetimali letiphatselene nahulumende, kodvwa kube nekuyekelela kusukela kwetfulwa Sabelotimali sa-2018 ngeNdlovana kulomnyaka.
tgt: Uhulumeni uqhubeka nokuzibophezela ekusimamiseni isikhawamamali sikahulumeni, kodwa kube nokuchezuka okuncane selokhu sethulwa kuSabelomali sowezi-2018 kuNhlolanja kulo nyaka.

src: Hulumende utimisele ekwenteni kutsi kube nekusimama nekutsi futsi kwehle tikweleti.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokuzibophezela ekuzinziseni nasekwehliseni isikweletu sezwe.

src: Ngekubuka simo lesimatima setemnotfo kanye simondzawo setimali letiphatselene nahulumende, lokwabiwa kwetimali lokuphakanyisiwe kubeka embili tindleko leticondzene netinhlelo tekutfutfukisa tenhlalo letisekela imfundvo lesisekelo, temphilo, tenhlalakahle, emanti kuhanjiswa kwekungcola ngemanti kanye nagezi.
tgt: Njengoba kuncipha umthwalo osindayo kwezomnotho kanye nasesimweni sesikhwamamali sikahulumeni, ukwahlukaniswa kwengeniso okuphakanyiswayo kuyaqhubeka nokubeka eqhulwini izinhlelo zokusebenzisa imali emphakathini njengemfundo eyisisekelo, ezempilo, ezenhlalakahle, amanzi, ukuthuthwa kwendle kanye nezinsiza zikagesi.

src: Ingcungcutsela yaMengameli Yetemphilo.
tgt: Ingqungquthela Yezempilo KaMongameli.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela yeNgcungcutsela yaMengameli Yetemphilo lenhlose kulungisa tinsayeysa letahlukahlukene luhlelo lwahulumende lwetemphilo lolubukene nato.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela imiphumela yeNgqungquthela Yezempilo KaMongameli ehlose ukudingida izinselele ezinhlobonhlobo eziqondene nohlelo lwezempilo lomphakathi.

src: Letincumo letitawutsatfwa kuleNgcungcutsela titawucinisa emalungiselelo ekucala kusebenta kweMshwalensi weteMphilo waVelonkhe (i-NHI).
tgt: Imiphumela izoqinisa amalungiselelo okuqalisa uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (i-NHI).

src: Kubuyeketa temhlaba.
tgt: Uguquko kwezomhlaba.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kucala kwekusebenta kwekubuyeketwa kwemhlaba kanye netinhlelo tekubuyisela kwawo kubanikati ngekulungisa umonakalo wesikhatsi lesengcile nekusita kutsi kukhule umnotfo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukuqaliswa kwezinhlelo zoguquko nokubuyiselwa komhlaba eziqhutshwa ngokulinganayo eziqondene nemisebenzi nokungalungi kwesikhathi esedlule futhi lisiza ukukhulisa umnotho.

src: Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa bekahola umcimbi wekubuyiselwa kwemhlaba kubanikati, lapho emahektha langetulu kwala-4 586 emhlaba lanikwe ummango waKaMkwanazi eMpangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa uhole umcimbi wokubuyiswa komhlaba, lapho kunikezelwe ngamahektha ayizi-4 586 omhlaba emphakathini waKwaMkhwanazi eMpangeni, KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Ummango waKaMkwanazi utawuphindza futsi utfole tibonelelo letitfolakala emuva kwekunikwa umhlaba kanye nekwesekelwa lokutawubasita kutsi basebentise ngalokusezingeni lelisetulu emandla alomhlaba.
tgt: Umphakathi waKwaMkhwanazi uzothola nezabelo ezilandela ukubuyiswa komhlaba kanye nokwesekwa okuzowusiza usebenzise yonke ingcebo ongase uyithole kulowa mhlaba.

src: Loku kuyindlela yekutsi imimango isuke ekubeni balimi labalimela kutondla nje bona kodvwa balimele kutsengisa njengebanikati bemabhizinisi kuto tonkhe tinchubo tekukhicita ngalomhlaba wabo.
tgt: Lokhu kushintsha imiphakathi esebenzela ukuziphilisa ibambe iqhaza kwezohwebo futhi ibe ngabanikazi bamabhizinisi kuyo yonke imisebenzi evela kwezolimo kanye nengcebo engatholakala emhlabeni wabo.

src: Hulumende utinikele kutsi asekele kusimama kwemabhizinisi etekulima lasafufusa, lokufaka ekhatsi imiklamo lenge-262 lehambisana nekubuyeketwa kwemhlaba kute kuzuze lusha nabomake kuto tonkhe tifundza.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzinikele ekwesekeni ukusimamiswa kwamabhizinisi ezolimo aqubukayo, okubandakanya imisebenzi engama-262 ehambisana nokuguqulwa komhlaba ukuze kuhlomule intsha kanye nabantu besifazane kuzo zonke izifundazwe.

src: Konelwa phasi kwetakhiwonchanti tahulumende.
tgt: Ukubhidlizwa kwengqalasizinda yomphakathi.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kukhatsateka kwayo mayelana nekonelwa phasi kwesakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulise ukukhathazeka ngokubhidlizwa kwengqalasizinda yezokuthutha.

src: Loku kubuyisela emuva kutinikela kwahulumende ekuletseni tinsita emimangweni lebeyinganakwa phambilini.
tgt: Lokhu kubukela phansi ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuhambiseni izinsiza emiphakathini eyayiphucwe amathuba ngaphambilini.

src: Kute kungajabuli lokukhulu kangako ngendlela yekutsi kungaholela ekutseni kunelwe phasi imphahla yahulumende.
tgt: Ayikho intukuthelo engasetshenziswa njengesizathu sokubhidliza impahla yomphakathi.

src: Lokonela phasi lokunje kuncisha labaphuyile tinsita labatidzinga kakhulu.
tgt: Lokhu kubhidlizwa kwempahla kuphuca abampofu inqwaba yezinsiza eziyizidingongqangi.

src: IKhabhinethi icela sive kutsi sicaphele futsi sisebentisane nema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo kute kutsi labo labenta loko baboshwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa amalungu omphakathi ukuthi aqaphele futhi asebenzisane nezinhlaka zomthetho ukuze labo abaphula umthetho babhekana nengalo yomthetho.

src: IKhabhinethi, iyakucaphela futsi kutsi Iklasta yeBulungiswa Yetekuvikela Bugebengu netekuPhepha itawubukana naloludzaba ngendlela lefanele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde laveza ukuthi iQoqwana Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvikelwa Kobugebengu Nezokuvikela lizobhekana kanjani nalolu daba ngokufanele.

src: Inchubo yekubekwa esikhundleni kweMcondzisi weMkandlu Wetebushushisi Wavelonkhe (i-NDPP) IKhabhinethi iyemukele lendlela lensha yekubekwa esikhundleni kwe-NDPMengameli Ramaphosa ukhetse Iphaneli Yekweluleka kutsi ibone iphindze futsi ibambe ingcoco yeluhlolokhono nalabo bantfu lababonakala bafanele kutsi batsatse lesikhundla sekuba yiNhloko yeMkandlu Wetebushushisi Wavelonkhe (i-NPA).
tgt: Inqubo yokuqokwa KukaMqondisi Wephiko Lwezokushushisa Kuzwelonke (i-NDPP) IKhabhinethi lamukele indlela entsha yokuqoka u-NDPUMongameli Ramaphosa uqoke Ithimba Labeluleki elizohlonza futhi libambe imposambuso nabantu abafanelekile ukuthi bangathatha isikhundla sokuba yiNhloko yoPhiko Lwezokushushisa Kuzwelonke (i-NPA).

src: Lephaneli ibambe umhlangano wayo kwekucala kuleliviki kantsi ilindzeleke kutsi ingenise kuMengameli emagama alabo labahlungiwe mhla ti-07 Ingongoni Sijubo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo.1 IKhabhinethi icocile ngeSijubo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo lesimayelana nekusebentisa, kulima kanye nekuphatsa insangu kwemuntfu lomdzala ngasese kuti atisebentisele yena ngekwakhe kanye nelifutse lalesijubo.
tgt: Ithimba lisebenze okokuqala kuleli sonto futhi kulindeleke ukuthi lithumele amagama abantu abakhethwe njengalabo abangase bafanelwe ukuthatha lesi sikhundla kuMongameli ngomhla ziyi-7 kuZibandlela 2018.

src: Emalunga emmango acelwa kutsi asifundze kahle lesijubo ngobe kusetjentiswa kwensangu endzaweni yemmango akukavunyelwa.
tgt: Isinqumo Senkantolo YoMthethosisekelo.1 IKhabhinethi lenze izethulo ngeSinqumo Senkantolo yoMthethosisekelo esiqondene nokusetshenziswa, ukulinywa nokuphathwa kwensangu ngabantu abadala ngasese bezisebenzisele ngokwabo kanye nomthelela wako.

src: Kwengeta kuloko, lesijubo asizange sisho kutsi akusasilo licala kutsengisa insangu.2 IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kutsi lesijubo sibekwe ngekubuka leminye imitsetfo lengalandzelwa macondzana nekusetjentiswa, kuphatsa kanye nekulima insangu.
tgt: Kucelwa ukuthi amalungu omphakathi azijwayeze lesi sinqumo njengoba ukusetshenziswa kwensangu emphakathini kungavumelekile.

src: IKhabhinethi isafuna seluleko macondzana naloludzaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lisabonisana nongoti ngalolu daba.

src: Ingcungcutsela Yekuphepha Etikolweni.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yezokuphepha Ezikoleni.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela leNgcungcutsela yeKuphepha eTikolweni lesandza kubakhona lebeyiholwa yiNdvuna yeTemfundvo Lesisekelo Angie Motshekga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela iNgqungquthela Yezokuphepha Ezikoleni esanda kubanjwa ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo u-Angie Motshekga.

src: Lengcungcutsela ihlangise ndzawonye betemfundvo kanye nalabatsintsekako bangephandle kute kutfolwe likhambi lelicondzene netindzaba tekuphepha tikolo talelive letibukene nato kanye nekuhlahla indlela leya embili yekwenta kutsi kube nekuphepha etikolweni.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ihlanganise ababambiqhaza kwezemfundo nabazimele ukuthola izisombululo ngezinkinga zezokuphepha eziqondene nezikole ezweni kanye nokusungula indlela ebheke phambili yokwakha izimo eziphephile esikoleni.

src: Loku kulandzela tehlakalo tebudlova letenteke kuletinye tikolo, lokufaka ekhatsi kushona kwathishela loneminyaka lenge-24 budzala, Umnu Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, lowagwazwa ngumfundzi wambulala lapha esikolweni saseRamotshere Secondary School eZeerust, eNyakatfo Nshonalanga.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela izigameko zodlame ezehle ezikoleni ezithile, okubandakanya ukubulawa ngesihluku kukathisha oneminyaka engama-24, uMnu.

src: Bonkhe labatsintsekako bavumelene ngekutsi budlova nje jikelele, kodvwa kakhulu etikolweni, abemukeleki nekutsi kudzinga kutsi kubanjisanwe kucinisekisa kutsi tikolo tibayindzawo lephephile yebafundzi nabothishela.
tgt: Bonke ababambiqhaza bavuma ukuthi udlame jikelele, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni, alwamukelekile nhlobo nokuthi kudingeka kuqhutshekwe nokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole ziba yindawo ephephile kubafundi nothisha.

src: Luhlolo lwamatekuletjeni IKhabhinethi ibafisela lokuhle bonkhe bafundzi, ikakhulu labo labafundza Libanga le-12, ngalesikhatsi.
tgt: Izivivinyo zikamatikuletsheni IKhabhinethi lifisela bonke abafundi, ikakhulukazi abafundi beBanga le-12, okumhlophe kulesi sikhathi.

src: Kutawuba kwekucala kutsi, litiko kulomnyaka libhalise luhlolo lweLulwimi lwaseNingizimu Afrika lweTimphawu (i-SASL) ezingeni leLulwimi lwaseKhaya bafundzi labange-58 labangeva etindlebeni labasetikolweni letili-10.
tgt: Okokuqala ngqa, kulo nyaka uMnyango uzoba nesivivinyo sokuhlolela uLimi Lwezimpawu lwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SASL) ezingeni loLimi Lwasekhaya esizobhalwa abafundi abangama-58 abangezwa kahle ezikoleni eziyi-10.

src: Loluhlolo lutawuchubeka emaviki lasihlanu nesigamu bese luphela mhla tinge-28 Lweti.
tgt: Lezi zivivinyo zizodonsa isikhathi esingamasonto amahlanu nohhafu futhi sizophela mhla zingama-28 kuLwezi.

src: Bafundzi kulolonkhe lelive batawusayina ngekutsandza sibopho nome sifungo sekwetsemba ngesikhatsi seluhlolo ngekutsi bangatimbandzakanyi kunome ngabe ngusiphi sento sekungatiphatsi kahle.
tgt: Abafundi ezweni lonke bazosayina isifungo esingaphoqelekile sokuzinikela ukuhlonipha isithunzi sezivivinyo ngokungayephuli imibandela yezivivinyo.

src: Batali nebondli bebantfwana bayagcugcutelwa kutsi basekele bafundzi ngalesikhatsi sabo lesimcoka eluhambeni lwabo lwetemfundvo.
tgt: Abazali nababheki bezingane bakhuthazwa ukuthi babeseke abafundi ngalesi sikhathi esibucayi ohambweni lwabo lwezemfundo.

src: Kubalulekile futsi bakhutsatwe bafundzi kutsi basicedze sikolo singabashipheli.
tgt: Kubalulekile nokuthi kukhuthazwe abafundi ukuthi basiqede isikole.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethi.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kumenyetelwa ngalokusemtsetfweni kweTindzawo taseLwandle Letinge-20 Letivikelekile (ema-MPA) njengencenye ye-Operation Phakisa: Luhlakamsebenti Lolumelele ema-MPA eMnotfo waseLwandle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukunqunywa kweziNdawo Zasolwandle Ezivikelekile (ama-MPA) ezingama-20 njengengxenye yeNethiwekhi Emelwe yama-MPA ye-Operation Phakisa: Umnotho Wasolwandle.

src: Inzuzo yalokukhetfwa, kutsi, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, kutawuvumela kutsi kube nentfutfuko kutekuvakasha letivikela imvelo kanye nekukhutsata kutsi kufinyeleleke kumitfombolusito lelawulekako lesimeme yetinhlanti letisilinganiso lesincane.
tgt: Umhlomulo womsebenzi ongenzelwe, phakathi kokunye, uzovumela ukuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kwezokuvakasha okuqondene nezemvelo kanye nokukhuthazwa kokufinyelela ezinsizeni zabadobi abadobela ukuziphilisa eziphethwe ngendlela esimamisayo.

src: Lokukhetfwa lokuphakanyisiwe kuta ngemuva kwekukhulumisana emkhatsini walabatsintsekako labafanele.
tgt: Imisebenzi ehlongozwayo yazalwa izingxoxo zokubonisana nababambiqhaza abafanele.

src: Lama-MPA atawushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende.
tgt: Ama-MPA azoshicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni.

src: IKhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlelo lweKwenta lwaVelonkhe (i-NAP) lweSibili Lolubuyeketiwe Lacondzaniswa lwaseNingizimu Afrika lweKulwa neBugwadvule, Kwehla kweMandla eMhlaba ekuKhicita kanye nekuNciphisa Imitselela Lemibi yeSomiso (2018-2030).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze uHlelo Lwemisebenzi Kazwelonke (i-NAP) Yesibili Olubuyekeziwe Noluhambisanayo lweNingizimu Afrika ukuNqanda Ukwanda Kwezindawo Eziwugwadule, Ukumoshakala Komhlaba kanye Nokungenelela kuMthelela Wesomiso (2018-2030).

src: Le-NAP ihlose kufaka ligalelo ekongeni kanye nasekusetjenytisweni ngendlela lesimeme kwemhlaba wetfu kanye naleminye imitfombolusito yemvelo.
tgt: I-NAP ihlose ukuba nomthelela ekugcineni nasekusetshenzisweni ngendlela esimeme komhlaba wethu kanye nezinye izinsiza zemvelo.

src: INingizimu Afrika itivume ngalokusemtsetfweni Sivumelwane saMhlabuhlangene (i-UN) seKulwa neBugwadvule sanga-1997.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika yavumelana ngokusemthethweni neSivumelwano Sokunqanda Ukwakheka Kogwadule kweNhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe (i-UN) ngowe-1997.

src: Ngekulandzela iSigaba se-9 salesivumelwane, emave alindzeleke kutsi asungule futsi acale kusebentisa i-NAP njengencenye lemcoka yendlelalisu lekulwa nebugwadvule nekunciphisa imitselela yesomiso.
tgt: NgokweSiqephu 9 sesivumelwano, abathintekayo kumele basungule, balungise futhi baqalise i-NAP njengesakhi esibaluleke kakhulu sesu lokunqanda ukuqedwa kwamahlathi futhi kungenelelwe emtheleleni wesomiso.

src: INingizimu Afrika yasungula i-NAP yayo yekucala nga-2004.Imitsetfosivivinyo.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika yasungula i-NAP yayo yokuqala ngowe-2004.IMithethosivivinywa.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibela Letiphatselene neBantfwana kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Oyisichibiyelo Wezingane kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze kutholakale izimvo zomphakathi.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kucinisa kusebentisana emkhatsini kwekunakekela bantfwana kanye neluhlelo lwekubavikela ngekusebentisa kuhlanganisa kusebentisana emkhatsini wematiko nemikhakha.
tgt: UMthethosivivinyo uhlose ukuqinisa ukudidiyelwa kohlelo lokunakekelwa nokuvikelwa kwezingane ngokuhlanganyela neminyango kanye nemikhakha ehlukahlukene.

src: Letichibelo tiphendvula Sijubo seNkantolo Lephakeme yaseNyakatfo Gauteng sangaLweti 2017, lapho Litiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle layalwa kutsi lilungise liphindze letfule tichibelo letidzingekile eMtsetfweni weBantfwana, wanga-2005 (Umtsetfo Longunombolo ye-38 wanga-2005) acondzana nekulawulwa kweluhlelo lwekukhuliswa kwemntfwana ngumuntfu longasuye umtali.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zilandela iSinqumo Senkantolo Ephakeme yaseNyakatho Gauteng sakuLwezi 2017, lapho uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi wayalelwa ukuthi ulungise futhi wethule izichibiyelo ezidingekayo zoMthetho Wezingane, wezi-2005 (uMthetho 38 wezi-2005) maqondana nesisombululo sezomthetho esiqondene nokuphathwa kohlelo lokukhuliswa kwezingane ngabantu abangazizali.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibela Tinsita Temaposi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lagunyaza ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinywa Oyisichibiyelo Wezinsizakalo Zeposi ePhalamende.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawunika emandla Inchubomgomo Lehlongotwako yaVelonkhe yeThekhinoloji Yelwati Lwetekuchumana (i-ICT) leHlanganisiwe leyavunywa yiKhabhinethi ngeNyoni 2016.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinyo uqalisa uMthetho Odingidwayo WeNqubomgomo Edidiyele Kuzwelonke Yolwazi Lwezobuchwepheshe Kwezokuxhumana (i-ICT) owagunyazwa iKhabhinethi kuMandulo 2016.Imiphumela okuphokophelwe kuyo wukuba yiPosi LaseNingizimu Afrika elinomsebenzi wokubhekana nomncintiswano, elisebenzayo nelisimeme futhielilawula yonke imisebenzi yeposi nengafinyelela kubo bonke abantu kanye nokuguqulwa komkhakha wezeposi.

src: Imiphumela lehlosiwe kutsi kube neLiposi laseNingizimu Afrika lelikhona kuchudzelana, lelisebentako nalelisimeme leliletsa tinsita letibanti lelinekufinyeleleka kanye nekuntjintja kwemkhakha wetemaposi.
tgt: UMthethosivivinyo uhlinzeka ngendlela yokunika imiphakathi yasemakhaya neqhuba izinqubo zesintu amakheli asemakhaya.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo futsi wenta kutsi kube nendlela yekunika imimango yasetindzaweni tasemaphandleni neyendzabuko emakheli.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinyo sewudlulile esigabeni sokubonisana nomphakathi.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo sekuvele kuboniswene ngawo nemmango.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Ikhomfa yaseNingizimu Afrika yeMave eMhlaba yeLutjalotimaliMengameli Ramaphosa ngaLesihlanu, mhla tinge-26 Imphala 2018, utawube angusihlalo wekuvulwa kweKhomfa yekucala yaseNingizimu Afrika yeLutjalotimali lapha eSandton Convention Centre eJozi.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yotshalomali Lomhlaba Jikelele YaseNingizimu AfrikaNgoLwesihlanu, mhla zingama-26 kuMfumfu 2018, uMongameli Ramaphosa uzosingatha iNgqungquthela Yotshalomali Yokuqala eNingizimu Afrika eSandton Convention Centre eGoli.

src: Loku kuyincenye yemitamo lehlangisiwe yekuheha batjalitimali kanye nekukhulisa umnotfo wetfu.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yokuhlanganiswa kwemisebenzi yokuheha nokukhulisa umnotho wethu.

src: Kwengeta, labane labamelele lutjalotimali labakhetfwe nguMengameli batakwetfula umbiko kulekhomfa mayelana nenchubekelembili leyentekile.
tgt: Phezu kwalokho, amanxusa amane kwezotshalomali aqokwe uMongameli azokwethula umbiko engqungqutheleni ngenqubekela phambili asebe nayo.

src: Ingcungcutsela yeMave Langemashumi Lamabili (i-G20) Mengameli Ramaphosa umenywe nguNdvunankulu waseGermany, Dkt.
tgt: Ingqungquthela yaMazwe Angamashumi Amabili (i-G20)UMongameli Ramaphosa umenywe uNdunankulu wase-Germany, uDkt.

src: Angela Merkel, kutsi abemdzibi munye eNgcungcutseleni ye-G20 Yelutjalotimali – emabhizinisi aseGermany nemave angemalunga eSivumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA), kanye neNkhulumiswano yeteMabhizinisi, kokubili kutawubanjelwa eBerlin, eGermany mhla tinge-30 Imphala 2018.LeNgcungcutsela Ye-G20 Yelutjalotimali itawuhlanganisa ndzawonye emabhizinisi aseGermany kanye neMave angemalunga e-CwA kute ahlwaye ematfuba elutjalotimali ngaphasi kweluhlakamsebenti lweBudlelwane be-G20 ne-Afrika.
tgt: Angela Merkel, ukuthi abambe iqhaza eNgqungqutheleni yoTshalomali ye-G20 - Amabhizinisi ase-German kanye naMazwe Angamalunga Esivumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA), kanye noMhlangano Wezamabhizinisi, zombili ezizobanjelwa e-Berlin, eGermany mhla zingama-30 kuMfumfu 2018.

src: Batjalitimali baseGermany batakwetfula imiklamo lesezingeni lelisetulu kwanyalo leyentiwa eMaveni angemalunga e-CwA kanye nekuhlwaya ematfuba kulelivekati.
tgt: Ingqungquthela Yotshalomali ye-G20 izohlanganisa amabhizinisi ase-German namazwe e-CwA ukuhlola amathuba otshalomali ngaphansi kohlaka lokuHlanganyela kwe-G20 ne-Afrika.

src: Mengameli utahambela leNgcungcutsela ngemandla esikhundla sekuba nguSihlalo Ngekuhlanganyela weLicembu Lekweluleka lase-Afrika le-LeNgcungcutsela ye-G20 itawugcila etindleleni i-G20, emave ase-Afrika kanye netikhungo tentfutfuko letingasebentisana ngato ngekubambisana ekuheheni lutjalotimali lomkhakha lotimele kanye nekutimbandzakanya kutemnotfo wemave ase-Afrika.
tgt: Abatshalimali base-German bazokwethula imisebenzi eyaziwa ngayo eqhutshwa emaZweni ama-CwA futhi kubhekwe namanye amathuba ezwenikazi.

src: Lomhlangano utawuphindza futsi wente emalungiselelo eNgcungcutsela ye-G20 letawubaseBuenos Aires, e-Argentina.
tgt: UMongameli uzohambela ingqungquthela esikhundleni sakhe njengoSihlalo Obambisene Nomunye eThimbeni lase-Afrika Lokweluleka i-G. Ingqungquthela ye-G20 nge-CwA izogxila endleleni i-G20, amazwe ase-Afrika nezikhungo zentuthuko angabambisana ngayo ukukhuthaza utshalomali lomkhakha ozimele kanye nokubamba iqhaza kwezomnotho zamazwe ase-Afrika.

src: Liviki laVelonkhe Lekugcila Kutimbizo Emalunga eSigungu (iKhabhinethi) atawukutimbandzakanya kuLiviki laVelonkhe Le-9 Lekugcila Kutimbizo leLuphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Netekwatisa (i-GCIS) lwalohulumende watsatsa lulawulo nga-2014, lelitawuba mhla ti-12 kuya mhla tinge-25 Lweti 2018.
tgt: Lo mhlangano uzophinde wenze umsebenzi wokulungiselela lo mkhakha iNgqungquthela ye-G20 ezoba se-Buenos Aires, e-Argentina.

src: Loku kwenteka ngeliviki linye neLiviki lwekuBika lweLuhlelo Lwekusebenta lweKhabhinethi.
tgt: Isonto Lokugxila Ezimbizweni Kuzwelonke Amalungu Eziphathimandla (iKhabhinethi) azobamba iqhaza Esontweni lesi-9 Lokugxila Ezimbizweni Kuzwelonke loPhiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokuhlinzeka Ngolwazi (i-GCIS) ngaphansi kombuso wentando yeningi labantu owavotelwa ngowezi-2014, elizobanjwa kusukela mhla ziyi-12 kuya kumhla zingama-25 kuLwezi 2018.

src: LeLiviki Lwekugcila Kutimbizo litawunika emalunga eSigungu Savelonkhe, baholi betifundza kanye nebaholi babohulumende bendzawo inkhundla kutsi babambe imihlangano nemimango kanye neTimbizo eveni nje lonkhe, kulesikhatsi, kukhombisa kutsi hulumende ucala njani kusebentisa Luhlakamsebenti lweNdlelalisu yeThemu leseMkatsini (i-MTSF) ya-2014-2019 kanye nekuphendvula leto tindzaba letiphakanyiswa takhamuti, letinelifutse kutekuphepha, kukhula nekutfutfukisa imimango yetfu.
tgt: Isonto Lokugxila Ezimbizweni lizohlinzekela Iziphathimandla Kuzwelonke kanye nabaholi bezifundazwe nabakahulumeni wasekhaya ngenkundla yokubamba imihlangano yomphakathi kanye neZimbizo ezweni lonke, ngalesi sikhathi, ukubonakalisa ukuqalisa kukahulumeni uHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTSF) lwezi-2014-2019 nokubhekana nezinkinga eziphakanyiswe izakhamizi, ezinomthelela kwezokuphepha, ukukhula kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi.

src: Lamaviki lamabili etimbizo enteka ngemuva kwemigubho yelikhulu leminyaka yemachawe eMzabalazo, Make Albertina Sisulu naBabe Nelson Mandela, bobabili bayinkhomba yekukhombisa kubaluleka kwekubonisana ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi kanye nekucocisana nemimango lebebayisebentela.
tgt: Amasonto amabili okubamba iqhaza azongena lapho kuphela imibungazo yeminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa Izishoshovu zomzabalazo uMama Albertina Sisulu noTata Nelson Mandela, okwakuyibantu ababebeka phambili ukuvama kokubonisana nokuxhumana nemiphakathi ababesebenza kuyo.

src: Imilayeto Kuhalalisela.
tgt: Imiyalezo Ukuhalalisa.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Indvuna Yetemphilo, Dkt.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt.

src: Aaron Motsoaledi, lozuze imiklomelo lemibili ye-Kochon, emcimbini wekunikwa lowo mklomelo lobewubanjelwe eThe Hague, eThe Netherlands.
tgt: Aaron Motsoaledi, othole imiklomelo emikhulu emibili ye-Kochon, emcimbini wokuklomelisa ngezindondo obubanjwe e-The Hague, e-The Netherlands.

src: Lomklomelo wakhe wekucala uwutfole ngendzima yakhe layidlale yena matfupha kanye nebuholi kutepolitiki ekulweni kwakhe nesifo sesifuba (i-TB) mhlaba wonkhe.
tgt: Umklomelo wokuqala uwuthole esikhundleni sakhe uqobo uNgqongqoshe ngeqhaza lakhe nobuholi kwezepolitiki ekulweni nesifo sofuba (i-TB) emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Umklomelo wesibili, Indvuna itakwabelana nawo neMhlonishwa Nick Hebert, Lilunga lePhalamende (i-MP) lase-United Kingdom, ngetikhundla tabo tekuba bosihlalo ngekuhlanganyela be-Global TB Caucus yeMalunga ePhalamende emhlaba wonkhe.
tgt: Umklomelo wesibili, uNgqongqoshe abambisene noMhlonishwa Omkhulu u-Nick Hebert, iLungu lePhalamende (i-MP) e-United Kingdom, ezikhundleni zabo zokubambisana ngokuba wosihlalo be-Global TB Causus yama-MP asemhlabeni wonke.

src: Lomklomelo we-Kochon uklonyeliswa njalo ngemnyaka kulabo bantfu nome netinhlangano letibe negalelo lelimcoka ekulweni ne-TB emaveni ato nome emhlabeni wonkhe.
tgt: UMklomelo we-Kochon kuklonyeliswa ngawo minyaka yonke kubantu ngabodwana noma nezinhlangano ezibe negalelo elikhulu ekunqandeni i-TB ezweni labo noma emhlabeni jikelele.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela umcimbi wanga-2018 wemiklomelo yemhlaba yetekuvakasha, i-World Travel Awards 2018, lovotele live laseNingizimu Afrika njengeNdzawo Lephuma Embili e-Afrika longaya kuyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ama-World Travel Awards wezi-2018 lapho kwavotelwa iNingizimu Afrika njengeNdawo Yokuvakasha Ephuma phambili.

src: IDurban leKwaZulu-Natal iphindze futsi yatiswa njengeLidolobhakati Leliphuma eMbili e-Afrika longaya kulo futsi latfola ligama lelihle lekuba yi-Leading Cruise Port e-Afrika.
tgt: Indawo yase-Durban KwaZulu-Natali yaziswa njengeDolobha Eliphuma phambili e-Afrika Kwezokuvakasha yase ithola isicoco sokuthi iCheba Lokungcebeleka Eliholayo e-Afrika.

src: IKapa eNshonalanga Kapa yona itfole ligama lekuPhuma Embili e-Afrika kuteMicimbi neMigubho.
tgt: IKapa, eNtsholanga Kapa lithole isicoco sokuba Indawo Ephuma Phambili e-Afrika Kwezemibhiyozo Nemicimbi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuboniswa e-United States mhla ti-02 Lweti 2018 kwelifilimu lalelive lelinesihloko lesitsi Nommer 37 lomkhiphi wemafilimu Joshua Bradley.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele ukubukwa okokuqala e-United States mhla zi-2 kuLwezi 2018 kwefilimu lala ekhaya elibizwa ngokuthi Nommer 37 elenziwe ngumqophimafilimu uJoshua Bradley.

src: Lelifilimu lebugebengu lelivusa lusikisiki litsetjulelwe eCape Flats lisekelwe ngetimali Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni ngekusebentisa sikimu sekukhutsata bakhiphi bemafilimu labamnyama baseNingizimu Afrika labasafufusa, i-South African Emerging Black Filmmakers Incentive Scheme.
tgt: Le filimu ekhuluma ngobugebengu eqoshelwe eCape Flats yaxhaswa uMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni ngohlelo i-South African Emerging Black Filmmakers Incentive.

src: Loku kutawuba neligalelo ekuheheni lutjalotimali loluvela emaveni angephandle kutsi lungene ngco embonini yemafilimu yaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoba negalelo ekuheheni utshalomalingqo olubuya kumazwe angaphandle lungena embonini yezamafilimu yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kudvudvuta.
tgt: Amazwi Enduduzo.

src: IKhabhinethi nayo njengaMengameli Ramaphosa ivakalisa emavi ayo ekudzabuka: ngekushona kabuhlungu kwebantfu labangetulu kwalabange-27, engotini yekushayisana kwetimoti letinyenti emgwacweni longu-N1 North eLimpopo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihlanganyela noMongameli Ramaphosa ukudlulisa ubuhlungu namazwi enduduzo: ngokudlula kabuhlungu kwabantu abangaphezu kwama-27, ezingozini zezimoto eziningi ku-N1 North eLimpopo.

src: Labasebentisa umgwaco bayacelwa kutsi basebentise umgwaco ngekucophelela futsi bacinisekise kutsi bayayihlonipha ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi imitsetfo yemgwaco.
tgt: Abasebenzisi bomgwaqo banxushwa ukuthi baqaphele emigwaqweni yethu futhi kumele baqinisekise ukuthi bathobela imithetho yomgwaqo ngaso sonke isikhathi.

src: ngekushona kwelichawe leMzabalazo, Make Agnes Msimang.
tgt: ngokudlula emhlabeni kweqhawe loMzabalazo, uMama Agnes Msimang.

src: Make Msimang bekasishikashiki sebulili lesitinikele futsi aLisekelamengameli laphambilini lembutfo wabomake waKhongolose, i-African National Congress Women’s League.
tgt: UMama Msimang wayezibophezele ekubeni isishoshovu sezobulili kanye nePhini likaMongameli we-African National Congress (i-ANC) Women's League.

src: Bekangulomunye wabomake labangabalwa labahlanganisa imimango yabo kulo lonkhe laseNingizimu Afrika kutsi ilwe nembuso welubandlululo.
tgt: Ubengomunye wabantu besifazane abaningi abanxenxa imiphakathi eNingizimu Afrika iyonke ukuthi balwisane nombuso wobandlululo.

tgt: Uzofihlwa ngoLwesihlanu, mhla zingama-26 kuMfumfu.

src: Inkonzo yemngcwabo itawucala ngensimbi ye-08:00 lapha e-Our Lady of Cedars Catholic Church eWoodmead, eJozi.
tgt: Inkonzo yomgcwabo izoqala ngelesi-08:00 e-Our Lady Cedars Catholic Church eWoodmead, eGoli.

src: ngekusishiya emhlabeni kwelichawe lelidzala leMzabalazo nelelaklonyeliswa ngemklomela wesive, i-Order of Mendi for Bravery in Silver, Umnu Eric “Stalin” Mtshali.
tgt: ngokudlula kweqhawe loMzabalazo futhi elamukeliswa indondo, i-National Order of Mendi for Bravery in Silver, uMnu.

tgt: Eric "Stalin" Mtshali.

tgt: ngokudlula kweqhawe le-ANC uMoss Chikane.

tgt: Ngowe-2005, waqokwa njengeNxusa leseNingizimu Afrika e-Germany.

src: Mk Palme bekangumfelokati waNdvunankhulu waphambilini waseSweden Olof Palme lowabulawa ngekuhlaselwa nga-1986 kantsi Mengameli Ramaphosa umchaze “njengeMngani weNingizimu Afrika”.

tgt: AbaqashiweBonke abaqashiwe kumele kuqinisekiswe iziqu zabo futhi bahlolwe ngokufanele.

src: IBhodi yaka-SENTECH SOC LIMITED: a. Mk Maureen Makole Manyama (umcondzisi longekho esigungwini lesiphetse) kanyeb.
tgt: IBhodi leSENTECH SOC LIMITED: a. UNksz.

src: NaMk Precious Nompumelelo Sibiya (umcondzisi longekho esigungwini lesiphetse).
tgt: Maureen Makole Manyama (umqondisi ongasiyona ingxenye yesigungu seziphathimandla) kanyeb.

src: IKhabhinethi ihlangene ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-7 Lweti 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-7 kuLwezi 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Tindzaba Letimcoka.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Ingcungcutsela Lephatselene Nekuhlukunyetwa Ngekwebulili Nekubulawa Kwalabasikati IKhabhinethi yamukela letingcogco letibe yimphumelelo teNgcungcutsela Lephatselene Nekuhlukunyetwa Ngekwebulili Nekubulawa Kwalabasikati lebeyibanjwe mhla lu-01 kuya kumhla ti-02 kuLweti.
tgt: INgqungquthela KaMongameli Yodlame Olubhekiswe Kubantu Bobulili Obuthile Nokubulawa Kwabantu Besifazane IKhabhinethi lamukela izingxoxo ezibe nempumelelo ezibanjwe eNgqungqutheleni KaMongameli Yodlame Olubhekiswe Kubantu Bobulili Obuthile Nokubulawa Kwabantu Besifazane ngomhla woku-1 kuya kolwe-2 kuLwezi.

src: Lengcungcutsela icinisekise lokuphutfuma bekwakhiwa kwesivumelwano sekubuketana naletikhinga tekuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili, kucwaswa kwabomake nekungalingani ngekwebulili.
tgt: INgqungquthela iqinisekise ukuthi ukuphuthuma kokuphoqa ukuvumelana ngezindlela zokubhekana nenkinga yodlame olubhekiswe kwabobulili obuthile, ukucwaswa kwabantu besifazane kanye nokungalingani ngokobulili.

src: Hulumende uvumile kubuyeketa tinhlelo tavelonkhe kute kucedvwe kuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili kanye nekubhalwa Kweluhlelo Lwekusebenta Lavelonkhe lekuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili.
tgt: UHulumeni uvume ukubuyekeza izinhlelo zikazwelonke ukuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabobulili obuthile kanye nokuthuthukiswa koHlelo Lomsebenzi LukaZwelonke ngodlame olubhekiswe kwabobulili obuthile.

src: Utawuchubeka nekuba yincenye yekwenta umsebenti nabo bonkhe labatsintsekako kucinisekisa kwekutsi sehlisa emazinga ekuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili kantsi kubuye kupheliswe ngalokugcwele.
tgt: Uzibophezele ekusebenzisaneni nabo bonke ababambiqhaza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi siwehlisa kakhulu amazinga odlame olubhekiswe kwabobulili obuthile (i-GBV) - size sibuqede nya.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebente ndzawonye kute bacale bagucule indlela yekwenta, kusebenta netikhungo letitawucedza kuhlukunyetwa kwalabasikati.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa zonke izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi zisebenzisane ukuze kushintshwe izindlela zokucabanga, izinqubo kanye nezikhungo ukuze kuqedwe udlame olubhekiswe kubantu besifazane.

src: Lutjalomali.
tgt: Utshalomali.

src: IKhabhinethi yamukela leKhomfa Yelutjalomali lebeyimphumelelo lebeyibanjwe ngenyanga yeMphala eSandton, eJozi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela iNgqungquthela Yotshalomali ebe nempumelelo ebanjwe kuMfumfu e-Sandton, eGoli.

src: LeKhomfa Yelutjalomali yente kwekutsi iNingizimu Afrika yetsenjiswe ngemali yekusisa letigidzigidziletinge-R290 yimikhakha leyehlukene yemnotfo.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yotshalomali yenze iNingizimu Afrika yakwazi ukwethenjiswa ngemali ezizigidigidi ezingama-290 zamarandi yotshalomali yimikhakha ehlukahlukene kwezomnotho.

src: Loku kungeta kulemali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi letinge-R400 iNingizimu Afrika lebeyetsenjiswe ngayo ngemave lahlukene ngalesikhatsi avakashelwe mancusa elutjalomali.
tgt: Lokhu kwengeza phezu kwemali ezizigidigidi ezingaphezu kwama-400 amarandi iNingizimu Afrika eyethenjiswe ngayo emkhankasweni wotshalomali owaqhutshwa amanxusa akhethekile otshalomali kanye namazwe anhlobonhlobo ngesikhathi ehanjelwe wuhulumeni.

src: Lekhomfa bewuhanjelwe tihambeli letingetulu kwa-1 000, letivela emaveni lange-35.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela ihanjelwe amanxusa angaphezu kwezi-1 000, ayephuma emazweni angaphezu kwama-35.

src: Umoya nenjabulo bekunyukile kantsi lakuleli likhangise ngematfuba lamasha ekusisa netinchubomgomo letisita kwakha simo lesilungele kusisa.
tgt: Umoya wawumuhle, nezwe labonakalisa amathuba amasha otshalomali kanye nezinhlelo zezinqubomgomo ezisiza ukwakha indawo elungele utshalomali oluhle.

src: IKhabhinethi ibongela lelicembu lelisebente kuleKhomfa kantsi litakutfokotela kutfola imibiko lebuyeketako njalo ekwenteni letintfo lekutsenjiswene ngato.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela ithimba elisebenze kule Ngqungquthela futhi likulangazelele ukuthola imibiko ngokuqhubekayo njalo maqondana nokufezekisa izethembiso.

src: Njengobe iNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-Afrika yonkhana bayachubeka kuhamba ngendlela lephakeme leholela ekukhuliseni umnotfo walelivekati, IKhabhinethi ibuye yamukele lokuvulwa kweNgcungcutsela Yelutjalomali yase-Afrika yekucala, lekwanyalo isachubeka kudzimate kube ngamhla ti--9 Lweti, eJozi.
tgt: Njengoba iNingizimu Afrika ne-Afrika iqhubekela phambili ekukhuliseni umnotho wezwekazi, iKhabhinethi liphinda lamukela iNgqungquthela Yotshalomali yase-Afrika yokuqala, esiqhubekayo esizophela mhla ziyi-9 kuLwezi, eGoli.

src: LeNgcungcutsela Yelutjalomali yase-Afrika ihlelwe Libhange Lentfutfuko e-Afrika (i-African Development Bank).
tgt: Ingqungquthela Yotshalomali yase-Afrika yasungulwa yiBhange Lentuthuko Lase-Afrika (i-African Development Bank).

src: Ihlose kwakhela emphumelelweni leseyivele ikhona ngekutsi ihlanganise ndzawonye basisi bemikhakha yangasese nahulumende kute basungule indlela lensha lekukhulisa umnotfo e-Afrika yonkhana.
tgt: Ngayo kuhloswe ukuba nempumelelo yamanje ngokuhlanganisa uhulumeni kanye notshalomali lwemikhakha ezimele ukuze kuqalwe indlela entsha yokukhula yeZwekazi lase-Afrika lilonke.

src: LoMhlangano we-G20 wase-Afrika losandza kubanjwa uchubeke nekusimamisa kukhula kwemnotfo wetfu ngekusebentisa kungenelela lokuhlukene lokube khona lokutfutfukisa kusisa kwabosomabhizinisi bangasese nekungenelela kumnotfo emaveni ase-Afrika njengencenye yeSivumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA).
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-G20 nge-Afrika esanda kubanjwa iqhubeka nokuxhasa amathuba okukhula ngezivumelwano ezinhlobonhlobo ezikhuthaza utshalomali lomkhakha ozimele kanye nokubamba iqhaza kwezomnotho emazweni ase-Afrika njengengxenye yeSivumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA).

src: INingizimu Afrika ingusihlalo we-CwA ngekuhlanganyela neGermany ngenca Yelicembu Lekweluleka lase-Afrika.
tgt: Isihlalo se-CwA sibanjwe ngokubambisana yiNingizimu Afrika ne-Germany ngaphansi kweThimba lase-Afrika Lokweluleka i-IKhabhinethi lamukele nokwethulwa kwemboni i-Phuthaditjhaba Industrial Park, ebize izigidi ezingama-50 zamarandi, kamuva eFreyistata ezokhuthaza imisebenzi yezimboni futhi yandise ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi nokukhula kuleso sifundazwe.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yamukela Phuthaditjhaba Industrial Park lebite imali letigizi letinge-R50 lesandza kwetfulwa esifundzeni saseFreyistata letawutfutfukisa inchubekela phambili nekwakhiwa kwematfuba emisebenti yakuleli nekukhula kwemnotfo kulesa sifundza.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linesiqiniseko sokuthi umphumela walo msebenzi kuzoba wukunciphisa izinselele zokushoda kwamathuba omsebenzi izwe elibhekene nawo, ngokuvuselela ithemba.

src: Kwakhiwa kwematfuba emsebenti.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa Kwamathuba Omsebenzi.

src: Hulumende uyangenelela ngekunyusa imitamo yekwakha ematfuba emsebenti kulusha nebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika yonkhana, kugcilwe emadolobheni nasemakhaya, kanye nemabhizinisi abomake nelusha lebavame kutfwala lomtfwalo wekubuketana netinselele letiphatselene nemnotfo.
tgt: Uhulumeni unyuse amasokisi kwezokwakhelwa kwabantu abasha kanye nezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika imisebenzi, kugxilwe emnothweni wasemalokishini nowasezindaweni zasemakhaya, kanye namabhizinisi abantu besifazane nentsha okuyibo abavame ukuthwala umthwalo wezinselele eziqondene nezomnotho.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba kwekutsi loluhlelo lwemvusamnotfo, lolutawungenisa imali lemabhiliyoni lange-R50 kumikhakha lebalulekile njengetekulima, tinsitanchanti tahulumende, iminotfo yemadolobha neyasemakhaya, lutawuletsa kukhutsata lokufanele kwekwakha ematfuba emsebenti nekutfola umnotfo losimeme.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lethemba ukuthi uhlelo lwezindlela zokungenelela, ezizofaka izigidigigi ezingama-50 zamarandi emikhakheni ebalulekile njengezolimo, ingqalasizinda yomphakathi, umnotho wasemalokishini nowasezindaweni zasemakhaya, okuzohlinzeka ngamathuba okwakha imisebenzi nokuvuselela umnotho ngendlela egcinekayo.

src: Loku kungeta kulemiphumela lebonakalako yaleNgcungcutsela Yemisebenti lapho hulumende, emabhizinisi nebetemisebenti batinikele: ekutsengeni imikhicito yakuleli kusetjentiswe indlela lenemandla yekukhulisa tintfo letitfunyelwa ngaphandle kungenelela kuluchungechunge lwetekulima nekusekela emabhizinisi lasemancane nalafufusako kute kusimamiswe imisebenti.
tgt: Lokhu kwengeza phezu kwemiphumela yeNgqungquthela Yemisebenzi lapho uhulumeni, amabhizinisi nabasebenzi izibophezele ekwenzeni okulandelayo: ukuthenga imikhiqizo yakuleli ukusebenzisa indlela enamandla ukwandisa impahla ethengiselwa amanye amazwe ukungenelela ohlelweni lwezolimo kusukela ekuqaleni komsebenzi kuya ekuthengiseni ngemikhiqizo yezolimo kanye nokwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane naphakathi nendawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ezemisebenzi.

src: IKhabhinethi ikholelwa ekutseni lokungenelela kubalulekile ekulungiseni lokutfolakele kuLuklayo Lwekota Lwetemisebenti lekota yesitsatfu yanga-2018, lolukhombisa kukhula kwemisebenti kanye nekukhula kwesibalo sebantfu labangasebenti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likholwa wukuthi lezi zinhlelo zokungenelela zibalulekile ukubhekana nokutholakele Ocwaningweni Lwezemisebenzi Lwekota lwangekota yesithathu yowezi-2018, olukhombise ukukhula kwezemisebenzi kanye nokwanda kwesibalo sabantu abangasebenzi.

src: Kuletinyanga leti-3, imisebenti leyengetiwe lenge-92 000 isunguliwe.
tgt: Esikhathini sezinyanga ezintathu, iyizi-92 000 imisebenzi eyakhiwe.

src: Noma kunjalo, bantfu labange-131 000 le ngaphambilini ‘bacedzelwa litsemba lekufuna umsebenti’ baphindze babuyela kuyofuna umsebenti kulekota, lizinga lebantfu labangasebenti libuye lakhula, nga-0.3% lafika ku-27.5%.
tgt: Nokho, ngenxa 'yabafunimsebenzi ababelahle ithemba' bangaphambilini abayizi-131 000 ababuyele ekufuneni umsebenzi, izinga lokusweleka kwemisebenzi nalo likhuphuke nge-0.3% laya kuma-27.5%.

src: Ngekusho kweLihhovisi Letelubalobalo laseNingizimu Afrika (i-StatsSA) ematfuba emsebenti akhule emkhakheni wetinsita temabhizinisi netekwakha, ngalesikhatsi kulaleka kwematfuba emsebenti kutfolakele etimayini, kutemikhicito, tekutfutsa nasemakhaya.
tgt: Ngokwesikhungo Sezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA) imisebenzi yande emkhakheni wezohwebo lwamabhizinisi nezokwakha, yaphela emkhakheni wezokuvukuza, wezokukhiqiza, wezokuthutha kanye nemizi.

src: Imisebenti kumikhakha lebhaliswe ngalokusemtsetfweni iphelile, ngalesikhatsi kumikhakha lengenasiciniseko ikhulile.
tgt: Sehlile isibalo sabantu abasebenza emkhakheni okusetshenzwa ngokugcwele kuyo, sakhuphuka emkhakheni okusetshenziswa kuwo ngokungagcwele.

src: Kubungatwa iminyaka lenge-20 yeMtsetfo Wekuncintisana IKhabhinethi inaka kwekutsi loMtsetfo Wekuncintisana uhlanganise iminyaka lenge-20 kusukela wacala kusebenta ngenyanga yeMphala nga-1998.
tgt: Ukugubha Iminyaka engama-20 yoMthetho Wezokuncintisana IKhabhinethi lazisa ukuthi uMthetho Wezokuncintisana sewufinyelele onyakeni wama-20 waqala ukusebenza kuMfumfu 1998.

src: Kuleminyaka lenge-20, lalabaphetse tekuncintisana bente inchubekelembili lenhle kakhulu ngekulwa netinhlangano letikhulisa tintsengo, kungasetjentiswa kahle kwemandla mabhizinsi lamakhulu nekuvikelwa kwemmango ngalesikhatsi kuhlanganwa.
tgt: Esikhathini seminyaka engama-20, izikhulu zezokuncintisana zibone impumelelo enkulu ekulweni nogombela kwesabo abanyusa intengo abangahambisani nokuncintisana, ukusetshenziswa ngokungafanele kwamandla ezinkampani ezinkulu kanye nokuvikelwa komphakathi ngesikhathi kuhlangana amabhizinisi.

src: Laba labaphetse babeke imali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi le-R8 yetinhlawulo etinkapani letiphula Umtsetfo.
tgt: Izikhulu zezokuncintisana zikhiphele izinkampani eziphula uMthetho izijeziso ezingaphezu kwezigididi eziyi-8 zamarandi.

src: Lihhovisi laNdvuna Wekutfutfukisa Umnotfo, ngekusebentisa uMtsetfo Wekuncintisana, lakhe imali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi le-R5 kusikhwama setimali letikhetsekile kute kutfutfukiswe emabhizinisi lasemancane, baphakeli bakuleli kanye nekungena kwebalimi labamnyama kulomkhakha wetemnotfo.
tgt: Ihhovisi likaNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho, ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezikuMthetho Wezokuncintisana, lakhe isikhwama esikhethekile sokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane, abahlinzeki bakuleli kanye nokungena kwabalimi abayibantu abansundu ohlelweni lomnotho, esinemali engaphezu kwezigidigidi eziyi-5 zamarandi.

src: IKhabhinethi ibongela labaphetse tekuncintisana ngalomsebenti lowentiwe kuvula umnotfo uvulelwe bantfu labasha nekutfutfukisa emabhizinisi nemincintiswano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela izikhulu zezokuncintisana ngomsebenzi owenziwe kwezomnotho kubabambiqhaza abasha nokukhuthaza ukusungulwa kwamabhizinisi amasha nokuncintisana.

src: Umhlangano we-18 Wemkhandlu waboNdvuna we-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA) IKhabhinethi ibongela Litiko Letebudlelwane Nekubambisana Kwemave Emhlaba ngekubungata Umhlangano we-18 Wemkhandlu waboNdvuna (i-COM) we-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA) lowabanjelwa eDurban, KwaZulu- Natal ngamhla ti-02 Lweti 2018 ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: Kuhlanganisa Bantfu base-Afrika, Asia, Australiasia naseMiddle East ngekusebentisa indlela yekusebentisana letfutfukisiwe nekuthula, Kusimama neKutfutfuka Lokusimeme”.
tgt: Umhlangano woMkhandlu woNgqongqoshe (i-COM) we-18 wenhlangano i-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA).

src: Munye walemiphumela yalomhlangano we-18 we-IORA beyiSimemetelo Lesikhetsekile sekuhlonipha Mengameli Nelson Mandela lekangulomunye webasunguli be-IORLoku kuholele ekutseni kusungulwe “luhlelo lwekucecesha le-IORA Nelson Mandela ‘Bani Ngumshiyandvuku nesibonelo semisebenti yakhe” lekulindzeleke kutsi luvulwe ngalokusemtsetfweni ngenyanga yaKholwane 2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela uMnyango Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Nokubambisana ngokusingatha uMhlangano woMkhandlu woNgqongqoshe (i-COM) we-18 wenhlangano i-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA) owabanjwa eDurban, KwaZulu-Natali ngomhla we-02 kuLwezi 2018 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: Ukuhlanganisa Abantu base-Afrika, e-Asia, e-Australasia nase-Middle East ngokubambisana okunzulu ukuze kube Nokuthula, Uzinzo Nentuthuko Esimeme".

src: Lomtamo uhlose kuniketa emandla nekuhlomisa bantfu labasha labayincenye ye-IORA ngelwati lwemsebenti kumikhakha yabo labayifundzelako.
tgt: Omunye wemiphumela yomhlangano we-18 we-IORA kwaba Isimemezelo Esikhethekile sokuhlonipha uMongameli Nelson Mandela ophinde abe ngumsunguli we-IORLokhu kuholele ekusungulweni “koHlelo Lokufundela Umsebenzi Usemsebenzini i-IORA Nelson Mandela 'Yiba Wukhondolo”” okulindeleke ukuthi lwethulwe ngokusemthethweni kuNtulikazi 2019.

src: Kulwa Nebugebengu IKhabhinethi yamukela Lesikhungo Sekulwa Netigebengu Letingemacembu lesisandza kuvulwa endzaweni yaseHanover Park, eNshonalanga Kapa, sivulwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuthuthukisa nokuhlomisa abantu abasha baku-IORA ngamathuba okusebenza emkhakheni abawufundele.

src: Loku kungete indlela yekungenelela kwahulumende kantsi kutasita kakhulu ekulweni netinkhinga tetigebengu letingemacembu kanye netidzakamiva lekubugebengu lobukhulako emimmangweni.
tgt: Ukulwa Nobugebengu IKhabhinethi lamukela ukwethulwa, kwakamuva, koPhiko Olulwisana Namaqembu Ezigelekeqe e-Hanover Park, eNtshonalanga Kapa, wuMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Lesikhungo sinemalunga laceceshiwe ekusebenteni ngetimo letinebungoti njengoba babuya kusikhungo selicembu leliphendvula ngekushesha (ma-Bharete), lelicembu lelinemsebenti lokhetsekile (i-special task force) kanye nalesikhungo lesingenelela velonkhe (i-national intervention unit).
tgt: Lokhu kwengezele ekungeneleleni kukahulumeni kuzoba nomsebenzi omkhulu ekubhekaneni ngendlela enzulu nenkinga yamaqembu ezigelekeqe kanye nobugebengu obuhambisana nezidakamizwa obukhungethe imiphakathi.

src: IKhabhinethi imema imimmango kutsi isebentisane netikhungo temtsetfo ekugcineni kuphepha nekuvikeleka lekuyintfo lebalulekile kunoma ngumuphi ummango kutsi ukwati kukhula.
tgt: Lolu phiko lunamalungu aqeqeshelwe ukubhekana nezimo ezinobungozi obukhulu njengoba evela emaphikweni okubhekana nezimo ngobuchule (amaBherethi), ithimba lokubhekana nemisebenzi ekhethekile (i-special task force) kanye nophiko lwezokungenelela kuzwelonke (i-national intervention unit).

src: Iyachubeka nekutinikela ekucinisekiseni kwekutsi imimmango iphephile kantsi itivela iphephile etindzaweni labahlala kuto.
tgt: Emshikashikeni wokulwa nobugebengu, le ndlela yokungenelela eholwa nguhulumeni izokwethulwa ezweni lonke.

src: Imali lengenako leyakhiwe ngekutsatsa intsela itawuhlala ingiyo lengumtfombo locinisekisa kwekutsi hulumende angatfulela bantfu tnsita.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa imiphakathi ukuthi isebenzisane nezinhlangano zomthetho ukugcina ukuphepha nokuvikeleka okubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kube nentuthuko emiphakathini.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta bonkhe bafundzi lebafuna kubhalela kuSikhwama Savelonkhe Sekusita Bafundzi Ngetimali (i-NSFAS) kute batfole lusito nga-2019 kantsi kubhalela nge-inthanethi kuvalwa ngamhla tinge-30 Lweti 2018.
tgt: Isikhathi Sokuqoqwa Kwentela IKhabhinethi libonga bonke abakhokhintela ngokuthumela imibhalo yokuqoqwa kwentela kwaminyaka yonke yesikhathi sokuqoqwa kwentela ngowezi-2017/18, esivalwe ngomhla zingama-31 kuMfumfu 2018.

src: Ngamhla lu- 01 Inyoni 2018, Ticelo tavulelwa bafundzi lebafanele nalabafuna kuchubeka netifundvo tabo nga-2019 bente sifundvo lesivumelekile kunoma ngabe nguyiphi iyunivesithi yahulumende noma emakolishi Etifundvo Tebuciko Bemisebenti Yetandla kanye Nekuceceshwa (ma-TVET) eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Imali eqoqiwe ngentela isawumthombo wesikhwama esiqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni angahlinzeka umphakathi ngemisebenzi.

src: Bafundzi bayakhutsatwa kakhulu kutsi batfumele nge-inthanethi ticelo noma bavakashele lihhovisi Lesikhungo Savelonkhe Sekutfutfukiswa Kwelusha (i-NYDA) ngembi kwalolusuku lwekuvala.
tgt: Isikimu Sikazwelonke Sokusiza Abafundi Ngezimali (i-NFSAS).

src: Tincumo TeKhabhinethi IKhabhinethi ilivumele Luhlaka Lwemasu lekuvikela umnontfo waseNingizimu Afrika mhlaba wonkhe ngalokuphatselene nekuhwebelana, kusisa nekutfutfukisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likhumbuza bonke abafundi abafuna ukufaka izicelo Esikimini Sikazwelonke Sokusiza Abafundi Ngezimali (i-NFSAS) ngosizo lwezimali ngowezi-2019 ukuthi izicelo ezifakwa nge-inthanethi zivalwa ngomhla zingama-30 kuLwezi 2018.

src: Lelisu lihlose kucinisekisa kwekutsi tivumelwano nemave angaphandle tihambisana netinchubomgomo talelive njengekucedza buphuya, kuswelakala kwemsebenti nekungalingani.
tgt: Ngomhla lu-1 kuMandulo 2018, izicelo zavulelwa abafundi abafanelekile abafisa ukuqhuba izifundo zabo ngowezi-2019 ezifundweni ezigunyaziwe kunoma eyiphi inyuvesi kahulumeni noma ekolishi Lokufundela Umsebenzi Wezobuchwepheshe Bezandla Nokuqeqeshwa (i-TVET) eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Luhlanganisa budlelwano bekuhwebelana nelutjalomali nemave lasatfutfukile lufunela lutjalomali langekhatsi, kundluliselwa kwemakhono netheknoloji kanye nekutfunyelwa kwemphahla ngaphandle leyenta inzuzo lenyenti.
tgt: Abafundi bakhuthazwa kakhulu ukuthi bethule izicelo nge-inthanethi noma baye emahhovisi eNhlangano Kazwelonke Yokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha (i-NYDA) ngaphambi kosuku lokuvala.

src: IKhabhinethi ivumele kukhushulwa kwemiholo wemalunga eKhomishini Yemalungelo Eluntfu yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAHRC).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze Uhlaka Lohlelosu ukuze kuqhutshwe izintshisekelo ezingokohlelosu zeNingizimu Afrika emhlabeni jikelele njengoba liqondene nezohwebo, utshalomali kanye nezimboni.

src: NgekweMtsetfo Wekhomishini Yemalungelo Eluntfu yaseNingizimu Afrika, wanga-2013, nguMengameli loneligunya, ngembi kwekukhulumisana neKhabhinethi neNdvuna Yetetimali, lekukhuphula imiholo, tinzuzo kanye naleminye imigomo nemibandzela yemsebenti.
tgt: Lolu hlelosu luhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukubonisana namanye amazwe kuwusizo kuzinqubomgomo ezibalulekile zasezweni ezinjengokuqedwa kobumpofu, ukungabibikho kwemisebenzi kanye nokungalingani.

src: Lekhomishini Lesezingeni Leliphakeme Mhlabawonkhe, lesungulwe yi-ILO nga-2017, iniketwe umsebenti wekuhlolisisa letingucuko letiphutfumako letenteka emisebentini, ibuke letinkhinga letibalulekile nekutsi yini lengentiwa kugcina likusasa lemisebenti libe ncono futsi lingavuni licala.
tgt: Luphinde luqinise ubudlelwane bezohwebo kanye nobezotshalomali namazwe asethuthukile futhi luhehe utshalomali olungena ngaphakathi ezweni, ukudluliswa kwamakhono nobuchwepheshe kanye nezimpahla ezithengiselwa amazwe angaphandle ezinenzuzo eningi.

src: Lomsebenti waleKhomishini Yamhlabawonkhe uhambisana naloku hulumende lagcile kuko lekukwakha ematfuba emsebenti lokahle nalosimeme, nemitamo yekucinisekisa kwekutsi bantfu labasha baseNingizimu Afrika banemakhono ladzingekako kute kutsi bakhone kuphila kulemisebenti lenetingucuko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukukhushulwa komholo wonyaka wamalungu eKhomishana Yamalungelo Esintu yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAHRC).

src: I-China International Import Export (i-CIIE)IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela lokungenelela kweNingizimu Afrika njengelive lelimenyiwe ngalokuhloniphekile kulomcimbi wekukhangisa, i-China International Import Export (i-CIIE) lebanjelwe eShanghai.
tgt: UMthetho WeKhomishana Yamalungelo Esintu yaseNingizimu Afrika, wezi-2013 uhlinzeka ngokuthi umholo, isibonelelo sezindleko kanye neminye imigomo nemibandela yehhovisi inqunywa nguMongameli ngokubonisana neKhabhinethi noNgqongqoshe Wezezimali.

src: Ndvuna Yetekuhwebelana Netimboni Rob Davis, uhola litsimba letinhlangano leti-27 taseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Osihlalo bale Khomishana nguMongomeli uCyril Ramaphosa nozakwabo wase-Sweden uStefan Löfven.

src: Lelitsimba lisekelwe ngetimali Litiko Lekuhwebelana Netimboni ngekusebentisa i-Export Marketing and Investment Assistance (i-EMIA) Scheme.
tgt: Ikhomishana Yomhlaba Jikelele Esezingeni Eliphezulu, ehlelwe yi-ILO ngowezi-2017, ibhekene nomsebenzi wokuhlola izinguquko ezisheshayo eziqhubeka emisebenzini, ohlonza izinselele ezisemqoka kanye nalokho okumele kwenziwe ukwenza ikusasa lomsebenzi libe ngcono futhi lilingane.

src: Kungenelela kweNingizimu Afrika kwente kwekutsi lelive likhone kukhangisa ngemakhono alo ekuhwebelana nekusisa kantsi siphokophelele phambili kubona bakhangisi labavela kumikhakha, kufaka ekhatsi bekugaywa kwalokulinyiwe, ticatfula nesikhumba, tebunjiniyela, emakhemikhali aphethiloli, tetetitimela, tekuvikela, kanye netheknoloji yelwati lwetekuchumana, nekutsi babuye ekhaya neticelo tekutsenga.
tgt: Umsebenzi weKhomisana Yomhlaba Jikelele uhambisana nokugxila kukahulumeni ekwakheni imisebenzi efanele negcinekayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika iba namakhono adingekayo ukuphumelela emkhakheni wezemisebenzi oshintshashintshayo.

src: Ngesikhatsi lomkhangiso uchuba, iNingizimu Afrika nayo ibungate umhlangano wekusisa lobukete kumatfuba lakumkhakha wekukhicita.
