tgt: Isitatimende Somhlangano WeKhabhinethi wamhla ziyi-11 kuNdasa 2020 ePhalamende, e-Tuynhuys eKapaIzindaba Ezisematheni.

src: I-Coronavirus (i-COVID-19) Ikhabhinethi iyabacinisekisa bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi kwentiwa tonkhe taba tekucaphela phambilini kuvikela lelive kunoma ngukuphi kubhebhetseka ngemandla kwale-COVID-19.
tgt: Igciwane i-Corona (i-COVID-19) IKhabhinethi liphinda liqinisekisa iNingizimu Afrika iyonke ukuthi kwenziwa konke okusemandleni ukuvikela izwe kukho konke ukuqubuka kwe-COVID-19.

src: Indvuna yeTemphilo, Dkt.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt.

src: Zweli Mkize, ubikele Ikhabhinethi kutsi sekunetehlakalo leti-13 te-COVID-19 lapha eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Zweli Mkhize, ubikele iKhabhinethi ukuthi kunezigameko eziyi-13 ze-COVID-19 eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Lamuhla ekuseni, Indvuna yeTemphilo icinisekise kutsi kutfolakale letinye tehlakalo letinsha letine, lokwenta lelinani letehlakalo te-COVID-19 likhuphuke liye ku-17.
tgt: Namuhla ekuseni, uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo uqinisekise ukuthi sekunezigameko ezintsha ezine esezihlonziwe, okwenza isibalo sezigameko ze-COVID-19 sibe yi-17.

src: Utasiniketa leminye imininingwane ekuhambeni kwalolusuku.
tgt: Uzohlinzeka ngeminye imininingwane ngokuhamba kosuku.

src: Ikhabhinethi nayo igcizelela simemo lesentiwe yiNhlangano yeTemphilo yeMhlaba neNdvuna yeTemphilo Mkize, kutsi bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bachubeke nekusebentisa netento letiyindlela yekuvimba kwesulelana nekwandza kwaleligciwane.
tgt: IKhabinethi ligcizelela okushiwo yi-World Health Organisation noNgqongqoshe Wezempilo uMkhize, ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele baqhubeke nokuthatha izinyathelo zokunqanda ukudluliseka nokusabalala kwaleli gciwane.

src: Letindlela tekuvikela tifaka ekhatsi kuvama kugeza tandla takho ngemanti lanensipho noma-ke usebentise sibulalimagciwane sekugeza tandla lesine-alkhoholi i-sanitizer, tiphindze futsi tifake ekhatsi kugwema kubamba emehlo, timphumulo nemlomo ngetandla letingakagezwa kanye nekuvala umlomo wakho ngethishu uma ukhwehlela noma uthimula bese uyayilahla leyo thishu.
tgt: Izindlela zokuzivikela zibandakanya ukuvama ukugeza izandla ngensipho namanzi noma usebenzisa uketshezi olwakhiwe ngamakhemikhali lokuhlanza izandla (alcohol-based hand sanitizer), zibandakanya ukugwema ukuthinta amehlo, ikhala nomlomo ngezandla ezingagezwanga nokumboza umlomo ngethishu uma ukhwehlela noma uthimula bese uyilahle leyo thishu.

src: Timphawu letivamile taleligciwane, yifiva, kukhwehlela nekuphefumula kamatima.
tgt: Izimpawu ezijwayelekile zegciwane zibandakanya, ukushisa komzimba ngokweqile, ukukhwehlela kanye nokuphefumula kanzima.

src: Uma ngabe unaletimphawu njengobe tichaziwe lapha ngetulu, bantfu belulekwa kutsi bahlale ekhaya futsi bafune lusito lwetekwelashwa.
tgt: Uma umuntu enezimpawu ezingenhla njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla, abantu belulekwa ukuthi bahlale emakhaya futhi bafune usizo lwezempilo.

src: Sicela wonkhewonkhe kutsi bahloniphe lingasense letigulane letine- CODVID-19 kanye nemindeni yato.
tgt: Sinxusa bonke abantu ukuthi bahloniphe ubumfihlo beziguli ze-COVID-19 kanye nemindeni yazo.

src: Sicaphelisa ngemandla kutsi kungandziswa nanoma nguluphi lwatiso lolungesiwo emaciniso loluphatselene naleligciwane kute kutsi kuvinjwe kwandza kweluvalo, kukhishwa inyumbazana kanye nekubandlulula labanye emimangweni yetfu.
tgt: Sinxusa bonke abantu ukuthi bagweme ukusabalalisa ulwazi olungamanga ngaleli gciwane ukuze kugwenywe ukwanda kokwesaba,isihlava nokucwasa emiphakathini yethu.

src: Bantfu labakhatsatekile bangatsintsa Lucingo Loluphutfumako lweSikhungo saVelonkhe seteTifo Letitsatselwanako (i-NICD) ku-0800 029 999 kute batfole lwatiso lolungilo mayelana ne-COVID-19.
tgt: Abantu abakhathazekile bangathinta iNombolo Yocingo ye-National Institute for Communicable Diseases (i-NICD) ku-0800 029 999 ukuze bathole ulwazi oluyilona nge-COVID-19.

src: Ikhabhinethi ijoyina Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ekufiseleni licembu lekubuyisa ekhaya kuleli lakitsi nelitsimba le-South African Airways (le-SAA) labafulatsele leli lakitsi ngaLesibili babhekisa emabombo kuLidolobhakati laseWuhan, kuSifundza saseHubei eRiphabhliki yeBantfu yaseShayina, kulandza babuyise kuleli bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika laba-122.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihlanganyela noMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa ekufiseleni ithimba lokubuyisela abantu ezweni kanye nabasebenzi be-South African Airways (i-SAA) abasuka ngoLwesibili belibangise eDolobheni Elikhulu lase-Wuhan, esiFundazweni sase-Hubei e-People's Republic of China, ukuyolanda izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika eziyi-122.

src: Licembu letemphilo leLitiko Letemphilo kanye neLuphiko lweteMphilo lweMbutfo Wetekuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika nabo bayincenye yalelitsimba lekubuyisa ekhaya.
tgt: Ithimba lezempilo loMnyango Wezempilo noPhiko Lwezempilo Lombutho Wezokuvikela WaseNingizimu Afrika liyingxenye yethimba lokubuyisela abantu ezweni.

src: Ikhabhinethi seyivakalise kubonga kwayo ku-SAA ngelusito lwabo lolukhulu kangaka kulomsebenti wekubuyisa ekhaya.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulise ukubonga kwalo kwi-SAA ngosizo lwabo olukhulu kulo msebenzi wokubuyisela abantu ezweni.

src: Lelicembu lekubuyisa ekhaya nalabantfu baseNingizimu Afrika lababuyiswa ekhaya balindzeleke kutsi batseleke kulelive lakitsi ngaLesihlanu lona, mhla ti-13 Indlovulenkhulu 2020.
tgt: Ngalolu Lwesihlanu, ziyi-13 kuNdasa 2020 kulindeleke ukuthi ithimba lokubuyisela abantu ezweni libuye nezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ekufikeni kwabo, batawuvalelwa bodvwana linanincane lemalanga la-14 kuya kulinanikhulu lemalanga lange-21.
tgt: Uma sebebuyile, bazogqunywa izinsuku ezingengaphansi kweziyi-14 kuya kwezingedlule ezinsukwini eziyi-21.

src: Ngalesikhatsi lesi, kuhamba kwebantfu nemphahla kuphunywa kungenwa kuletindzawo tekuvalelwa kutawuncishiswa.
tgt: Ngalesi sikhathi, iminyakazo yabantu nempahla endaweni abazogqunywa kuyo izoba nemikhawulo.

src: Sicaphelisa bantfu ngemandla kutsi bangetami kutsintsana ngekwemtimba noma-ke balinge kuvakashela letindzawo teluvalelo.
tgt: Sixwayisa abantu ukuthi bangalinge bazame ukuxhumana ngokwesiqu noma bangazami ukuvakashela indawo abagqunywe kuyo.

src: Uma-ke lesikhatsi sekuvalelwa sesiphelile futsi netinhlolo tacinisekisa kutsi sekute kwesuleleka ngeligciwane i-COVID-19 lokubhacile kwebantfu bakitsi, batawubese-ke bayakhululwa babuyela emuva emimangweni yabo lefanele.
tgt: Uma sekuphele isikhathi sokugqunywa futhi isivivinyo zaqinisekisa ukuthi alikho nhlobo igciwane i-COVID-19 ebantwini bakithi, bazokhululwa ukuthi babuyele emiphakathini yabo.

src: Ikhabinethi iyawuncoma kakhulu umsebenti lowentiwe Likomidi leTindvuna (i-IMC) lebelinikwe umsebenti wekubukana ne-COVID-19, liholwa yiNdvuna yeTemphilo futsi lisebentisana ne-NICD, ekulandzeleleni nekuvimba leligciwane, lapho basasita labo labatsintsekile nekuhlala njalo batisa sive ngalokusha lokwentekako.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lincoma umsebenzi owenziwe iKomidi Elihlanganise Ongqongqoshe (i-IMC) elinomsebenzi wokubhekana ne-COVID-19, eliholwa uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo nelisebenzisana ne-NICD, ukulandelela nokunqanda igciwane, libe lisiza labo abathelelekile nokuqhubeka lazise izwe ngokuqhubekayo.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyakutfokotela kakhulu kutsi tifundza letinyenti tiyelekele luchumanolwatiso mayelana neludzaba lwe-COVID-19 etandleni teNdvuna yeTemphilo ngenca yekubaluleka kwalo ngekwavelonkhe nekwemave emhlaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabonga ukuthi izifundazwe eziningi zidlulisele ukukhuluma ngalolu daba lwe-COVID-19 kuNgqongqoshe Wezempilo ngenxa yobukhulu babo ezweni nakumazwe ngamazwe.

src: Sicela tonkhe letinye tifundza kutsi nato atente njalo kute kucinisekiswe kuphuma endzaweni yinye kwelwatisokuchumana futsi ngaleyo ndlela-ke kutawugwemeka nanoma ngukuphi kudideka lokungakahloswa nekwendluliswa kwemilayo lokungakachumani.
tgt: Sinxusa zonke ezinye izifundazwe ukuthi nazo zenze okufanayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiyalezo idluliswa iphuma endaweni eyodwa ngalokho kugwenywe noma wokuphi ukudida abantu ngephutha kanye nemiyalezo engahambisani.

src: Mengameli Ramaphosa masinyane-nje utawatisa emacembu etembusave ePhalamende kanye nebaholi bemasontfo ngale-COVID-19.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa uzokwazisa amaqembu ezepolitiki amelwe ePhalamende kanye nabaholi bamabandla nge-COVID-19.

src: Kutawubanjwa umhlangano lokhetsekile mayelana ne-COVID-19 ngeLisontfo, mhla ti-15 Indlovulenkhulu 2020, eTshwane.
tgt: Kuzoba noMhlangano weKhabhinethi okhethekile nge-COVID-19 ozobanjwa ngeSonto, ziyi-15 kuNdasa 2020, eTshwane.

src: Umnotfo.
tgt: Ezomnotho.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikubuyekitile kukhululwa kweMbiko weTelubalobalo lwaseNingizimu Afrika lomayelana neLinanimkhicito netinsita (i-GDP, lokhombise kutsi umnotfo wetfu wehlile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi libheke ukukhishwa kombiko we-Statistics South Africa ngoMkhiqizo Wasezweni Uwonke (i-GDP), oveze ukuthi umnotho wethu uwele esigabeni sokwehla kwamandla omnotho.

src: Emanani akhombise kwehla kwe-GDP nga-1.4% eKoteni ye-4 yanga-2019.
tgt: Izibalo ziveze ukwehla kwe-GDP nge-1.4% ngeKota lesi-4 lowezi-2019.

src: Loku kulandzela kuncipha nga-0.8% eKoteni ye-3 yawo lowo mnyaka.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela ukwehla ngama-0.8% ngeKota lesi-3 kuwo lowo nyaka.

src: Nanoma-nje isibona lesimo lesibi lesibangelwa kusetjentiswa kwagezi ngekwabelana, Ikhabhinethi solo iyatibophelela ekulungiseni loko lokubalulekile, kulandzelela tindzawo tekukhula kwemnotfo letibalulekile iphindze futsi ichube umkhankhaso wetisombululo letihlangene nabo bonkhe balingani betenhlalo kute kutsi sisonkhe sibeke lelive endleleni lecondze ekukhuleni kwemnotfo.
tgt: Yize uqondwa umthelela omubi wokucishwa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga, iKhabhinethi lisamile ekulungiseni izisekelo, kuphokophelwe emikhakheni esemqoka yokukhula kwezwe nokuqhuba izisombululo ezihlanganyelwe nozakwabo basemphakathini khona bezohlanganyela babeke izwe endleleni yokukhula ngokomnotho.

src: Sicinisa lutjalomali lwetfu futsi kute kube ngulamuhla imiklamo lenelinanimali letigidzigidzi leti-R9 seyiphotfuliwe bese kutsi imiklamo lenge-27 letigidzigidzi letingetulu kwaletinge-R250 isesigabeni sekufezekiswa, kunaleminye leminyenti letawentiwa kulomnyaka.
tgt: Siyaluqinisa utshalomali lwethu futhi njengamanje sekuqedwe imisebenzi yotshalomali elinganiselwa kuzigidigidi zamarandi eziyi-9 kanye nemisebenzi engama-27 ebiza imali engaphezudlwana kwezigidigidi zamarandi ezingama-250 ezigabeni zokuqalisa, kube kunokuningi okuseza kulo nyaka.

src: Intsengo yedatha yaka-Vodacom.
tgt: Ukwehla kwamanani edatha yakwa-Vodacom IKhabhinethi lamukela isimemezelo seKhomishana Yezokuncintisana ngesivumelwano esiyingqophamlando okufinyelelwe kuso ne-Vodacom ngokwehliswa kwamanani edatha alo mhlinzeki.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyasemukela simemetelo lesikhishwe yiKhomishini yeteMncintiswane mayelana nesivumelwano sekuvuma sikhonkhwane lekufinyelelwe kuso ne-Vodacom mayelana nekwehliswa kwentsengo yedatha yalomsiti.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela Izingxoxo Zezimakethe Zokuncintisana ngemisebenzi yedatha eyacelwa ngowayenguNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho u-Ebrahim Patel ngowezi-2017, lapho kwatholwa ukuthi amanani edatha ayengaphezu kwawakwamanye amazwe okwakulimaza abathengi abadla imbuya ngothi.

src: Loku kulandzela luphenyo lweKubuta ngeMakethe yeMncintiswano mayelana netinsita tedatha lolwacelwa yiNdvuna yetekutfutfukisa Umnotfo Ebrahim Patel nga-2017, lolwatfola kutsi tintsengo tedatha betisetulu kakhulu kunakulamanye emave futsi betibandlulula batsengi labaphuyile.
tgt: Isivumelwano ne-Vodacom sizoqala ukusebenza mhla lu-1 kuMbasa 2020 futhi sizobona amanani edatha ehla kuwo wonke ama-bundles enyanga, njengoba amanani e-1GB bundle ezokwehla esuka ku-R149 aye ku-R99 (okuwukwehla ngama-34%), kube kusazoba nezinye izaphulelo ngonyaka ozayo.

src: Lesivumelwano lesentiwe ne-Vodacom sitawucala kusebenta mhla lu-1 Mabasa 2020 futsi sitawenta kutsi intsengo yedatha yehle kuwo onkhe ema-bundle angenyanga, lapho khona tintsengo te-bundle i-1GB titawehla tisuke ku-R149 tiye ku-R99 (kwehla nge-34%), futsi kutawuba naletinye tephulelo emnyakeni lotako.
tgt: I-Vodacom izophinde ivulele ukutholakala mahhala kwedatha kumakhasimende kumawebhusayithi athile asiza umphakathi (njenge-GCIS, i-BizPortal entsha kanye ne-Wikipedia) kanye nokungena kumawebhusayithi amanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika.

src: I-Vodacom itawuphindze yente kutsi kube nemadatha amahhala ebatsengi emawebhusayithi ahulumende (njenge-GCIS, i-BizPortal lensha ne-Wikipedia) nekufinyela emawebhusayithi emanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Kuzoba nezinye izaphulelo kumakhasimende asemiphakathini eyizi-2 000 edla imbuya ngothi futhi abasebenzisi bazoba nohlelo lwedatha oluyisisekelo yokuthola imiyalezo emibili ye-SMS mahhala nsukuzonke.

src: I-PepsiCo itfole i-Pioneer Foods.
tgt: I-PepsiCo ithola i-Pioneer Foods.

src: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yemukela incalisakuvela yedili yekuhlomisa tisebenti leyentiwe ne-PepsiCo njengencenye yalenkampani yekutfola inkampani yekudla yaseNingizimu Afrika, i-Pioneer Foods I-PepsiCo itinikele kumisebenti, lutjalomali kanye nekuhlomisa bendzawo nekutsenga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela isivumelwano sokuthuthukisa abasebenzi esiyingqophamlando ne-PepsiCo njengengxenye yokuthengwa kwenkampani yokudla yaseNingizimu Afrika, i-Pioneer Foods.

src: Iphindze futsi yavuma kutsi emahhovisi ayo lamakhulu lase-Sub-Sahara atawuba eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: I-PepsiCo izibophezele emisebenzini, utshalomali kanye nokuthuthukisa nokuthenga kuleli.

src: Tisebenti te-Pioneer Foods leti-10 000 tivikelekile ekudzilitweni emsebentini ngenca yalokuhlanganiswa kwaletinkampani futsi i-PepsiCo ivumile kugcina i-agrigethi yemazinga ekucasha ikulamazinga lakhona kwamanje sikhatsi lesiminyaka lesihlanu.
tgt: Iphinde yavuma ukuthi amahhovisi amakhulu ase-Sub-Saharan azoba seNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tisebenti kulenkampani titawunikwa nemasheya labita tigidzi leti-R.6 e-PepsiCo latawusetjentiselwa kutfola sabelo sa-13% e-Pioneer Foods kungakapheli iminyaka lesihlanu.
tgt: Abasebenzi be-Pioneer Food abayizi-10 000 nabo bavikelekile ekudilizweni okuhambisana nokuhlanganiswa kwezinkampani futhi i-PepsiCo ivumile ukugcina amazinga ezibalo zokuqasha emazingeni akuwo iminyaka emihlanu.

src: Kulwa nekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana.
tgt: Ukulwisana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane nezingane.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyasemukela sincumo seNkantolo Lephakeme yaseGauteng sekwala sicelo semvume yekwendlulisa sikhalo ecaleni lemdlwenguli Nicholas Ninow lodliwe licala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamuka isinqumo seNkantolo Ephakeme yase-Gauteng sokuchitha isicelo sokudlulisa isinqumo ngecala lomdlwenguli ogwetshiwe uNicholas Ninow.

src: Kulomnyaka lophelile, Ninow wagwetjwa dzilikajele ngemuva kwekudlwengula intfombatanyana leneminyaka lesikhombisa budzala endzaweni yekudla i-Dros eSilverton, ePitoli nga-2018.
tgt: Ngonyaka odlule, uNinow wagwetshwa udilika-jele emuva kokudlwengula intombazanyana eneminyaka eyisikhombisa esitolo sokudlela i-Dros e-Silverton, ePitoli ngowezi-2018.

src: Lesehlulelo, sigwebo, nekwaliwa kwemvume nekwendlulisa sikhalo, itfumela umlayeto lonemandla kubabhebhetseli nalabo labangaba babhebhetseli bekuhlukumeta bomake nebantfwana kutsi, tikhungo tebulungiswa taseNingizimu Afrika itawubenta batiphendvulele ngaletento tabo letimbi kangaka.
tgt: Isahlulelo, isigwebo nokuchithwa kwesicelo sokudluliswa kwesigwebo, kuthumela umyalezo onamandla kubabhebhethekisi bamacala kanye nalabo abasazoba ngababhebhethikisi abahlukumeza abantu besifazane nezingane ukuthi, izikhungo zobulungiswa zaseNingizimu Afrika zizobajezisa ngezenzo zabo ezimbi ngokwedlulele.

src: Sisonkhe ngekubambisana sifanele kutsi sikucedze nya lokuhlukubeta lokwentela phansi emalungelo eluntfu labaluleke kakhulu abomake nebantfwana.
tgt: Sindawonye singakuqeda ukuhlukumeza okudelela amalungelo ayisisekelo sabantubesifazane nezingane.

src: Ngekusebenta ngekubambisana sifanele sicinisekise kutsi kute make noma umntfwana lohlukubetwa ngekwelicansi, loshaywako, lodlwengulwako noma-ke lohlaselwa nanoma ngukuphi kulelive lakitsi.
tgt: Ngokubambisana singaqinisekisa ukuthi akekho umuntu wesifazane noma ingane ehlukunyezwa ngokocansi, oshaywayo, odlwengulwayo noma ohlaselwayo noma kuphi ezweni lethu.

src: Kuphepha emigwacweni.
tgt: Ukuphepha emgwaqweni.

src: Ikhabhinethi ivakalisa emavi ekulilela nekudvudvuta imindeni lenge-25 yebagibeli labashone engotini yebhasi ngaseCentane eMphumalanga Kapa ekucaleni kwalenyanga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa ukuzwelana nemindeni engama-25 yabagibeli abashona engozini yebhasi eyehla eduze kwaseCentane eMpumalanga Kapa ekuqaleni kwale nyanga.

src: Iphindze futsi ifisela nalabo labalimele labasindzile kwelulama lokusheshako.
tgt: Liphinda lifisele abagibeli abangama-68 abalimele ukwelulama ngokushesha.

src: Luphenyo loluchutjwa yiNhlangano yekulawula teMgwaco neMaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika lufanele kutsi lusite ekuniketeni temphendvulo mayelana netimo letiphatselene nalenhlekelele.
tgt: Uphenyo lwe-Road Traffic Management Corporation namaPhoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika kufanele ukuthi luzosiza ekuhlinzekeni ngezimpendulo ngezimo eziholele kulo mshophi.

src: Bashayeli betigitjelwa banemsebenti wekwenta konkhe lokusemandleni abo kutsi bacinisekise kuphepha kwebagibeli babo.
tgt: Abahlinzeki bezithuthi banomsebenzi wokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabagibeli babo.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo weKuchibela Imigwaco yaVelonkhe wanga-2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukuthunyelwa koMthethosivivinywa Oyisichibiyelo Wokuhamba Kwezimoto Emgwaqweni Kazwelonke wezi-2019 owethulwe ePhalamende.

src: Utawutsi ungaphasiswa ube ngumtsetfo, loMtsetfosivivinyo utawufaka ligalelo ekunciphiseni lokubhubha kwebantfu labanyenti emigwacweni yetfu.
tgt: Uma sewuphasisiwe waba umthetho, uMthethosivivinywa uzoba negalelo ekunciphiseni ukuchitheka kwegazi emigwaqweni yethu.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethi.

src: Lisubiciko laVelonkhe (i-NSP) yeteBudlova Lobucondziswe kuBulili Lobutsite neKubulawa kwaLabasikati (i-GBVF).
tgt: Udlame Olusekelwe Ngokobulili Nokubulawa Kwabantu Besifazane (i-GBVF) uHlelo Lwamasu Lukazwelonke (i-NSP) Ngowezi-2019, iKhabhinethi lagunyaza i-GBVF-NSLaphinda lahola ithimba loNgqongqoshe abaholwa uNgqongqoshe Osehhovisi Likamongameli Obhekele Abantu Besifazane, Abantu Abasha kanye Nabantu Abaphila Nokukhubazeka, uNksz.

src: NgeNgongoni 2019, Ikhabhinethi yavuma i-GBVF-NSYaphindza yatfuma litsimba leTindvuna lebeliholwa yiNdvuna eHhovisi laMengameli yetaBomake, Bantfwana Nebantfu Labanekukhubateka, Mk Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, kutsi bente umsebenti lochubekako mayelana nemalungiselelo esikhungo lowentiwe kule-GBVF wekwengamela kufezekiswa kwe-GBVF-NSItfokotela kuchutjwa ngekuphutfuma kwenganyelwa kwalomsebenti wekuvimba i-GBVF, Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kusungulwa kweMkandlu waVelonkhe we-GBVF (NCGBVF).
tgt: Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ukuthi aqhubeke nokwenza umsebenzi wezinhlelo zesikhungo we-GBVF ephakanyisiwe ukuqapha ukuqaliswa kwe-GBVF-NSNgenxa yokubona ukuphuthuma kokuqhuba nokuqapha umsebenzi wokunqanda i-GBVF, iKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukusungulwa koMkhandlu Kazwelonke we-GBVF (i-NCGBVF).

src: Lomkhandlu utawuhlanganisa bantfu kulo lonkhe lelive, etifundzeni nasetindzaweni letisemakhaya kuhola nekwesekela tingenelelo te-GBVF letiletsa tingucuko.
tgt: Lolu hlaka luzonxenxa abantu kuzwelonke, ezifundazweni nakuleli ukuthi bahole futhi beseke izindlela eziletha izinguquko ze-GBVLuzoba nanomsebenzi wokuqaliswa kwe-GBVF-NSUMkhandlu Kazwelonke we-GBVF uzobikela uMongameli ngoNgqongqoshe uNkoana-Mashabane.

src: Utawuphindze futsi ube nesibopho sekufezekisa le-GBVF-NSUmkhandlu waVelonkhe we-GBVF utawubika kuMengameli ngekusebentisa Indvuna Nkoana-Mashabane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwakhiwa kwe-IMC elakhiwe uNgqongqoshe Wamaphoyisa uBheki Cele uNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo uNgqongqoshe Ronald Lamola uNgqongqoshe Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo uSenzo Mchunu uNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uLindiwe Zulu noNgqongqoshe Nkoana-Mashabane njengomholi wayo.

src: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yavuma kusungula i-IMC lefaka ekhatsi Indvuna yeMaphoyisa Bheki Cele Indvuna yeTebulungiswa Nekucondziswa Kwesimilo Ronald Lamola Indvuna yeTemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa Indvuna yeTekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle Lindiwe Zulu neNdvuna Nkoana-Mashabane futsi kutawuba nguye ummemi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligcizelele ukubaluleka kokubheka izinqumo ezinqala zokunqanda udlame olubhekiswe kumalungu abuthakathaka emiphakathini yethu.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikugcizelele kubaluleka nekuphutfumisa timiso tekuvimba budlova lobubhebhetselwa kumalunga emmango lahlaseleka kalula.
tgt: I-IMC iyalelwe ukuthi isheshise umsebenzi wokumisa uMkhandlu Kazwelonke we-GBVF ngokusemthethweni.

src: Le-IMC itfunywe kutsi isebente ngekushesha nangalokongako ekuhleleni kahle ngalokusemtsetfweni loMkandlu waVelonkhe we-GBVBaphindze futsi batfunywa kutsi bachubeke bacubungulisise kukhoneka kwekwakha umtsetfo mayelana nalokuhleleka kwamanje kwesikhungo.
tgt: IKhomishini Lezokulingana Ngokobulili - njengesikhungo esingaphansi kwesahluko sesishayigalolunye ezinomsebenzi ngokomthethosisekelo wokukhuthaza ukuhlonipha ukulingana ngokobulili nokuvikela, ukuthuthukisa nokutholakala kokulingana ngokobulili - kuzolindeleka ukuthi siqhubeka nokuhlola nokuqapha inqubo eyenziwayo yokuqalisa i-GBVF-NSUHlelo Lwamabhizinisi Asemalokishini Nasezindaweni Zasemakhaya (i-TREP).

src: Ikhomishini yeTekulingana ngekweBulili – njengesikhungo sesahluko semfica lesinemsebenti wetemtsetfosisekelo wekukhutsata kuhlonishwa kwetekulingana ngekwebulili nekuvikelwa kwe, kutfutfukiswa nekutfolwa kwekulingana ngekwebulili – itawulindzeleka kutsi ichubeke nekutsi ihlale njalo ihlola futsi ilandzelela inchubekelembili leyentiwako ekufezekiseni i-BVF-NSLuhlelo Lwetemabhizinisi aseMaphandleni naseMalokishini (i-TREP).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukuqalisa i-TREP ngeSikhwama Samabhizinisi Asemalokishini.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kufezekiswa kwe-TREP ngekusebentisa Sikhwama seTemabhizinisi aseMalokishini.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambisana nezindlela zokungenelela kwezomnotho ukuze kufukulwe futhi kuthuthukiswe iminotho yaselokishini nasezindaweni zasemakhaya.

src: Loku kuhambisana netingenelelo tetemnotfo tekusebentisa nekulawula nekukhulisa iminotfo yasemalokishini nasetindzaweni tasemaphandleni.
tgt: Isikhwama sizohlinzeka ngokweseka futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izizinda zomnotho ezingaziqhuba ngokwazo ezihambisana noHlelo Lokuthuthukisa Umnotho kulezo zindawo.

src: Lemali itawusita futsi icinisekise kutimela kwetikhungo tetemnotfo letihambisana neModeli yeKutfutfukisa yeSigodzi kuleto tindzawo.
tgt: UHlaka Olubuyekeziwe Lwenqubomgomo Yokuhlola Kazwelonke (i-NEPF) Lowezi-2019 – 2024.

src: Luhlakamsebenti lwaVelonkhe lweNchubomgomo yeKuhlola Lolubuyeketiwe 2019-2024.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze i-NEPF Ebuyekeziwe yowezi-2019-2024 kanye noHlelo Lokuhlola Lukazwelonke lowezi-2020-2025, okuthuthukisa uhlelo lokuhlola kuhulumeni.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyivumile le-NEPF leBuyeketiwe yanga-2019-2024 neLisu laVelonkhe Lekuhlola langa-2020-2025, lolwenta kancono inchubo yekuhlola ngekhatsi kuhulumende.
tgt: Lizothuthukisa amandla kahulumeni okuqalisa uHlaka Lwesu Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi lowezi-2020-2024 olusetshenziswayo.

src: Atokwenta kancono emakhono ahulumende ekufezekisa loLuhlakamsebenti lweThemu leseMkatsini lolwemukelwa nga-2020-2024.
tgt: Yomibili imibhalo ingatholakala kuwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wokuhlela, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola (WEBTOKEN).

src: Lisubuciko leLwandle i-Antarctic nalolungaseNingizimu.
tgt: Isu Le-Antarctic ne-Southern Ocean Strategy.

src: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweLisubuciko leLwandle i-Antarctic nalolungaseNingizimu kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa kweSu le-Antarctic ne-Southern Ocean yokuphawula komphakathi.

src: INingizimu Afrika iyindlela leya e-Antarctica yaletinye tinhlelo temave emhlaba te-Antarctica leti-10.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyisango le-Antarctica lezinye ezinhlelo ze-Antarctica zamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Tonkhe letinhlelo tifaka ligalelo kumnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Zonke izinhlelo zibe negalelo emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika.
